name: Chris
title: The outrigger in kuaui was a great…
text: The outrigger in kuaui was a great location, but we were put in a room where the whole wing was under construction. Lots of noise, banging etc. After 2 days, asked to be moved. Price was great & flight was good (I paid for southwest).

name: Andrea
title: A great trip for a great value!
text: GVV set us up with a perfect Ireland trip! The hotels were superior and the itinerary was really good. Some hotels were for 2 nights in areas where there was more to do. The deal included round trip airfare and rental car. We could upgrade any component, but the base items included were great for a great price. Check Great Value Vacations out!

name: Christine Rae Walter
title: Amazing vacation to Greece
text: Amazing vacation to Greece - everything was easy to book, travel was coordinated, really nice places!

name: Alma M
title: Awesome trip to Portugal!
text: We had a fantastic trip to three cities in Portugal. GVV took care of our transportation, lodging, flights and included some tours. We had no problems whatsoever! We have trusted them with many trips and we have never been disappointed. We will continue to recommend GVV to our friends and family.

name: Kenneth Allan Eng
title: Great experience everything went…
text: Great experience everything went according to plan.

name: Christopher
title: Everything went smoothly, no surprises
text: The only drawback was half of the hotels did not have parking, you had to park a few blocks away and walk

name: Anita Cecile Adams
title: you have to pay a lot for carry on luggage
text: The flight and hotel was great. i would have liked to be closer to town. There is a cost for your carry on luggage, I missed that bit of information when i signed up for the trip.

name: John
title: The hotel and transportation…
text: The hotel and transportation arrangements were very nice. It was disappointing to have to commute so far from our hotels to get to the city sights.

name: Katherine Witte
title: The ins and out of Iceland
text: Evidently there are different packages available for the Iceland trip. This wasn’t explained and I had to add on 3 separate excursions after I booked the trip… which meant transportation to and from the hotel to the bus station where the excursions meet wasn’t included. I didn’t realize this until we were there and had to taxi back and forth. Also you have to buy your seats on the plane or chance getting whatever is available… there’s also a charge to check your bag… and if you have a carry on, the size restriction is very small.we’ve used GVV for several trips and have been very happy..but this trip was difficult as there were too many things that were not explained when we booked it. We have another trip booked and hope it’s a little easier… if not we’ll use another company.

name: Larry Richman
title: Well organized
text: Well organized. Good communication.

name: Dottie Atkins-Neikirk
title: Great Value Vacations are true to their name! We had a GREAT and reasonably priced…
text: We had a GREAT and reasonably priced vacation! It really was exceptional. If I would to change anything about your trip description is that more details would have been helpful, for example, if the hotel breakfast was included in our stay or if there was a hotel parking lot. Those details are basic but matters when budgeting. So, more details please! Would do the trip all over and I might! Thank you ~ 💜

name: Cynthia
title: The flight was too long and overbooked
text: The flight was too long and overbooked. The hotel had plumbing issues and sent staff to give us a plunger, The room and location was not bad, in walking distance of several eating establishments.

name: customer
title: Great organization, even if we had to pay extra for the basic necessities
text: We had a wonderful vacation in England, thanks to Great Value Vacations. We do feel like we were nicks and dimed for things that should've been included. For example, we signed up for a 4-person vacation. The hotels we were given reflected that. But we were handed the keys to a Fiat 500, which barely held the four of us, let alone our luggage, which had to be held in our laps as we drove around the entire country of England. We could upgrade, if we wanted to pay more. We didn't have a choice but to pay extra for the zone taxes in London, which, we feel, should've been covered in the price that we paid. For a rental car. In London. Considering all the details, we appreciate how Great Value put together the itinerary so everything was together. That made what could've been a chaotic international trip with two kids, much more organized and easier to keep track of all the things.

name: Dave Helfrich
title: It was a good price for the trip
text: It was a good price for the trip, until you found out that the airline charges you for your seat, and both to check luggage, as well as charging you for the carry on.The hotel was very nice, as was the included Northern Lights Tour.

name: Heather Sue Cormier
title: Great price
text: Great price, nice hotel.

name: Arnold W
title: I feel like this was an all around…scam
text: I feel like this was an all around scam. I bought a Groupon for my family. The Groupon said to buy it then contact the company to book. Only then when I called the company they rudely explained that I just needed to get on their website and do it myself. The dates of the Groupon were WAY more expensive than the Groupon cost. To get the cost down, we had to leave at a bad date. Further, there was no direct flights, no flight upgrade offered, etc. In addition to all that, I ended up having to book hotels at 2 of the three cities. We went to Venice and Rome. The Venice hotel required a train or boat ride to even get to Venice and was like at least 20-30 minutes each way. Then, in Rome, the hotel was a one hour and 9 minute walk from the train station and then an hour walk from any sights in Rome. It was ridiculous and I spent money on a more central hotel. The hotel in Florence was a 24 minute walk to the train station or to any tourist activities. The hotel had no air and the hardest beds I have ever tried to sleep on. The extra tours were very good but very expensive for the money and you can get better things on other cites.

name: KAREN
title: The big disappointment was being booked…
text: The big disappointment was being booked on flights that connected in FCO to go to Madrid from Boston! That added at least 4 to 5 hours to our flying time each way! We were exhausted by the time we got to Madrid and felt we missed the whole next day because of jet lag (and we are seasoned travelers!).Our guide, Rikardo, was great and so were all the local guides. We also had a great group of fellow travelers. So those were the pluses.The hotels were great, but we wished they were more centrally located. Also, we would have liked a little more time in Cascals, or Estoril and not have lunch in a gas plaza. I do understand the drivers need breaks, but somehow I wish the breaks could have been better planned.There was an awful lot of history shared on this trip...quite a bit that was repetitive between our trip guide and the local guides.Overall, the trip was good, not great. I will be honest when people ask me about the trip. I'll share the good (and there definitely were a LOT of good points), but I will also let them know there's definitely a lot of bus time. I think the trip should possibly be 12 days, instead of 10...I barely remember Madrid!

name: Emily
title: Would book again
text: It was my first time booking through great value. Everything was easy and seamless. Everything was as described. While everything was budget- level, that is what was described and expected. I would book again

name: Veronica
title: Memorable Experience
text: This excellent flight options.Hotel was fantastic, clean, pretty, modern and most importantly, its location was so central in the city.  Close to most of the excursion bus stops, restaurants and tourist spots.  The inclusive excursion was excellent (on time, friendly folks, comfortable bus).

name: Melody Bustillos
title: We have taken many trips around the…
text: We have taken many trips around the world with Great Value Vacations. What they do well is source hotels that are always better than what the price point is and in locations near coffee shops and restaurants. Our most recent trip to Bali and Gili T was fabulous! Again, the location of the hotels and the properties themselves made the trip knowing we would have a comfortable place to be with good food around us after a full day of exploring. I tell everyone I know about Great Value Vacations.

name: GMT
title: Itinerary was very well organized except The Address Connolly …
text: Itinerary was very well organized however the last location turned out to be a nightmare. Parking for the rental car was only located in a dangerous sketchy area and the rental car was booted because the parking lot asked for the vehicle VRN number which turned out to be the license number it costed time and over two hundred euros to get the boot off the car which made us also lose time in Dublin. Terrible location for travelers with cars and or walking location at night.

name: Monica H
title: Great company for stress free travel plans!
text: The booking process was simple and thorough. There were no hidden surprises in the form of fees, availability, or changes to our trip. We had a great time and it was stress free when she showed up to our car rental and hotels!

name: Beth M.
title: Our experience was great
text: Our experience was great! All transitions went smooth with the exception of the airport transport to our hotel! They took us to the wrong hotel that created a panic, but was straightened out!Our room was very nice, the pool area was beautiful, and the service staff was fabulous!This is our second trip booked through GVV and we have another one planned! They do a nice job of putting together a well laid out vacation!

name: Jason
title: Our trip was amazing especially for the…
text: Our trip was amazing especially for the price!

name: phil
title: The trip to Puerto Rico was full of…
text: The GVV trip to Puerto Rico was full of high extra costs. The airline charged for options, taxes, carrier fees. The resort charged for resort fees, resort taxes and facilit expense. The extra costs added an additional 1/3 to the cost of the trip. Had we known we would have gone somewhere else. I would hope vendors would advise customers of excessive extra expense when they make their vacation decision.

name: Nick Friedman
title: GVV's answer to my review is a LIE.
text: I recently posted a 2 star review because our promised room WITH TWO DOUBLE BEDS didn't existed and wasn't ready.  GVV responded by saying they only promised a double room, not a room with two double beds.  That is a LIE.  I have the email from GVV promising a room WITH TWO DOUBLE BEDS. For this reason I am lowering my review.

name: TBlauv
title: Our Ireland Vacation with Great Value Vacations was great!
text: The country of Ireland was beautiful and the people were fantastic!  Our trip, booked through Great Value Vacations, was just as described and everything was easy to confirm.  We didn't have any issues and appreciate the truly great value we received.

name: Anatoly Gershman
title: It was not even mentioned that Great…
text: It was not even mentioned that Great Value Vacations  has nothing to do with this Tour which was practically provided by Cosmos.Price was given and Airline tickets were booked without checked baggage allowance (0) for International Tour!

name: Adrian E Torres
title: Spain and Portugal
text: We had a great experience from communication with our guide, even before we left home to the itinerary. Our guide Rikardo, was extremely knowledgeable and the local guides were always well chosen also. We had a Great experience.

name: October 2019
title: Great trip!
text: We visited wonderful sites in Cornwall/Devon which met our expectations!  The sites demanded more physicality than expected however. There was a lot of climbing and steps.Perhaps the time spent in Exeter was not very satisfying but the Leonardo hotel was great. The Greenbank hotel was very nice in Falmouth.The pick up location in the Greenline Coach station was slightly obscure to find    We were in Victoria Station in error.Our Driver and tour guide Amir was exceptional! He was knowledgeable, personable and a very safe driver. He always was concerned about our opinion of what we were seeing and our comfort throughout the trip. I highly recommend Amir and would take another trip with him as a guide!

name: Anonymous
title: Great experience
text: Great experience, would highly recommend. If you choose to do this tour you will not be disappointed.

name: Christopher Gaspard
title: Too far away from the action
text: Seemed all hotels were to far away from the action, especially Split. Some beds were not comfortable. The last place in Zagreb before your flight, should not be an option. It had sheer, see through blinds. Bright and noisy all night brfore our 6am flight.

name: Heather Nicole Herrington
title: We enjoyed our trip
text: We enjoyed our trip! Everything was arranged for us and went perfectly.

name: V Levy
title: Very divided on this vacation
text: Very divided on this vacation.  Flight was a nightmare with a long layover cutting our time short in Venice.  Accommodations in Venice(Mestre) were beautiful and convenient.  Accommodation in Florence was a little disappointing but also convenient location.  Really could have used more information on how to get around the areas.  Had to depend on hotel personnel for everything.   Overall we had a good time but a few changes could have made it great.

name: Jodi Oliver
title: Great Value Vacations live up to their name
text: This was the first time my husband and I have ever done a “package” trip. I had no idea what to expect but not to worry!  Everything from the airline (Play) to the hotel (Hotel Muli) and the Northern Lights tour (Reykjavik Excursions/Icelandia) was terrific.  I would highly recommend checking this company out. I will be booking with them again.

name: Cathy
title: Fabulous Iceland experience
text: Play Airline provided a simple but very comfortable and easy flight from Boston to and from Iceland. Natura Hotel was high quality with really good beds and helpful staff.  We loved stopping at the Blue Lagoon on arrival since we had a lot of time to kill before check in.  Great hotel location (near Perlan museum) and near a local beach with hot pool and sauna)  Location is perfect if you have a car or like to walk (about 20 minutes to downtown).  We walked during day or took taxis at night.  Price for our early April GVV package was a  fabulous value for cost.

name: lorie laliberte
title: Loved the cities we visited.
text: Loved the cities we visited but all the walking and bus riding was a bit much for some of the older people that were on the tour. The tour operators should look at the age of the groups before making the agenda. Some of the hotels weren’t what we had hoped for. Some had tiny showers that larger people would have difficulty with. Otherwise, we had a very enjoyable trip.

name: Dan Hunnicutt
title: The transfers were good and 2 of the 3…
text: The transfers were good and 2 of the 3 hotels were great. The Mykonos hotel was well below expectation. Bad weather caused a missed connection in NY to Athens and we missed 1 night of hotel and the Athens sightseeing trip as a result. We will wait and see if the hotel and sightseeing is reimbursed.

name: Cathy Elaine Patton
title: Hotel was far from town but was close…
text: Hotel was far from town but was close to public transportion. Rooms were super tiny and there was no restaurant.

name: K from the OC
title: Definitely a Great Value
text: Great Value has always been a good experience for us.  We have used them on three different Hawaii tours and never had any problems.  Our reservations at the hotels are in the system and the rooms are great.  It is just enough time away to feel like a vacation.  I would use their services any time.

name: Todd Smith
title: I felt rushed through our call and…
text: I felt rushed through our call and STILL have never received the “confirmation” email we were told we should have received.VERY frustrating.

name: Autumn Eells
title: False Advertisement
text: The package I bought was falsely advertised. It stated that the 2 nights stay, rental car, and airfare were all included in the advertised price. Instead, up on arrival, I was charged an additional $650 for the rental car and $1000 for my stay at The Cringletie. Additionally the package claimed the other 4 nights were at an assortment of air BNBs, which I ended up paying separately for.

name: Marcia Drinkwalter
title: Great planning
text: Great communication. Easy to access information

name: Yasya G
title: Completely smooth process from start to…
text: Completely smooth process from start to finish. Hotel and airline had our reservations, and all of the pricing was accurate (no hidden fees or additional hotel charges).

name: Selene I.
title: Best trip ever! And all thanks to Great Value Vacations
text: I so recommend Great Value. The way the trip was organized, the emails with the itineraries and admission tickets, etc. Email reminders just to make sure that we had everything we needed before the trip helped a lot. The hotels selected were all very different (one modern, one charming, one in a country club, etc) but all were great in their own way. Had a great experience on each one (I think that it helps that Irish people are so nice too). I usually do the logistics myself and it takes so much time but with this package it was all done already that I just had to worry about where to eat or anything extra that wasn't in the itinerary. There were no hiccups and everything went according to plan.The price offered for the package was the main reason I got this, but now that I've done it, next time I'll know it's because it's less stressful to do it this way.I can't believe I jumped in because I saw a post on tiktok about this package, but I definitely made the right choice. It was an awesome experience. Don't hesitate and do it.

name: Daniel Fuente
title: We got what we paid for
text: We got what we paid for. This is not a complaint, just if you want to be lead around by your hand, it’s not for you. You get 2 half day tours as advertised. The hotel in Barcelona is a fine facility but more geared to business travelers, due to its location

name: Zheila Pouraghabagher
title: Experience matched expectations!
text: Was very easy to book. Expectations matched up to what was sold. I would definitely book through you all again!

name: Stephanie Ann Gertz
title: The beauty of Southern Italy
text: Our accommodations were good and I felt like we got everything Great Value stated we would get in the official itinerary. Massimo was a great tour director, very knowledgeable in Rome’s history and he has a love for his country. There is a lot of walking, which is understandable, considering where you are. It was great exercise and I enjoyed everything about the trip.

name: Pamela Ferguson
title: Budapest, Vienna, and Prague
text: We just completed a trip to Budapest, Vienna, and Prague. It was overall a wonderful experience and we were pleased and happy with our vacation. However, there were a few things that I think could've been done differently and/or better. Due to the chosen flight and train times, we ended up only having 1 day in Budabest and Prague, but 3 days in Vienna. Unfortunately, those were the cities that we wanted to spend the most time. We would've actually even chosen to skip Vienna all together. The other thing is that our hotel in Vienna was so far out of the city that 30 mins by car to get to anything, including the train station. There's no way that we could go back and forth without wasting time. I would've paid more to be closer to the city,

name: Lhdavis
title: Our Ireland/Scotland trip was fabulous
text: Our Ireland/Scotland trip was fabulous! The value was phenomenal. The hop on hop off bus, included in both cities, was fantastic and allowed us to see so much we would not have been able to. The Ashling hotel in Dublin was fantastic- great breakfast, comfortable modern rooms, and convenient location. The Ibis hotel was a budget hotel in Edinburgh and not the same level as the Ashling. Our room was not clean although, management got housekeeping quickly to change bedding, got us a fan, due to no air. Outlets were limited and not convenient. It reminded me of a cabin on a cruise ship- small and sparse. We still had a great time and will book again with GVV. You have to realize and understand you are not getting luxury hotels for the price you pay.

name: Suzanne Joy Gokavi
title: We enjoyed the whole experience
text: We enjoyed the whole experience!  The package was well put together, though the part that would have been helpful was to include airport transfers as we arrived in Iceland at 4:30 am.  It was a nice hotel and the flight times were convenient both coming and going!  We will probably book again with you!

name: partially satisfied customer
title: loved Titanic Hotel in Belfast and…
text: loved Titanic Hotel in Belfast and Dunboyne Castle Hotel. Was unimpressed by Red Castle Hotel-- no air conditioning?!?! and checked out of Ocean Sands Hotel in Innescrone a day early because it smelled, was extremely loud and had maybe the most uncomfortable beds and linens I have ever experienced.

name: Liz
title: Portugal is amazing!
text: Our 10 day trip to Porto and Lisbon was well worth it and very affordable.  The country is beautiful and the people are friendly. Really recommend going and Great Value is very helpful too!

name: Mark A Abatuno
title: A direct flight from Boston to Cancun…
text: A direct flight from Boston to Cancun is great.

name: DENISE
title: Hotels were good
text: Hotels were good. Tours that we paid for were not as described.

name: Ian
title: Complicated logistics that were…
text: Complicated logistics that were flawlessly executed.  Great trip.

name: Eddie
title: As Advertised
text: Great deal on Western Europe trip. It was our first time using GVV. Also, very happy with their hotel selections and breakfast options included on our stays. Won’t hesitate to use GVV again. Happy to have used them, and looking forward for the next trip with them.

name: The Bees
title: Flight itinerary overly aggressive...tired, old hotel
text: Good Trip but the itinerary was overly aggressive.  Almost 20 hours of flying and then pick up a rental car at dark and drive over 3 hours in the rain and darkness to our hotel.  Several hotel changes made us feel like we were getting ripped off and sure enough, the hotel was old and tired with grumpy staff.  Other than the over ambitious schedule and tired hotel, the trip was lovely.

name: Malou Nicklow
title: Awesome vacation!!
text: We had a great hotel, great vacation!! This is our 3rd trip with Great Value Vacations!! We will definitely book with them again!!!

name: Rocio Lopez
title: This was my first time booking through…
text: This was my first time booking through Great Value. My friend and I had a great time in Costa Rica. Everything was well organized, the flights, hotels, tours and transportation through out.  The choice of hotels were perfect, well kept, clean and above all we felt safe throughout our trip.

name: Brian
title: We had a great experience
text: We had a great experience. Value for what we got was incredible.

name: Jonathan  Blackburn
title: Hotels were great except Greece 2025the 8 hour…
text: Hotels were great except the 8 hour ferry back to Athens

name: Norma Q Gandolfo
title: Hilton Riviera Maya, Tulum, Mexico
text: The Hilton is, indeed, a five star hotel.  The room was clean and nice but quite far (Casa 5) from the lobby where the action is.  The service was excellent.  The "all inclusive'  buffet food good but fortunately they had the option of "dinner a la carte" at good restaurants which we enjoyed every evening.The hotel surprisingly does not have good beaches, it's rocky and impossible to get to the sea.  Only one small beach has been conditioned with some sort of  "wall" to stop the huge waves but still with some rocks.  It is recommended to wear special shoes.About GVV, as a constructive criticism, they should advise the customers the Cancun airport is very far from Tulum and hire a more reliable company for their transfers. The "shared transfer" with NEXUS should be advertised properly with a banner.  It took us a long time to find the Nexus van upon arrival.  On departure, it was equally difficult to make the reservation.  I contacted GVV for approval to change the "shared transfer" to a private transfer since we were told the ride would take about 5 hours and our flight was at 11:14am. They never responded so I did my own arrangement and paid an additional $74 for one.  However, the day of departure, April 8, they didn't show up.  We had to hire a taxi to drive us to the airport and paid US$100 for the service.I am requesting GVV reimbursement for the "shared transfer" we didn't use.  Also I have requested Nexus to reimburse me for the additional $74 I paid and the $100 for the taxi. Totally disappointed with the trip.

name: DH
title: We had another wonderful vacation with great value vacations
text: We had another wonderful vacation with great value vacations. They work with high quality local vendors to provide excellent service and memorable experiences

name: Patrice White
title: Southern Italy
text: Everything was great thoroughly enjoyed the trip.. all the hotels were nice some better than others breakfasts were really good miss the coffee already. Our tour director Mossimo was top notch and really made the trip one to remember!! Highly recommend.

name: E T
title: The Hilton Tulum Great/ Nexus Tours Transporation NO SHOW at Airport
text: The Hilton Tulum is very nice - multiple infinity pools, various restaurant choices, great views of the ocean if your room faces that way.  The staff is friendly and accommodating. The hotel is isolated though so either you hang at the resort or take day trips elsewhere.  Only 3 stars for this trip though bc the Nexus Tours airport transfer NEVER SHOWED even though we upgraded to a private transfer. We waited for 1+ hour and the reps kept saying “10-15 more minutes”. Finally one of them said “The driver is missing. We have to find a new one.”  They never did so we paid for a taxi to the Hilton (1+ hour ride).  The ride back to the airport was on time thank God. Still waiting for the refund from Nexus.

name: T Adams
title: Itinerary was good.
text: Hotels were good. Met itinerary expectations. Top notch tour director.

name: TROY
title: The vacation value was excellent
text: The vacation value was excellent. The hotel was better than expected at 3 plus stars. The daily breakfast had a lot of fresh and healthy choices. This is our second great value vacation and we highly recommend them.

name: Emily C
title: No value to this trip vs booking on my own
text: I was very disappointed with this experience.  I book through these websites expecting to receive a deal - and as it turns out for the flight they gave me and the hotels they included, it would have been significantly cheaper for me to book on my own. Additionally, when I arrived in my second city location, the hotel had not been reserved and the hotel was sold out. Because they do not have 24/7 emergency customer service, I had to fill out the online form and find different accommodations on my own. On the plus side, they did call me about five hours later and said they would refund me the cost of the hotel for that city. I have one more trip already booked through great value vacations for next month and then I will strongly consider going back to gate1 travel.

name: Benjamin Holy
title: Trip was great, Limerick hotel was not
text: Just about everything about this trip was amazing! Starting with the price, which was awesome! Most of the hotel were really great. Lots of amenities and even better views and culture.  The travel was mostly smooth and well done through Aer Lingus. The only problem that soured the trip a bit was the Limerick hotel. There is no way that place is a 4 star hotel. I give them a little pass as there was construction going on in the hotel, but only having one, very small, functioning elevator for a 6 story building doesn’t work. Also, this was the only location where parking was only discounted, but even the discount wasn’t great. Also, no amenities like a pool or workout area was a real bummer. In my opinion this location should be removed as an option with your packages moving forward. There were a number of much nicer hotels very close to that location.  The feel of this vacation started off somewhat luxurious at the Ormond in Kilkenny and continued in Bantry at the Maritime. Druids Glen in Wicklow was also amazing. The fact that you have a run down, no amenity having hotel like this in the middle to end of the trip was really unfortunate. Please try to do something to remedy this in the future. We will continue to use Great Value in the future. Thanks.

name: Kit
title: The trip was very organized
text: Great experience and great value, definitely recommend it

name: Margaret Tiedemann
title: We stayed at the Ashling Hotel and that…
text: We stayed at the Ashling Hotel and that was a great choice for us.  Thank you.

name: Ben A
title: Awesome trip
text: We were so happy with our recent trip! Everything worked out seamlessly from airfare,hotels and car rental. The hotels that were picked for us were all amazing and so different from each other, which made things fun.

name: Esther Koblitz
title: We loved our stay in Amsterdam!!
text: We loved our stay in Amsterdam and the countryside. Each day was full of exciting adventures. From the windmills, to the canals, to the museums and architecture, we enjoyed every minute.

name: Sad and mad
title: Places were great
text: Places were great! Hotels were good.

name: Lisa Jane Alexander
title: We were left stranded on the Big Island…
text: We were left stranded on the Big Island of Hawaii. Our flight home had been scheduled from another Islands (Kauai) airport. It was Sunday & we were unable to reach a live person. We had to submit an emergency request online. No response until Tuesday & redirected to send another email. I had to find & pay for our flight home. Expensive & stressful to say the least! We were a party of 3. Still not resolved!

name: Customer
title: No worries with great value accommodations, flights, or vouchers
text: All the hotels were ready for us -easy check in and check out. The accommodations were great.The voucher system for rail was easy.Our flights were comfortable with good seating placement.The Ring of Kerry guided bus tour was fantastic!Everything fell into place beautifully.What a wonderful trip to Ireland for such a great value!Thank you for making my first overseas trip in 15 years a wonderful experience!

name: AMBER MILLER
title: Great experience
text: I was pleased with the pricing and that all aspects of the trip were booked for me. Vouchers were easy to find and instructions were clear. I needed to reach out to great value vacations because there was no confirmation number on my transfer from the airport to my resort and my email was answered very quickly with the information I needed. I would definitely book through this site again!

name: Gail Ruscito
title: Package included Air
text: Package included Air, Hotel, transfers and Northern Lights tour - never been to Iceland so made it easy.  GVV customer service was very helpful and accomodating and made it easy to upgrade air and hotel as I wanted more than just economy air  and was not happy with location of hotel even though it was 4 star it was in a business district - not where I wanted to be - they gave me a few different options to choose from (for an upgrade fee) and I found the perfect hotel - Center Hotel Midgadur - perfect location, awesome staff, nice spa.  Can not say enough good things about this hotel.   All in all a great value tour.   No pun intended.    Would book another tour with them again for sure.

name: Bernadette Michelle Lyons
title: I really had such a good experience
text: I really had such a good experience. My husband and I went to Italy and everything was booked for us with no issues. I had never done a package before so I was nervous, but it was a great experience and very affordable.

name: customer
title: Hotel was great in Prague
text: Hotel was great in Prague, but the other two were in need of remodeling otherwise loved that they were central to restaurants and train stations.For the price I would do it again!

name: Annie
title: Hotel Info not accurate
text: Our package indicated the hotel in London included breakfast.  It did not.

name: Alejandra Camarco
title: Traveling with 8 friends and Great…
text: Traveling with 8 friends and Great Value Vacations cut my stay and my friend a day short. When I found out that our check out was a day earlier I called them. The lady who answered the phone only repeats “ I see your book ends tomorrow “ I tried to explain that must be an error because we all (8 people) never chose the dates. It was a link that when you click it only can chose the departure. Also we were all traveling together, so how 2 people in the group have to leave a day before. I was a nightmare. I will never use the company again. They even didn’t try to refund the extra day we paid, when we all paired the same amount of money but one of my friends and I we vacationed a day shorter. title: Exceptional Thailand Experience with Great Value Vacations!
text: My partner and I recently took a trip to Thailand through Great Value Vacations, and it exceeded our expectations! We chose a package with more tours, and to our surprise, every tour was completely private—just us, our personal driver, and an incredible guide, Pepsi.Pepsi made our trip unforgettable. Not only was he knowledgeable and personable, but he also had a college degree in English, making communication effortless. He shared expert tips, took us to hidden gems, and even arranged bonus visits to places like a wholesale flower and vegetable market. We always had a direct line to him via WhatsApp, which made everything seamless.Every tour went smoothly except for the Phi Phi Island excursion booked through Wow Andaman, whose guide (Don) was untrustworthy. I wouldn’t recommend that provider.As for flights, Air India was okay, but I wouldn’t fly with them again. One small hiccup was that our local travel agency booked a Thai Airways flight but didn’t provide Great Value Vacations with our ticket details. Fortunately, Pepsi quickly resolved this for us. Our personal tour guide in Phuket, Alex, was similarly stellar (though we had significantly fewer interactions with him vs Pepsi). Alex was able to recommend an excursion to an elephant sanctuary that was the highlight of the entire trip and his travel agency ICS was able to book that swiftly for us and arrange for payment.Overall, Great Value Vacations delivered a stress-free, personalized experience. name: Europe-bound
title: Awesome Icelandic Adventure for three…
text: Awesome Icelandic Adventure for three adults, three nights, four days, from Boston visiting a Great Value Vacation.Play Airlines - an economic option- does not offer an app, but rather uses web or airport kiosk options to check in.  Carryons MUST fit in the pre-boarding measurement device. Comfortable seating with slight upgrade, pay for beverage & snack service, and no WiFi. Leaving Keflavík was a bit awkward as we were bused from the inside of the terminal to the outside tarmac, and had to board, carrying luggage, up steep slippery steps into the plane while it was raining, snowing & sleeting with high winds.Staff though were all very friendly & professional.We stayed at Center Hotels Plaza  that offered EXCELLENT service, including a complimentary upgrade upon arrival due to construction improvements going on. We found adding daily breakfast buffet upon check in was worth it. We were within walking distance to great international restaurants, nightlife, shops, waterfront, historical sites, and the embassies.Northern Lights experience was a bust- due to being too cloudy, and low KPI rating. Group meets at the BSI bus terminal at 9:30, 10 buses left at 10:00 to drive to Thingvellir National Park an hour away. Stand outside in the dark with little to no direction. Bus boarded at 1am, hour ride back, dropped numerous passengers off to a variety of hotels (great way to get a preview of the city), before returning to bus terminal. If we were to do this trip again, we’d forgo the Northern Lights (due to the time constraints of 10p to 2:30am) and seek a Blue Lagoon option package instead. (We live in the north & see the Lights often.) Reykjavík Experience (who run the tours) offer next night free if you don’t see the N. Lights and will refund you if still unable to see them.We rented a car and loved being able to go and explore the Blue Lagoon & Golden Circle on our own as well as the west coast. Beautiful breathtaking country!Icelandic food was absolutely delicious & worth the expense.The locals- absolutely wonderful and friendly!We took the time to read many of the plaques and sculptures scattered around Reykjavík… great history lesson. Highly encourage visitors to pick up any of the free well-written newspapers and magazines. We found several in the airport,  bus terminal and hotel.Looking forward to a return someday soon!

title: Some good; some bad!
text: No information was given pre-trip on the best/least expensive way to get from the airport in London or the train station in Paris.  This left us using a taxi in both cities for a cost of over $100 in each city.  The hotel in London was quite nice and the people who worked there were very pleasant and helpful.  It was well located for using public transportation for sight-seeing and was close to shops and restaurants.  The hotel in Paris was awful.  There wasn't space in the room to even open a suitcase and it wasn't located close to either shops or restaurants.  It required taking an Uber to whatever sight we were seeing that day and another Uber to get dinner after we were through sight-seeing for the day - more unexpected costs.  Overall, I really enjoyed my time in both London and Paris but none of my enjoyment had to do with the travel arrangements made by Great Value Vacations. name: KATHERINE
title: Tropical vacation of my dreams
text: Our entire package was wonderful and as described! Our flights were luckily empty and we had rows to ourselves each way, though we paid additional for luggage (expected).Our transfers to and from the airport were easy to register ahead for (just put code in their site to confirm 1-2 days prior), on time, air conditioned, and clean. We had a private ride to the resort and picked up one other couple on our way home. They planned ample time for traffic, the other pick up and security for our departure, which I appreciated.The resort itself was awesome! The architecture is fun to explore, the many bars and food establishments allowed us to dive in to enjoying ourselves right away. We arrived in time for breakfast and had 4 drinks each before it was through, the service is great and they love to take care of you! I am gluten free and they are super allergy focused throughout the facility. When you are sat at each location they ask for allergies right away, write it on a card to give the waiter/kitchen and also tell the waiter verbally. At the buffet the hostess would walk me around and tell me what was safe for my needs and what I could special order from the kitchen. In the restaurants, menus are labeled but the waiters also knew of additional substitutions that could be made for me to enjoy even more (gf pizza crust and removing Orzo from shrimp at La Luce, gf soy sauce, fried rice and rice noodles available, special made the tuna roll gf too at Noriku). I found all the options to be very fresh and well seasoned, with great variety everywhere even given my limitations (my husband enjoyed everything).Love the Seasalt bar and grill by the pools in the middle of the property. You can see the ocean from the restaurant and most of the nearby pools, where you can have the food and drink delivered to you poolside by one of the many roaming waitstaff. That became my favorite thing: just relaxing and reading, swimming, having a tamarind margarita and beef tenderloin tacos delivered right to me as I watched the ocean and an iguana searching for an abandoned burger. Just the relaxing tropical retreat I was hoping for!Our room was absolutely wonderful! The room was spacious, the shower was large and had a large rain shower head, separate water closet, and mini fridge with snacks, water, soda, and beer, also included. The room was clean and had good AC, it did get kind of humid inside, but we had trouble drying out our clothes in and outside, so I think it was simply the weather. We seemingly were upgraded from nature view to first floor, pool and ocean view! It was right between Seasalt and the adults only pool so we could walk right out to one of 3 pools, beach, and bar/grill without leaving our building group! The main lobby and south buffet were both a short walk or shuttle ride away. We did find catching the shuttle at our stop to go to them was less reliable than just walking 5 minutes, but it was easy to catch one back.We enjoyed just swimming at the beach and pools, eating and drinking and relaxing so much we didn’t leave the resort or do many activities outside of a casino night prior to dinner in the lobby one evening and dancing to a band in the bar one later night. Several daily activities were on offer though especially for kiddos it seemed, but they were more in their area of the resort. There is a whole online portal you access to arrange your dinner reservations, see activities for the day, order room service, etc. it was really convenient. And when we couldn’t get a reservation online, the concierge arranged it no problem.Absolutely wonderful trip! Would highly recommend especially at a good price like we got compared to the hotel website! Would also recommend bringing some cash to tip the waitstaff for their great work and service! We didn’t spend more than $100 tipping for days and they kept us well taken care of!

text: I am writing to formally lodge a complaint against your agent, Tracey, for her lack of transparency and extremely unprofessional behavior in handling my recent ticket booking.In March 2025, I booked a ticket through Skylux via Tracey for a May 2025 trip to India. At no point during the booking process did she explain or provide any details about your cancellation or rebooking policy. She appeared to be in a rush to finalize the booking and push for payment, leaving no opportunity to review or discuss these critical policies.Due to the escalating conflict in the region I was originally scheduled to visit, I contacted Skylux to rebook my flight to a safer city. To my shock, your customer care representative informed me that I would have to pay the full retail price for the new ticket, not the discounted Skylux rate I had originally received. When I questioned this, the representative rudely stated that Skylux discounts only apply to new bookings and not to rebookings — a crucial detail that was never disclosed to me during the booking process.I followed up with Tracey directly. She initially told me to contact customer service again, despite my already having done so. I reminded her that she had failed to explain the rebooking policy, and she said she would speak with her supervisor and call me back. She never did. When I called again, she picked up, heard my voice, and immediately transferred me to hold music for over 20 minutes. After that, she ignored five more calls and has not returned my voicemail.This is completely unacceptable. Skylux’s practice of withholding essential policy information until after payment is deceptive and unethical. Customers have a right to understand their options before purchasing tickets, especially for international travel to potentially unstable regions.I am formally requesting that Skylux:Rebook my ticket to a different city in India — one not affected by conflict —At the original discounted Skylux price,Without additional retail charges, since the lack of policy disclosure was not my fault.This issue stems from Tracey’s failure to inform me of the relevant policies at the time of booking, and Skylux should take full responsibility to resolve it.I sincerely hope your company values its customers beyond the point of payment. I expect a prompt and fair resolution within 7 business days, or I will escalate this issue to appropriate consumer protection agencies and share my experience publicly.

title: Really enjoyed getting to bypass the…
text: Really enjoyed getting to bypass the lines in most places. Taking the Riverboat Cruise in Paris was amazing. Since we are paying for these meals in the cost of the trip it was really disappointing to not have good meals. Or what seemed to be the cheapest meals there were. On top of this there was no real time on lunch to really go explore food options. Having this be my first trip to Europe I was really disappointed in 90% of the food. Most of the time we were stuck in areas that were not air conditioned and very warm. Also, we were only allowed water unless we wanted to pay extra. Again since food is paid for in the cost of the trip we should have been allowed a drink of our choice.Also, I wasn't very happy with the hotel choices with the exception of the hotel in Paris. There was no air conditioning allowed in the hotels making for an uncomfortable sleeping arrangements.There wasn't enough time to truly have some free time to explore or just take in what we were seeing. Everything was rushed. Including walking. The pace should be slower so people don't feel like they are running a race. I expected there to be a lot of walking but what I didn't expect was to have to walk 10 minutes or more to get back to the buses. I don't understand why they could drop us off close to our venue but not pick us up close to our venue.Overall, it was a great trip. Got to see and do a lot but just not enough time to explore and see a bit of the culture and shop. There should be 2 1/2 hours at lunch to get to eat somewhere good and explore. An hour and a half isn't long enough.I really did enjoy our tour guides Charles and Mike by the end of the trip it felt like one big family!Thank you.

name: Jennifer Shinn
title: Thoughtfully Planned, Student-Centered Travel Experiences That Inspire
text: Traveling with EF Tours has been a truly rewarding experience for both my students and myself as a Group Leader. What stands out most is the level of organization, care, and thoughtful planning that goes into every part of the trip — from the pre-departure support to the on-the-ground experience. EF makes what could be an overwhelming process feel manageable and even fun, especially for busy educators like me.The professionalism and knowledge of our Tour Director and local guides brought the destinations to life in ways that went far beyond what students would experience as ordinary tourists. I also appreciated the variety in the itinerary — major cities, charming small towns, and incredible optional excursions that added unforgettable moments to our trip, like dining in the Tuscan countryside and visiting one of Italy’s oldest hilltop towns.EF also excels in their support behind the scenes. My Experience Specialist, Johanna, did a great job at keeping me organized, answering my many questions, and even going out of her way to help us add an extra chaperone last minute. That kind of service makes a huge difference for educators juggling a lot of responsibilities.If I had one piece of constructive feedback, it would be to continue finding ways to support first-time Group Leaders with clearer expectations during fast-paced moments on tour — but overall, EF has built an impressive system that balances structure with flexibility, and I’m so grateful for the experience.We’ve already sold out our next tour to Greece for 2026 and are excited to plan for 2027. I highly recommend EF to anyone looking to create life-changing travel opportunities for their students.

She is top ten in her class, and she could not remember what country a couple locations were located, because everything started to run together.  Madrid could have been left off. That would have allowed the girls to enjoy Rome and Paris a little more on their own with their chaperone's. It would have given them a little more free time which they wanted. A little more time to enjoy the city and see more things on their own (with chaperone's).  As a mother, i truly understand where they are coming from.  We understand this is an educational trip, BUT you can get education as well from exploring a city and enjoying the culture, sites, food, shops and sounds of the city. It would have felt a little more personal as well.  We get the museum exploration but there was a couple too many.Adding a little more site seeing and experiencing on their own in groups with their chaperone would have been very nice.  They enjoyed the trip but felt 1 too many museums and not enough down time to explore Rome and Paris a little more in a different light.

Plus, the local tour guides brought each destination to life with their rich insights and enthusiasm. EF Tours truly made this an unforgettable adventure for both students and chaperones!

name: Krissa Peters
title: Japan EF Tour

It was relaxing as an adult as the kids paired up in groups as they made friends and explored on their own under the safety of the tour guide and I got to explore at my own pace

name: Catherine Brady
title: Experience of a lifetime
text: My daughter really enjoyed her trip and all the tours thru EF tours. They communicated to the parents very well we had absolutely no issues!

name: Heather Andrus
title: Our EF tour guide was amazing
text: Our EF tour guide was amazing, and so was Greece! He was knowledgeable, patient with our students, and personable.

name: Tomira Viviano
title: I did not like the hotel set up

name: Samuel Reed
title: Naomi has been amazing at helping me to…
text: Naomi has been amazing at helping me to get a Travel program started at my campus.

name: Elizabeth Berdan
title: Will never do a tour with EF afain
text: I have called numerous times and spoken to different people about getting the credit back to me from a recent trip. They all have me a different answer on the process. Just received the check back which was incorrect. They all told me I would be getting an email first to ask how I wanted the refund back. They said they would always try to use the electronic version first. Needless to say no email was ever sent. Today I spoke with Enrique and Asmith(sp). I asked to speak to a supervisor they refused. Enrique told me he can handle anything a supervisor can. Nobody had been able to help me up to this point so I wanted someone higher. They both refused multiple times. EF hiding something?

name: Danielle Camastra
title: Outstanding experience
text: Klaudia, our tour guide was absolutely amazing. She was high energy, informative, fun, organized, collected and easygoing. The tour was jam packed with sights, history and activities. Although towards the end, it would have been nice to have a bit more time to rest.

name: Amber Chittenden
title: We had an amazing trip to Italy
text: We had an amazing trip to Italy, Austria and Germany.  The days were very structured yet allowed for enough flexibility that we could adjust when needed.  The kids had a great time and made memories to last a lifetime.  Our tour guide Rosala was a perfect blend of knowledge and humor to keep the tours fun and informative.

name: Laurel Gugino
title: My son had an amazing time on his…
text: My son had an amazing time on his recent France/Spain excursion with his class through your tour company.  He went everywhere and saw everything he wanted and more.  He said he never felt uncomfortable and always felt safe.  He had a wonderful time, and his tour guide was THE BEST.

name: Christine Teixeira
title: My daughter had an amazing experience…
text: My daughter had an amazing experience with her class. Everything was well organized and the tour guides were great. The weather was amazing, the food and people too.

name: Laurie Weed
title: My daughter truly loved the…
text: My daughter truly loved the organization of this trip with a friendly guide to show them all the best spots!

name: Patricia Stolz
title: Easter Europe April 2025
text: The organization and information to prepare for the tour is excellent.  The tour guide makes the travel easy.  The daily intinerary was exciting and well balanced.Eastern Europe was so beautiful and rich in history.  I cannot express how highly I recommend this journey.The only negative was that flight arrangements were a little tight, and indeed we did miss a connection.  Everyone was very helpful and we enjoyed a little extra time to explore!

name: Mireille Loosli
title: Macy that I have been working with is…
text: Macy that I have been working with is really very helpful!  She has guided me really well.

name: Tabatha
title: Not for me
text: There were aspects that I enjoyed and some that didn't create a positive experience.1. Hotels- I knew the hotels would be 3 star rated hotels but I don't know the criteria for the rating equivalency in the US compared to Italy. In some cases I would say they were 2 star hotels. Walls were dirty, bugs in room and on bed, bathrooms and windows were broken and in one location the hotel was in an area with run down buildings, graffiti, etc. I wasn't sure how a school tour was booked in this neighborhood and then we had to walk at night through it. The food wasnt really good at some of the hotels and we had dinner and breakfast there sometimes.  Some were better than others. I persinally think we were booked in hotels far from our destinations to save money but the quality wasn't good. On the positive side, the customer service was good from the front desk staff and they were friendly.2. Flights, the tour requires you to arrive 3 hours early which is excessive. If you need any special accommodations that require special seating or upgrades, forget about it. Ef doesn't care. They really leave you in a bind and say they can't help you. They won't take your request in advance and they won't adjust after. They say the contract doesn't allow, however the airlines, repeatedly said they were lying and they were the only ones who can make the adjustments to a group booking. They don't confirm the flights until 1 month prior which doesn't leave alot of time to manage the reservation on your own. They didn't care about my accommodation and told me that I would be released from the group booking 24 to 48 hours prior to departure to make changes on my own. That never happened and the airline told me that wasn't a thing and apologized for my experience with EF tour and said they are the only ones that could help me. I will add Lufthansa is not flexible to change a group booking directly with them and require that thr tour agent does it unless they release you from the group but EF would not release me.EF will accept advance room request for an upgraded price but don't do the same for flights. I will never tour with them again3. My child had fun with his friends but the days were so packed it took away from the enjoyment for them. The kids wanted the ability to have true free time. Everything was restricted. In some cases they got free time but only in a designated area. Free time or days didn't allow for you to stay at hotel or offer options. Everyone had to go to a specific space and have so called free time. It didn't feel like free time to them. In some cases you got free time before seeing the area so you didn't know how to spend your free time. I think it would be better to offer free time in between tours. Have the ability to stop along the way. Maybe the EF guide creates space for that.4. Website, they offer a checklist on their site. It would be helpful if it you complete a task to show completed.5. Bus, our first bus was old and had a wood rooftop. There were termites flying in it. Yes, termites.6. Food, the food was not good in most of the places. Someone told us this was known. They know the restaurants don't have good food. So why keep that relationship. One place fed us slop. It was disgusting. Most kids didn't eat and ended up going to McDonalds. One restaurant the worker yelled at our guide and was rude. Why continue to do business with them.We went to one that served us braised beef and green beans. That was the best in Florence.But in general, EF needs better restaurant partners. We are still paying for meals and they should be quality.Besides that, the tour Guide was great. No complaints with her. We all loved her.I appreciate the experience and some of the great places that we got to see and meeting new people but EF in terms of customer service and the quality of the hotels and restaurants were not great.

name: Heather Dillon
title: Always looking out for you!
text: EF Educational Tours makes traveling with students seamless from beginning to end. They develop a well-thought-out itinerary and set up experiences that are educational and fun. Having a dedicated Tour Director makes all the difference - they make sure that everything is running smoothly, and they are also there to support you when complications arise. EF has your back, and I will never travel without them.

name: Desiree Da Silva Holdredge
title: Great TD - Gustavo was amazing! He knew absolutely everything and was always there to provide a tidbit of information. He was an historian, and biologist and naturalist and so much more!
text: Great TD, amazing local guides, beautiful accommodations, wonderful experiences.

name: Luis Jimenez
title: Great Itinerary, Fantastic Views!
text: My wife and I were in search of a travel adventure to discover the Alps up close and personal.  After a long, tedious search, we discovered EF Tours which offered the "Jewels of Alpine Europe", 12 day tour, with a two day extension to Salzburg, Austria.  This truly fantastic tour exceeded all of our expectations!  What made this tour extra special was definitely our tour guide, Jocelyn. She was professional, caring and patient with all of us, a group of 24 enthusiastic travelers.  And, the views of the Alps were just amazing, breathtaking.  You must go on this EF tour. Simply the best!

name: Allison Brocious
title: My EF Tours Representative
text: My EF Tours Representative, Lindsey is amazing. She made a process that would have been overwhelming simply easy and amazing!

name: TEA ALAGIC
title: Excellent work
text: Excellent workMy son had great experience

name: Michelle Michaud
title: Amazing work experience for our 16 yr old!!
text: EF Tours made it very easy for our son to go on this once in a life time trip with his school. Our son had an amazing time and came back with so many stories about his trip. The payment plan was very reasonable for us and we love that the trip was about two years out so we had plenty of time for planning. The itinerary they laid out to get things done and what he would be needing on his trip was very easy to follow and helped a lot. We also got our some the Till card through your recommendation and that was so incredibly easy to use and helped a lot. It was nice to see the fees that are normally charged for using cards overseas refunded. Thank you very much for this opportunity EF Tours!! If another trip opportunity comes up through you we will be jump on getting our boys on it ASAP!

name: John Coleman
title: The tour was very organized but our…
text: The tour was very organized but our experience started off bad. My son’s group leader did not attend the trip (found someone else) and did not keep us informed about what we needed prior to boarding the plane. My son and I missed the first flight to Belize because we did not have the parent authoration form. Also, my son is in middle school and was in the room with high school kids.  My son ended up getting kicked out of his room because one of the boys could not sleep in the bed with another boy so that the two boys would have their own bed. Luckily, I was able to go on the trip with him because the other group leader made the tour director moved my son to my room.  I think that was out of order because my son did not get the independent experience I paid for and I thought I paid for my own room. In addition, one night one of the Parents from the other school slept in my room with me.

name: Kara Clark-Hartshorne
title: Our son had a fantastic experience
text: Our son had a fantastic experience.  He saw a lot,  he enjoyed things he didn't think he'd care about.  He made new friends, and has stories that he will remember his entire life.  The trip ran smoothly, communication was excellent and he had zero complaints.

name: Annette Bickford-Young
title: It was really organized and made great…
text: It was really organized and made great use of all the time we were there!

name: Morgan Ruchel
title: It was great
text: It was great, they kept us alive, didn’t put up with bullshit, and Sofia was lovely. I just wasn’t the biggest fan of all the dinner spots

name: Fabian Flores
title: EF Tours Germany
text: EF Tours was exceptional throughout the tour process, from the beginning to after the tour. Their ability to communicate effectively and efficiently is amazing. They answered all my questions respectfully, and even if they did not have an answer, they went and found it. The tour went well thanks to the support of EF.

name: Mo
title: EF Tours supplied us with a fabulous…
text: EF Tours supplied us with a fabulous tour guide and bus driver, Caterina and Sibilo (name may be spelled wrong). We saw more than what was on our itinerary because they always made sure to point out other places and sights to us. Food-breakfast wasn't the best, and dinner wasn't the best. We had pasta every night...I know they say when in Rome...but the kids were certainly looking for other options, which were possible when we stayed at the first 2 hotels. The last hotel, although nice on the inside, we were given strict instructions not to venture into the neighborhood, which we had no plans to do. The neighborhood did not look safe at all. Overall, we had a great time! Memories were made...

name: Vanja Trifunovic
title: My child loved it

text: The flights going and returning were both horrible, with multiple layovers requiring more than 24 hours of travel time each way.   However, the tour itself in Costa Rica was outstanding.

name: A.C.
title: A great trip!
text: Communication about how to plan for the trip was phenomenal.  My kids had a wonderful time, got to see many scenic places and enjoyed the tour guides that led them through each day.  I highly recommend the EF Tours!

name: LL
title: Rome, Paris, and Madrid
text: Our tour guides, Mike and Charles were amazing. My daughter and I miss them! They were so knowledgeable and fun, they were also protective of the group and made sure we were safe and where we were supposed to be on time. Everything was very well organized. There was only one day that we were standing out in the rain waiting to get in somewhere, but you just had to laugh about it, everybody being soaking wet, my favorite part of the Tours besides all of the beautiful sites of course, included the local culture. We had free time to walk around and visit shops and restaurants. Get lunch on our own. Try and speak with people explore and take pictures. I’m signed up for next year‘s tour and I can’t wait to see what’s coming up after that!

name: Elizabeth Larson-DiPippo
title: Best Week Ever
text: Best Week Ever! My Daughter just returned from an 8 day trip to Scotland & Ireland with her school.  They used EF Tours and she can't stop raving about what a good time she had. Interesting excursions, good food, great hotels, and easy transfers between countries. Thanks for making her first international travel experience a really really good one!

name: Brad Osullivan

title: My son had the best time
text: My son had the best time! The company even got them through Vatican City and Rome during the pope’s funeral. What an amazing experience.

name: Carla

She is on top of everything and always willing/available for calls, zoom meetings, emails, or whatever. I'm very impressed by her acute attention to detail every step of the way. I love working with this company and look forward to many more trips with you.

name: Elaine Moore
title: Kept me Organized
text: The experience as a parent was great on how the site kept us organized with deadlines and payments. It was great.

name: Shannon V.
title: Our EF tour was fantastic
text: Our EF tour was fantastic! We traveled to Ireland and Scotland. Our trip tour guide Ben made the whole trip run so smoothly. Everything was planned and ready to go we just had to show up. I would definitely use EF for my next trip. We had so much fun exploring and seeing all of the things.

name: Elizabeth Delacy-Almeida
title: Spain and Portugal
text: My daughter's trip was perfectly planned and executed.  We felt that she was safe and well provided for during the 9 day trip.  Very pleased.

name: Zeta Crawford
title: It was great being a part of an…
text: It was great being a part of an organized tour and the sites chose were amazing. Dinner selections for the most part were great. Hotel accommodations were ok and my favorite was the one in Paris but the breakfast selection was very limited.  Breakfast in Brussels was wonderful. Our guide was amazing but it would have been helpful if she had a flag or something so we could easily spot her, especially when we entered very crowded areas. The connection with the other group from Canada did not go so well.

name: Tiffany Scott
title: Great Experience for Students
text: My daughter went on the Spain tour (Barcelona, Madrid, Toledo) with her classmates and other local schools during Spring Break 2025.The EF Tour Guide provided general information to parents during the pre-tour information sessions.  As a result of not providing as much information to parents' inquiries, we found out about other requirements later - and we would've preferred knowing certain information much earlier in the preparation phases (hence why I gave 4 stars).The feedback my daughter provided is that she would go on another EF Tour based on how organized the itineraries were in Spain.

name: Johanna Lawrence
title: Great time in Greece
text: Tour guide was terrific- my daughter had a wonderful visit to Greece.

name: Yvonne Jose
title: Wonderful Tour Experience
text: Thank you for providing excellent customer service. As a parent, I had a so many concerns and questions. The reps are very professional and took the time to assist me with the EF tours app.  My son enjoyed his Adriatic Odyssey Tour to Italy and Greece. EF Tours was very well organized and my son enjoyed his Tour Guide who chaperoned his group and exposed them to various restaurants during his trip. Thank you for this awesome experience. I hope we can use EF tours for one of our family trips to Japan or Spain.

name: Maria Va De Loson
title: I had a great experience with my…
text: I had a great experience with my students. We went to Italy and Spain during the Easter break 2025.We were not happy with some of the hotels. The hotel in Rome was located 20 minutes away from the Historical Rome. That was not the issue, the issue was that the hotel had a few hiccups when it came to the bathrooms and towels services. The shower was malfunctioning and caused an overflow of water to the actual bathroom's floor. Something similar happened in the hotel in Florence, but having the prior experience in Rome, the issue was taken care rather quickly.Overall, As stated before, we had a great experience. I believe that as a first timer taking a big group [39 travelers] abroad, made me become more diligent and thoughtful and not always believe that everything it is so far "perfect" before departing. With the latter, I meant that as a group leader, I will make sure that what I requested, will be granted or not, but at least make sure that I will know clearly that the excursions or places of visiting that we planned ahead of time,  are good to go and not been surprise in situ if any excursion is cancelled.

name: Spanish trip
title: Costa Rica was great, Panama was ok
text: Eric was a great tour guide but the money you spend the food could be a lot better than the rice and beans we had for the first 3 days. The packed full 12 hour days was a lot on the group of kids and maybe one day break in the middle of the trip to relax and enjoy a pool day or beach day would have been great. Over all it was a great experience.

name: Abigail gills
title: My daughter loved it and had a great…
text: My daughter loved it and had a great time! Only complaint was food which I was very surprised with. Maybe a better food option could be offered next time to get authentic Greek food. Otherwise great trip

name: TrumpLost
title: Trip of a lifetime! 100% recommend
text: Slim was amazing! Knowledgeable and funny. Brought us to the best spots and taught us so much. There is no way I would have seen or done what we did on my own. I would 1000% do another tour like this - all we needed to do was show up and keep up. As an adult on a high school trip, I’m confident the teens would have been fine without me, but what a bonus to be able to share this experience with my daughter. A trip of a lifetime! We also met Beth, a new ef guide from Scotland, plus two other guides - and the bus drivers from London. All brilliant and made the experience even better.

name: Nicole Twilley
title: My son had a wonderful time on his trip…
text: My son had a wonderful time on his trip and loved every minute of it! I will recommend amend to my friends and family for EF tours!

name: Kathy
title: Mediterranean Coast Adventure
text: The tour guide and bus driver were amazing! Every day was planned to maximize our activities and tours. The trip was exactly as planned and at an amazing value!

name: Mary Kay Felton
title: Disappointing Trip With Planning Flaws
text: Tour guides were difficult to hear in busy locations. There were no audiovox or other type of headsets to help hear the guides.  The tour seemed to be weighted toward the quantity of sites rather than the quality of the visit at each site.  Not enough time was allocated to adequately visit sites.  Ok for students who just wanted to hang out on a foreign trip with friends, socialize, take a quick look at the sites, and do some souvenir shopping. Disappointing for students who were looking for more of a cultural and historical experience i.e., more time spent in castles, cathedrals, museums, historic and cultural sites, less time in souvenir shops and shop brands that exist in the US.  Hotels should have been chosen more carefully.  One hotel was supposed to be a multi night stay but the rooms and bedding were so dirty the group got relocated to another hotel for the remaining nights (but not until they had to spend one night in the dirty hotel).

name: Wendy Bethoney
title: Spain & Portugal
text: My student reports that the tour guides were great, but there was not enough variation in the types of sites visited.  The biggest compliant was that the food was underwhelming and without much variety. This is disappointing as food is such a large part of a cultural experience. Not having direct flights and having long layovers is something that should be changed. There are multiple carriers with direct flights, so there is no reason for this. Overall, my student had a good time with friends, sharing new experiences, but there is room for improvement.

name: Donna Incorvaia
title: Travel fun …
text: My son had an amazing experience with EF Tours this year. It was organized and planned out fantastically.

name: R M D
title: While EF Tours provided a great…
text: While EF Tours provided a great experience for our child that they would not otherwise had, the trip had a number of pitfalls. EF did little to prepare our child for the trip and a representative was only available for the trip - not before to introduce themselves (Zoom or Teams is always an option). The meals were typically bland, and tours always ended with a tourist hook - hey, buy this as a souvenir. Negative comments aside, the tour packed a lot into a few day, and our child is still talking about the experience.

name: Jon A.
title: My daughter had a wonderful trip
text: My daughter had a wonderful trip! Her guides were terrific, she raved about how much fun she had!

name: Joe
title: Fantastic trip!  Well organized with outstanding guides.
text: This trip was so very well organized.  We were actively engaged with interesting and fun activities all day, every day — but it was never hectic.  Our main guide, Carlos, was fantastic as were our three guides in the Galapagos.  We expected the trip to be amazing but possibly chaotic as we had a large group of travelers.  It was never chaotic, and, somehow, the trip managed to greatly exceed our high expectations.  Great job!

name: JM
title: First Class Educational Travel Experience
text: Overall amazing experience from start to finish! Seamless travel and accommodations. Guides were friendly and supported the learning outcomes. Definitely coming back for more!

name: Mayra Sauceda
title: Great communication
text: I loved how everything was documented and up to date that they kept in touch. Step by step instructions from day 1

name: Ashley
title: Thank you…
