name: CCFinster
title: Where was the supervision?!
text: There absolutely needs to be better supervision of these children.  Illegal activities are not tolerated in the US.   Why were they allowed to happen in South America.

name: Nicholas
title: Great Tour
text: The tour director was great, the sites were great, and the accommodations were good. The food was not the greatest, we would have preferred to go out to other restaurants rather than eating in the hotel. Additionally, knowing the amount of travel between sites/locations ahead of time would helped us prepare our students better. The 20-hour ferry ride was a complete surprise, the length of it was never discussed.

name: Dorothy Everstine
title: My grandson had a great time
text: My grandson had a great time. EF was very helpful with all of my questions and very quick to respond.  I hope the school uses them again.

name: Jorge Laure
title: Amazing experience for my teenagers
text: Both of my  daughters went with EF educational tours to 2 different places. One went to Europe and the other one to Japan and both had an amazing experience.

name: Eliana R.
title: An incredible experience
text: An incredible experience.  Every day was different fun and exciting. I would recommend anyone having the opportunity to coordinate plans with EF tours, you will not be disappointed.  Everything was organized and loved the fact that we got to explore on our own and shop around at different stores. The food and culture in Japan was amazing! A true trip of a lifetime and something  I will remember forever!

name: Happy Traveler
title: Traveled stressed free
text: Traveled stressed free, as all itineraries and payments have been completed ahead of time.

name: Carla Gray
title: Overall great experience
text: Overall great experience. My son didn't enjoy the food and limited choices.

name: Paulina Sargent
title: The human resources were the best, but there is place for improvement for food and hotels!
text: The human resources were the best part of the trip! Our tour guide, Sergio, went above and beyond throughout the entire experience. The local guides were very charismatic and entertaining, and our bus driver, David, was also incredibly friendly. However, the last hotel, Compostela Suites in Madrid, was terrible. It was in poor condition, lacked proper security, and was dirty when we arrived. Two of our meals were awful. The one we had after leaving Zaragoza, when we stopped in the middle of the road, was especially bad. The eggs in the salad were green, there were flies everywhere, and the food was cold. Unlike the other days, we didn’t have alternative lunch options. We were also very disappointed that the tour to Montserrat was cancelled. We had paid for it, and it was something we had looked forward to for two years while planning this trip. Sergio was truly the highlight of the trip!

name: Jordan Ashby
title: Complete Endorsement!!
text: We have worked with EF Tours for some years now and each time we do, it is always a success.  The staff on the front end are so helpful and thorough.  The Tour Guides and local guides that they pair you with when abroad are well versed and accommodating.  Certainly would recommend to anyone who is interested in taking students abroad, no matter the size of your group!

name: Sara Osborne
title: Greek experience
text: The planning, the options, and the experiences were all perfect!  The students were offered so many opportunities to visit historical sites, participate in Greek culture, and enjoy Greek food.

name: Corie Jarin Woods
title: The Ireland and Scotland Experience
text: Our tour guides helped make the experience fun. They were flexible with schedules. The hotels were really good, especially Moxy, Edinburgh. We would’ve liked an extra day in Belfast, Northern Ireland.

name: Stephanie
title: Amazing experience
text: My daughter had an amazing time on her trip! She recently visited Greece for her senior trip. EF tours made everything so easy with making payments, keeping updated on everything also an easy to navigate app. She said her tour guides were fantastic. This was the first time she has ever done anything like this and she said she is now ready to travel and see more of the world!

name: Susan Gackowski
title: EF Tours made this whole experience…
text: EF Tours made this whole experience amazing! Their service is so comprehensive and streamlined, from helping you keep track of payments and reminders of what needs to be done prior to your trip, to providing an exciting itinerary with memorable adventures while traveling! EF Tours made foreign travel so easy and I really trusted my student was in good hands!

name: Lulu
title: You really need to have one twin size…
text: You really need to have one twin size bed per student.

name: Jannia Quintero
title: The tour guide
text: The tour guide we had, kique was really what made the whole experience so special and memorable

name: L.G.
title: Great experience overall
text: Great experience overall.  Our tour director was a huge part in helping to shape this experience.  Had some unexpected changes that were beyond our control is she did the best she could to not let it impact our trip experience too much.  Would recommend to others.

name: Mo
title: Honestly
text: Honestly, it was the most fun I had over a spring break in a really long time! I got to meet new people, try new foods, and explore new places

name: L. Gutierrez
title: The trip was a fantastic experience
text: The trip was a fantastic experience. My child had an amazing time. Only reason not 5 starts is my child had a food allergy that we believe at least on 2 occasions they got sick from the group meals as the proper precautions weren’t taken.

name: Melissa Williamson
title: This trip was excellent
text: This trip was excellent! Our tour guide was mindful of our group making sure the students seen historical sites and landmarks they’ve learned about at school. She also made sure we got to see all the cool local sites when we had free time or with her! She even made sure we got authentic local food and even a meal that wasn’t local but phenomenal! We would take this trip again! The charter bus was clean, the driver was excellent, the lodging was great, and our tour guide was very adept with guiding us and providing us with other excellent and funny tour guides!

name: Maryann Fornabaio
title: It was so memorable
text: It was so memorable. We learned so much. The tour guide was very knowledgeable and kind.

name: Kim Simon
title: Great time but food was not good
text: My daughter had a great time, but she did not like the fact that there was no choice for dinner. She explained that they had bangers and mash just about everynight, and had no other choices to choose from. Maybe in the future, allow there to be two choices for a meal that are traditional to the area they are touring.

name: Nancy B
title: The trip was fun & educational
text: The trip was fun! My grandson went on the trip and was nervous. He did not know any of the other students on the trip. Before the end of the trip, he was having conversations with them and playing card games with them. He made friends, learned a lot about history and had a great time.

name: Courtney
title: Costa Rica DLI Middle School Trip
text: My daughter's recent trip to Costa Rica was amazing! The trip was packed with activities, all presented in Spanish since the students on the tour are all in dual language immersion. They learned so much about the culture, agriculture, and nature in Costa Rica. The only suggestion I have for EF Tours to improve the parent experience is to eliminate the fee charged for unenrolling from the automatic payment plan. It was disappointing to see a fee charged to me when I was simply trying to pay the trip off. That being said, we will use EF Tours again for future trips.

name: Megan Galiczynski
title: My daughter tore her acl right before…
text: My daughter tore her acl right before she was leaving for her Greece trip and the staff at ef tours went above and beyond to help us. They were in constant communication with me regarding accommodations that could be made to assist her while she was away. It was scary for me to send my daughter overseas, but it was even scarier sending her with an injury. And I am upset that I was not told that my "land by 9PM" request was impossible to fill. If I had been told that we would have considered other options.I hate to put so much negativity in a review when most of the trip was excellent. But EF really needs to do something about the way it handles flight arrangements. We were a small group--10 people total. title: I would rated our recent tour to Italy…a three out of five
text: I would rated our recent tour to Italy 3 out of 5 stars.What I appreciated most was the breathtaking scenery and educational depth of the itinerary. The weather was beautiful, and the views—mountains, rolling landscapes, and expansive blue skies—were absolutely picturesque. Each city showcased impressive architecture, rich in detail and historical significance. The remnants of the Etruscan civilization, in particular, were deeply inspiring. It’s unfortunate that the legacy of the Etruscans—as well as the profound influence of other melanated peoples such as the Berbers and the Moors—is often overlooked in mainstream narratives. These civilizations contributed significantly to the cultural, architectural, and scientific foundations of the Mediterranean world. The Moors, for example, preserved and advanced knowledge in mathematics, astronomy, and architecture, much of which later influenced the European Renaissance. Their contributions, along with those of the Etruscans and Berbers, can still be seen in the design, infrastructure, and urban planning of many Italian cities that are now major tourist destinationsIt’s unfortunate that these foundational contributions by melanated civilizations are rarely acknowledged, despite their lasting influence on Italian culture and infrastructure.I must also express my disappointment with the lack of hospitality we encountered. As a group made up predominantly of melanated students, we were often met with dismissive or cold behavior from locals. This left us feeling unwelcome in a country whose rich cultural heritage is, in many ways, built upon the contributions of people who look like us. That contradiction was difficult to ignore and certainly impacted our overall experience.Italy has so much to offer in terms of history and beauty, but true appreciation of its legacy must come with an acknowledgment of all the cultures that helped build it—and a hospitality that reflects that shared heritage.

text: My son went to Peru with his classmates to perform a service learning project in the Vilcabamba region of the Andes mountains. EF Tours created a safe and robust trip experience for the teens, allowing them to experience much more than just the tourist attractions.  Everything - from airfare to meals, from hotels to last minute flight changes - was handled with attention to detail and care.  The trip consisted of many tours and experiences that immersed the kids in the culture of the Peruvians, in ways that were utterly unique and educational.  From experiencing pottery making, to playing soccer in the local park with young Peruvian kids, to salsa dance lessons, the tour guides were fantastic and went out of their way to let the kids LIVE in Peru for a short while.  The experience curated by EF Tours allowed ample time for exploration and reflection, and the teachers were well supported through the entire journey by the administrative staff and the local tour guides.While there were a number of travel issues on the return trip home, EF Tours did the best they could with delayed and cancelled flights, rerouting connections, and trying to get the kids home as safely and quickly as possible.  My one criticism is around the use of American Airlines - when flights had issues, it seemed they only worked with AA.  If they had worked with other airlines to get the kids home, I would have been more impressed. What should have been about 27 hours of travel ended up taking over 50 (yes fifty!) hours.  Some parents secured direct flight for their children from Lima to Newark instead of finishing their trip with their class, but we couldnt afford to do that.  My son flew from Lima to Miami to Chicago to Philly instead, and this meant we had to drive to Philadelphia to get him at 1 am.  While I understand the difficulty of rescheduling 28 people onto other flights, it seems that EF was only working with American Airlines.  I certainly could be wrong, but if direct flights from Lima to Newark were available, we certainly didn't hear about them.All of that said, when I asked my son if he would do it all again, even if he had to endure the horrible return trip the same way, he said "Absolutely - it was STILL worth every second of the horrible return trip. It was the experience of a lifetime and I am so glad I was able to go."

Ideally, the drive from the airport to accommodations should not exceed two hours to ensure students are rested and ready to enjoy their trip.Additionally, the food provided at hotels could be improved in both quality and quantity, especially considering the nutritional needs of active teenagers. More generous portions and a greater variety of fresh, local food would significantly enhance the experience.Lastly, selecting hotels located in towns with access to local restaurants and supermarkets would offer students more flexibility and cultural immersion during their free time.Overall, it was a memorable and educational trip, and with a few adjustments, future experiences could be even better.

title: Pretty good!
text: Overall, my son LOVED his time in Italy with EF. The tour guide was “awesome” and the bus driver was “super fun.” He loved Italy and can’t wait to go back and explore more - he’s VERY glad that he joined this tour. Three stars (he said 3.5 but not an option here) are because of the hotels, food, and flights.Hotels: The hotels were not in great locations, and one was so dirty (trash and unidentified substances) they had to change rooms and STILL had to clean the bathroom themselves - this made him very unsettled and nervous about their arrangements and safety.Food: He also said the food was terrible (unless they were on their own and could fend for themselves) and was disappointed with the quality; he felt it could have been amazing given they were in Italy and food is an important part of experiencing a culture.Flights: Our hometown is not near a major airport, so it’s understandable flights will be tricky. However, on the way there they had an eight hour layover, and on the way back the flight was too late (on time, not delayed) to make the last bus home and the group leaders had to rent cars and drive in the middle of the night (despite having told EF they needed to be back by a certain time to make the bus).One last thing as a parent: Because their group was smaller they were paired with another school group from a different part of the country - awesome idea, friends were made! We knew about this ahead of time and there were no issues. However, upon return, we learned there was an additional small group (sounds like family) that also joined, and were there for “vacation and were drinking and complaining the whole time.” This was NOT told to us ahead of time, and we were not pleased to learn about the behavior on an educational trip with minors.He had an amazing teacher (and her husband) from his school that led this tour, and that made this a five star trip for him! Again he really did have “the best time ever” and without those two to help coordinate and offer guidance (and have fun!) it would not have been as much of a success. As a parent I wanted to leave an honest review to set expectations and help EF learn from his experience.Thanks so much!

text: I spend a lot of time making a profile and loading pictures for a housesit. There were two applicants which then makes me not eligible for a refund. Some don’t live in the state listed, others don’t want local sits or long sits. Some aren’t really available since their calendar’s aren’t up to date. Some are unreliable and don’t follow through since there isn’t any loyalty to the Pet Parent.I’ve also recently realized some sitters are using this site to promote their personal pet sitting business at an expensive rates. (Some are on Facebook.) They’ll use the reviews and background checks from this site to show they are ‘trusted’Lessons Learned: Basic plans are not eligible for a refund. If you get two applicants, you’re not eligible. The site favors sitters over housesits. Don’t believe the auto messages to sit back and wait for applications. Better look and make offers if you want to have a sitter through this site. I’ve had to hire a local person, not on this site, at twice the regular rates and also additional charges for each pet. name: Mrs Murphy
title: CRAZY GOOD PLATFORM
text: We have been house sitters for 7+years and helped approx 70 home owners enjoy their travels, knowing their cats, dogs, sheep, rats, cattle and more are being well looked after.  The site offers multiple opportunities to travel far and wide, it's up to us to secure the sit with confidence that it's a match.  There have been times the match wasn't quite right for example, home cleanliness, home owner attitude or not true reflection of care required, but l have to say it's a crazy good site! You meet some fabulous people who have become friends in our world and we spend time with wonderful animals in amazing lovely places. We don't want to commit to a dog or cat at home, so sharing is fabulous.  We want to travel because being retired and at home can mean job after job and l get bored and want to travel locally and overseas while l can! I love it that we can  help people and feel appreciated. Yes sometimes home owners cancel but as long as the reason is genuine; we had planned to go to Guernsey July 2025, but sadly their elderly labrador had to be put to sleep, so they cancelled and offered to pay for any travel costs we may have incurred... luckily we had not arranged travel yet, but how kind and thoughtful to offer if we had.  We ourselves have been on the verge of cancelling due to a medical diagnosis that required lots of scans, operation and follow up treatment, but thankfully our friends, who sometimes join us on a sit, came to our and the home owners rescue. Either side cancelling can be difficult, l think l would always recommend the home owner has a back up plan, just as we do if our travels across the other side of the world are cancelled. I think it's amazing that we have walked into people's homes, never met them, taken over all they love, shared their home and pets and then left! other times we have spent an evening with good food, wine and great company, having chatted away like we have known each other for years! There are so many stories you could tell, which have enriched our lives and our friends who sometimes join us. It's addictive!!

name: Corinne Matheson
title: My experience was ok
text: My experience was ok, not great, but that had nothing to do with Trusted House Sitters.  The web-site worked for me, and I was given e-mails to remind me when my house sitter was coming.  I had the sitter come a few days early while we were here as we live off grid and have horses, so there is a lot more to learn than just having cats and dogs.  We feel our sitter helped themselves to toilet paper rolls, food and gas (for the generator) since they live in a little car when not house sitting and they said they get food from the Food bank and get money from the Government to pay for things when not sitting.  This person was very charming and talkative and very helpful with writing us instructions to help future sitters using AI to write everything.  So very personable and charming, but I feel we were taken advantage of.

name: customer
title: Terrible Experience – No Support from TrustedHousesitters
text: We had a truly awful experience with TrustedHousesitters. Our sitter cancelled at the last minute right before our 3-week holiday, leaving us scrambling to find alternative arrangements. To make matters worse, the platform offered absolutely no support. Their chat service is unresponsive, there’s no phone number to call, and messages are routinely ignored.After many attempts, I finally got through to someone who promised reimbursement for the emergency pet care we had to arrange. That was over three weeks ago. I was told I’d receive the funds within 7–10 business days — still nothing. Since then, TrustedHousesitters has continued to ignore my messages.Even more frustrating is that the sitter who cancelled on us still has glowing 5-star reviews and continues to get bookings. The platform doesn't allow you to leave a review if the sit was cancelled — effectively silencing honest feedback and misleading future users.I urge anyone considering this service to think again. You're better off booking a reputable pet sitter directly and having peace of mind. I’m now pursuing a small claims case in the UK to recover my money, as this entire experience has felt like a scam.Update 11th May: Provided trustpilot my name and email so that they can pass on my details to trusted housesitters. In the meantime another day with me chasing these people up for my claim has passed. Heard the same thing today that they will chase this up with their claims team tomorrow  😂

We chose a premium membership (with background check and bonding) and we only interviewed people who had been background checked to take out any risk there. The platform takes time to set up the first time - but it's HIGHLY worthwhile to do it correctly and to be thorough - giving FULL information to potential sitters makes a huge difference in their ability to be prepared and in their self selection - last thing you want is someone who ends up being a bad fit last minute. Took us a dozen interviews the first time and a couple of sits to figure out the characteristics we were looking for that made for a successful sit in our case and we got a whole lot better at screening for them but the beauty of the platform, at least for us, is there were so many applicants we could always find what we were looking for. The platform has virtually all the information we could want and that we would want have applicants to have while we are away. We have our own set of info that seems to be a little less "word" and to the point than the basic Welcome Guide but we've learned to make both work well together. text: Consistently, I’ve had a really great experience on the app. All applicants are verified, I like that the app pauses applications after five to ensure you’re not overwhelmed with applicants. It’s easy to review who would be most suitable for your pet or who has the right experience. I’ve even become friends with some of the house sitters. Highly recommend.

name: Annabelle
title: Love this app and how it’s structured…
text: Love this app and how it’s structured for great sitters and pet owners to connect. I love that no money is exchanged between parties, but all parties need to pay a subscription and have relevant background checks to participate. We’ve used this service three times in the last 12 months and couldn’t recommend it enough!

name: Mike f
title: Trustedhouseitters could do more
text: Trustedhousesitters could do more to be honest.Our first sit was a place with single pane windows, with holes in the frames, and, a wasp issue.Granted, it's not their issue, however they should be making checks (perhaps even requested a video walkthrough) of a house.There were no blinds or curtains in any of the bathrooms at all, this caused anxiety.Trusted housesitters left it up to me to sort out, instead of taking the reigns, only offering to let them know if we don't want to sit there, so they could arrange an alternative one.We also have a family member in hospital, however all trusted housesitters did was say we have an obligation to do an agreed sit.It seems that the mid tier membership, doesn't really do anything in terms of support, which is a great shame.We also had a cat that literally took chunks out of us biting, and, scratching. AGAIN, although there was a first aid kit listed in the welcome pack, there was none there... Only a box with some plasters in it.I really feel that more thorough checks are needed, not to mention cover for petsitters (who seem to be an expendable asset), because the only medical cover that exists, is for pets, and, the property petsitters stay in, NOT fire the petsitters.This really needs to change.

name: Jerry
title: Delighted First Trusted Housesitters Experience
text: We just completed our first experience having a dog sitter, and we were glad that it was through Trusted Housesitters. The annual fee was reasonable, especially when you consider how expensive it is to hire a dog sitter for two weeks. The website and app were extremely easy to use. Listing your pet-sitting opportunity reminded me of listing a house - with taking photos of your (cleaned and decluttered) home and describing your pet. And once you receive responses from potential sitters, it was very helpful to be able to read their past reviews before making a selection. It was nice to know that they had all been background checked. The app allows you to communicate with your sitters before and during the stay. All in all, we were very pleased with our experience with Trusted Housesitters!

name: Laura
title: A very successful first experience.
text: This was my first time using Trusted Housesitters as our usual sitters were not available. I found the process very easy & straightforward & I liked how it all worked. We found a lovely sitter & have had a very successful first sit & experience for our sassy cat, Sasha. I’d definitely return if I needed another sit.

name: Starlight Farm
title: what a relief!!
text: We have to travel with our work and living in Switzerland with 4 dogs the thought of having to put them in kennels seems both financially impossible and unkind. We have also relied on friends to come and housesit but this isnt always practical. We stumbled upon trustedhousesitters and havent looked back. Our first sitter was for 3 weeks and she did a lovely job and very reassuring process throughout with the platform.

name: Patricia Rifat
title: We’ve used this service multiple times…
text: We’ve used this service multiple times in the past 2 years, and it has been truly life changing and allowed us to really enjoy our time away. All our sitters were truly amazing, reliable and would not mind having again. The pet care (2 dogs and a seahorse aquarium) has been superb, home minding was exceptional. Highly recommended this organisation.

name: Consumer
title: Great app great website
text: Great app great website, amazing concept. Had amazing experiences with both hosts and pets :))

name: Carrie
title: A Resounding Win for Pet Lovers and Travelers Alike
text: Joining Trusted Housesitters in late 2022 was one of the best decisions we’ve made. At the time, we were searching for dedicated sitters to care for our two senior dogs while we went on two pet-free trips. Thanks to the platform, we connected with exceptional sitters who provided attentive care for our beloved dogs and meticulous oversight of our home.When the time came to renew our membership, life had changed—both of our senior dogs had sadly passed. While we deeply missed the companionship of pets, we weren’t ready to adopt again. Instead, we decided to "flip" our membership, stepping into the role of sitters. Since then, there has been no turning back.Being Trusted Housesitters has been an incredible adventure. Not only do we have the privilege of showering love and care on others’ pets, but we also get to explore amazing locations. To date, we’ve completed 12 housesits and have 7 more lined up this year, including two international sits. Along the way, we’ve added some unique experiences to our repertoire—caring for raccoons, desert tortoises, goats, and koi fish.For anyone who enjoys traveling, Trusted Housesitters is a resounding win. It’s a truly enriching way to connect, care, and explore.

name: Jackie Baker
title: Excellent, our 2nd time
text: This is the 2nd time we have used Trusted House Sitters for our furries.  I can highly recommend them.

name: Polly A
title: Peace of Mind
text: It is always stressful to seek out strangers to watch fur babies and your home. Goes against every "stranger danger" rule we grew up with!!We love the fact that everyone on THS is background checked and we can interview people via zoom to find the best fit.  We have loved every one of our sitters. More importantly, so has our dog.Our level of membership (which covers kennel fees if a sitter cancels) gives peace of mind too. We also love the fact that our fur baby stays at home in a routine he knows.

name: jacquie heathcote
title: Lucky us ! Another lovely sitter!
text: Another excellent sitter experience which is a great relief. To know that your home and pet are safe in the hands of an honest and competent person makes it so much easier to go away. We are feeling very confident about TH and will continue to use the service and tell all our friends about it. One comment I would make is that it is not easy to tell TH that you have been recommended by a friend when you apply. I did get retrospective  recognition when my daughter joined up for this latest holiday...thank you! However another friend recently joined on my express recommendation and she said there was no way to get this recorded when she applied....Maybe this could be looked at?

name: Sara
title: Game changing pet care
text: We've had a couple of really excellent pet/ house sitters, thanks to Trusted Housesitters. There's no way we would go back to boarding our dog now. This way is great for us, and hopefully for the sitters too! It is so reassuring to know that not only are the pets well cared for, fed, walked...but also that someone is in the house while we're away. We won't hesitate to use this service in the future and recommend it to others.

name: Heather Stewart
title: Reassurance with one's choice
text: I have found that everyone we have has pet sit for us have gone above and beyond expectations. It's been so reassuring that the people coming into one's home are trustworthy and kind.

name: Tina
title: Happy Travelers!
text: This app makes it so easy to find sitters. I love that you interview prior to the sit and that some sitters are willing to come a day early to acclimate the transition, not only for them, but also for the pets. The guides that you fill out fir the site are thorough and helpful to the sitters. This was our first time using this app, but I will definitely be using it in future travels.

name: Joni
title: Trusted Housesitters has been a life changer for us!
text: Trusted Housesitters has been a life changing experience for us!  We're both retired and our pooch is the center of our lives.  Paying a pet sitter has been SO expensive and prohibitive for us to travel for more than a few days at a time.  Friends of ours used THI a few times and told us of their incredibly positive experiences.  We decided to give it a try, first time for 5 days then we took another 3 week trip.  Both sitters were amazing!!   What a wonderful concept!

name: Leore Ben-Chorin
title: Life Changing Company
text: I have been using THS for almost a year and it has completely changed my life. I am now a global pet sitter for a very low yearly fee. Travelling in hotels and Airbnbs is a thing of the past now! I highly recommend this app for entrepreneurial, easy-going, pet-loving individuals!

name: Emma Sparkles
title: I got 1 great weekend sit and plenty of sitter ghosting for £190!
text: One star for the very lovely pair that came to sit my dogs.NO STARS for the set up. The sitters are not to be trusted, they are only vetted by previous clients. They are soooo unreliable. It is a big deal to leave your home and pets with strangers. Even if you've managed to chat with them first. I was naiive to think this would work and paid alot of money for the privilege!This site is definitely aimed at the sitters getting a free holiday in your much loved home.If you sign up and question ANYTHING, take up the 14 day money back guarantee.

name: Trish
title: I have now used Trusted House sitters…
text: I have now used Trusted House sitters twice and both times been so impressed at how seamless the experience is. The benefit of having a company in place  as back up for both hosts and sitters is fantastic. Reviewing also keeps everyone on their toes and makes sure everyone is doing what is required. It is very hard to choose the sitter as they are all so qualified and fantastic so it can be quite a process. The quality of this site and app is also very easy to navigate, and I am not particularly technologically minded so the benchmark is quite low. Its easy and efficient as well as logical with great updates and notifications as you go.

name: Lisa Barrell
title: TrustedHousesitters is a genius service and wonderful asset to any pet owner.
text: I joined Trusted Housesitters fairly recently with a view to having a sitter for a two weeks over Easter.The process of registration and creating a profile were very thorough but easy to do and within minutes of my sit going live, I had 5 offers from sitters.Going through the profiles was easy as was the selection of a sitter, who has just completed the sit this week.Normally I would not be comfortable with having a stranger in my home for so long especially with a very young kitten, but the sitter had wonderful reviews and a strong profile so I felt perfectly comfortable about using her. The opportunity to interview prospective sitters before selecting was appreciated though in the end, we went with the first sitter to respond.As the first sit went very well, I am very happy with the whole process and think TrustedHousesitters is a genius service and wonderful asset to any pet owner.I would highly recommend TrustedHousesitters to anyone considering it.

name: Frances Hopcraft
title: We just completed our first house sit…
text: We just completed our first house sit in the stunning region of Umbria in Italy looking after a big sweet dog and 2 kittens. We had a pool and sauna and stunning views of medieval hilltop villages. Our hosts were easy to communicate with while they were away to make sure we the dogs needs were met. Excellent experience

name: JoAnne Brooks
title: This website works!
text: This website works!I did a house/pet sit in the village my great grandparents were married in 1853!!All possible because of the website.It all worked beautifully and I am thankful to have joined.Sign up today for your adventure!!

name: Christina Cino
title: First international sit completed!
text: I’ve been a member of TrustedHousesitters for over two years and truly love the concept behind this service. It’s an amazing platform that creates mutually beneficial opportunities for pet lovers and homeowners alike. I’ve promoted it widely to friends and family because I believe in what it offers.That said, it’s been a bit of a challenge for someone like me, who doesn’t have a completely flexible schedule. Coordinating dates, travel, and logistics for sits—especially internationally—takes time and careful planning. I’ve found that many homeowners are hesitant to accept applications from sitters who aren’t local, which makes it difficult to book sits outside of my region. While I’ve applied to several international sits, I’ve received only a few responses and just one acceptance.That one acceptance, however, was a wonderful experience. I was thrilled to finally complete an international sit in the UK this year. The homeowner took a chance on me despite not being able to meet in person beforehand, and everything went beautifully.So while I still love TrustedHousesitters and appreciate what it offers, I haven’t been able to benefit from it as often as I’d hoped, which sometimes makes me question whether I should continue the membership. Still, I remain hopeful that with time and persistence, more doors will open.

name: Lilian Maclennan
title: Our home and pets were host to really…
text: Our home and pets were host to really wonderful first time sitters. They really did their homework and made sure our pets were looked after  in the best way. We got regular updates and pictures and arrived home to a warm welcome and happy pets.It is such a comfort to know that everything is left in such responsible and capable caring hands. Trusted Housesitters are the perfect solution for us.

name: Virginia Sainz-Rasines
title: A perfect experience – highly recommended
text: For me, this kind of arrangement is ideal. It allows me to enjoy super comfortable accommodation with everything I need, plus the company of pets – which are essential in my life. Taking care of them adds a special meaning to my journey and makes it so much warmer and more fulfilling.On a practical level, the value is amazing. What you’d normally spend on just a couple of nights in a hotel can give you a whole year of accommodation in places you dream of visiting. I highly recommend it – it’s a beautiful, affordable, and enriching way to travel.

name: customer
title: Not So Trusted Housesitters
text: Trusted Housesitters has been quite a disappointing experience. As a first time member, I naturally found myself in uncharted waters. I needed guidance, but most importantly I needed someone to talk to. There has been no one. For all their advertising and accreditation, I have found them quite lacking. I cannot believe that a global entity with such reach, their customer service is non existent, their app is really confusing and hard to navigate with a lot of duplication of questions you are expected to answer. Their bot is only programmed to answer scripted questions which makes the experience of finding a suitable sitter very stressful, especially when you have already booked your holiday with the expectation that finding a sitter will be a mere formality. Not so in my experience. My suggestion would be a very thorough upgrade of the app and a customer service centre with a live phone number manned by humans. As things stand, I would very much shy away from recommending them as a rock solid service and I am rethinking my renewal with them.

name: Customer
title: Love being a sitter 💕
text: I’ve been using TrustedHousesitters as a sitter for a year and a half now, and I’ve had nothing but good experiences with them. The app is super easy to use, and all the people and animals I’ve met through sitting have been fantastic. I’ve never had a negative experience with any pets or home owners, so can’t speak to that!

name: Morgan Leigh
title: I've been using the app for a year now…
text: I've been using the app for a year now and it's allowed me to be comfortable to leave my three dogs and know they are safe and happy whenever I travel! I've had nothing but positive experiences using the app and have met some amazing and lovely people along the way! I'd highly recommend it for anyone who likes to travel but is holding back due to being a pet owner!

name: Laura Reilly
title: A great way to travel and see new places
text: I have been housesitting on Trusted Housesitters for almost two years now and it's been a great experience. I've been able to travel around my home country and internationally and stay in beautiful homes. I've met some lovely families and pets and can't recommend it enough!

name: Pat Pratley
title: Great Experience Wlused three pet/house sitters…
text: We have used three pet/house sitters and have been delighted with each of these experiences. The notion of letting strangers into our home would normally be anathema. However we have felt really comfortable with Trusted Housesitters guarantee. Nice people, interesting stories. And each time we have found our sitters to be delightful and we have loved their reason for taking on the challenge/ potential disappointment of an unknown destination.Thank you House sitters for enabling this mutually beneficial arrangement.

name: Kappa
title: Sadly I am leaving this community after…
text: Sadly I am leaving this community after seven years due to the following reasons :1: it's a constant hit and miss (our last sitters from Barcelona Judith and Marc were a tragic miss)2: membership fees have skyrocketed3: there is no real benefit to being a long time member as customer service does not differentiate between active members and newbies4: the general quality of the sitters is very random - - few  actually care to petsit. Many are just looking for free lodging.5: the good ol' days when it was a positive and supportive tight knit community are over. 👋 (I used to give 5 stars! See my first review)Glad to have stayed in touch with the best, only two, but definitely top notch.Note : the Barcelona sitters were the last straw for us as it seems harder than ever to discern between those who are honest petsitters and those who will tell you what you want to hear just so they can use your house to set up a travel office.  They manipulate to get the sit and then accuse you of mistreating them when you call them on their game. These people should not be petsitters!Time to check out their competitors!

name: Vin
title: A reliable place to find a pet sitter
text: Trusted House Sitters is a reliable site and we have been happy with all our sitters. Not only do they take care of the background checks and vet their applicants, the site is easy to navigate and communication between sitters and hosts is clear and straightforward. They offer a valuable place to find reliable caregivers for our most beloved family members.

name: Toni Turiak Nance
title: Quality pet care in your own home!
text: When I first heard about Trusted Housesitters, my initial thought was it sounded too good to be true. I was somewhat apprehensive about having someone I did not know in my home taking care of my four-legged family member. However, any doubts I had initially have totally been expelled! Our first sit, for a seven-night stay, has taken place and it could not have been a better experience for us and our pet! Our sitter was dependable, took great care of our dog, and left my house spotless.

name: Don
title: Highly recommended!
text: Trusted House Sitters was easy to set up, easy to use and gave us a number of great candidates for our first sit.  The couple we chose were excellent.  I highly recommend the site to everyone looking for great house sitting while away.

name: Alan Zube
title: THS has made retirement fun!
text: We have taking advantage of THS to travel around the UK and USA. The process is simple. Well worth the money you save in lodging, but the biggest perk for us is being around and caring for the pets. Being retired, we want to travel as much as possible, so having our own pet would be logistically difficult. With THS we can travel and grandparent pets all over the world.

name: Elizabeth
title: We have had lovely sitters who have…
text: We have had lovely sitters who have kept in touch with us  letting us know how our pet was whilst we were away which is so reassuring. Came back to a happy pet and clean house. we would not go away without a sitter as our pet is old so it gives us freedom.

name: Shelby G
title: Doesn't Feel Worth It
text: I completely regret paying for a membership. First of all, that expensivse, upfront cost is just for one year! Second, majority of sits seem to be out in the country, where public transport isn't accessible - so you need a rental car. You must need to book months in advance for any summer sits because there are 1 or 0 in all of the countries I've looked at in Europe and Latin America, and it's just April now. I won't get into some of the problems or expectations of homeowners and their pets (some are fantastic, but many make you wonder why they don't seek out a professional service). Please read the Reddit thread for this website before buying and you might change your mind.

name: Elizabeth
title: Convenient and Fun New Experiences!
text: I originally joined Trusted Housesitters for traveling, but this year I have been traveling for work every month and this síte has been wonderful! I get a place to stay, have furry friends, and meet great people! I love it!

name: J Lock

name: J.F.

We have now had 3 sits and they have all been exceptionally good. Being able to traval knowing your pets are in good hands, and avoid expensive shelter solutions, is a win-win!

name: Frank Mitchell

We were led by them through every stage of the process and the wonderful people who looked after our house and our pets whilst we were away were just incredible. We were genuinely sad to see them go at the end of the sit and felt like we had made two new friends. I would highly recommend the service, it could not have been better.

name: Lisa Hurley

We have felt comfortable and recommend Trusted House Sitters highly to anyone looking at how to looking after their pets and property.

name: Kiwis Fly the Coop NZ
title: THS website and App is the best tool for house sitting
text: We have been with THS for quite a few years and have used them for our HS all around the world.  I love the prompts that come through, which reminds me to request info, check the dates, and write reviews.  This also prompts the pet owners to do the same.  Communication is key, and we find that all the tools THS have in place assists with this.

name: André Thérien
title: Cleanliness of the place
text: Cleanliness of the place. Healthy animals. Intelligent and careful oewners

name: Lenore McDonald Gunst
title: So far so good!
text: So far so good!  We have had very satisfactory experience with Trusted Housesitters and frequently recommend the service to family, friends and acquaintances we make while we travel.  We travel for 3-4 weeks at a time, 2-3 times a year.  Trusted Housesitters have been reliable, friendly and loving with our dogs, and also are interesting people!  It took an effort to initially list our home and write up our pet info. Our sitters love the detailed instructions, photos and info about everything from appliances to local restaurants in our house manual.  Our friends are surprised that no money is exchanged. That's where the "Trusted" comes in - the network provides members a means to confidently find a match for a mutual interest and need, and it works beautifully.  Sure, some sitters outshine others; but overall everyone we've selected has met our expectations and fulfilled their responsibilities responsibly and enthusiastically.  We are fans since joining in 2022.

name: Dorinda Lugo
title: Such a horrible experience
text: Such a horrible experience. Kay, my sitter, never read my welcome guide as evidenced by the fact that she never followed any of my instructions, she smoked marijuana inside and outside of my house, she never changed the litter box, she parked in the driveway when I told her not to, etc. But worse of all, two days into my international trip, she purposely let my cat outside stating to a neighbor that one of my cats was “not happy and so she let it out side” even after I told her several times different ways that both my cats were indoor cats only. (if my cat was not happy it was because I was not home and Kay was there as I’m sure my cat did not like K because she had bad vibes. So much for her supposedly good reviews as I’m sure they were all lies.) My cat has not returned, and I am absolutely livid.To add more fuel to the fire Trustedhousesitters has not taken any responsibility whatsoever in getting her off the roster or firing her. They didn’t want to do anything because I canceled the contract since I wanted her out of my house within the first week of the two weeks I was out of town after she let my cat escape.What company would keep an employee on when they have violated specific instructions from the homeowner, lost an animal that the sitter was supposed to be responsible for and continue to keep the employee on to risk another horrible situation for another homeowner? If I could provide less than one star, I would because this is a horrible company, and Kay was a horrible sitter as well as a horrible person as she never even apologized nor took responsibility for her actions or lack of. Never again. I hope you all get what you deserve. Trustedhousesitters is not to be trusted as they don’t vet their own sitters.

name: Dean
title: Loving TrustedHousesitters
text: Loving TrustedHousesitters! We’ve just had our fourth set of sitters and have had a great experience every time. The process of sorting out your first sitters and knowing what info to share and ask for takes some time and energy, but it’s so worth it!

name: Bridgette
title: In Trusted HouseSitters, we Trust!

We recommend THS to everyone!

Our housesitters were awesome and we came home to a very wiggly, very happy pup.  Thank you for this service - we have another booked for summer!

name: Thayana Cabral
title: I absolutely love the TrustHousesitters…
text: I absolutely love the TrustHousesitters platform! It’s such a brilliant idea that connects travelers with pets, allowing pet lovers and travel enthusiasts to create meaningful connections all around the world.The platform is incredibly easy to use and offers great value for the return it provides. It’s a fantastic way for people who love pets and travel to explore new places while taking care of wonderful animals.I had great times and sitters in a year using the platform and I highly recommend TrustHousesitters to anyone who is planning to travel and loves pets. It’s a wonderful way to have enriching experiences, meet new animals, and save on accommodation while making lifelong memories!

name: Miriam Wood
title: Trusted Housesitters is extremely professional
text: We love Trusted Housesitters. name: Chelsea Arganbright
title: Finally Standing in My Power After a Decade with Trusted Housesitters
text: I’ve been with Trusted Housesitters for over a decade, completing 20 sits across multiple countries since 2014. My experiences were even featured in the Daily Mail, so I feel confident sharing this: it’s time for a reality check on how the platform values its sitters.We pay a membership fee to offer unpaid labour. That alone raises ethical questions. Many of us aren’t on extended holidays - we’re caring for animals with complex needs, often in unfamiliar environments, having paid for our own travel. The assumption that we’re just “lucky” to stay in someone’s home misses the mark. When the experience involves aggressive dogs, feral cats, filthy homes, or restrictions like not being able to leave the dog alone for more than an hour a day, it’s not a holiday. It’s work - and often, emotionally and physically draining work at that.I’ve been misled or placed in difficult situations more times than I can count:•	Owners downplaying or hiding serious behavioural issues (e.g., aggression toward other dogs, misbehaviour on the lead, refusal to listen).•	Being in a state of hypervigilance on walks for up to two weeks due to aggressive pets.•	One owner not disclosing that their dog was partially paralysed, meaning I could only walk him for 20 minutes instead of the promised two hours.•	Cleaning up regular bowel accidents and being expected to bathe and groom the dog each time - none of which was mentioned beforehand.•	Being placed in filthy homes with poor hygiene standards.•	Living with practically feral cats who would jump in my face and in the food while I ate, literally being allowed to put their paws in the food by the owners.•	Being expected to sleep on an uncomfortable couch rather than a proper bed.•	Restrictions like not leaving the pet alone for more than one hour a day, making it impossible to enjoy the location or rest.Many sitters still tolerate this dynamic because of the allure of travel. But after 10 years of doing this properly - multiple walks, stimulation, affection, outings, and responsibility - I’ve come to a clear conclusion: sitters should be paid.There may be students or retirees happy to do it for free. But quality, experienced, reliable pet care should not come without compensation. We offer enormous value, and it’s time Trusted Housesitters acknowledges that - not just with a badge or a review, but with fair treatment, transparency, and ideally, payment options.This review isn’t bitter - it’s empowered. I now stand in my worth, and I hope other sitters do, too.

text: You ask what the company is doing well and link it to the experience of pet sitting as if the review of the latter refers to the company. I have submitted several issues to THS without any satisfactory response. For this I would rate THS as perhaps a 2 to 3 star. Example - suggested that you make the Welcome Guide mandatory for a sit to proceed as many pet owners seem unwilling to put up a comprehensive guide (or one at all), on the net, and it makes it very hard for a sitter in terms of issues such as emergency contact, Vet etc.Secondly, for Past Sits, I am shown as having been to places never visited and looking after pets that I have never met or cared for - seemingly due to the fact that when a pet owner changes address my sits are now shown as having been at their new address with their (at times) new pets? name: David Pérez
title: TrustedHousesitters: A "Tamper-Proof" Policy That Only Applies When Convenient
text: Thinking about joining TrustedHousesitters? Be warned. Here, the rules only apply when it suits the company.I received a review that blatantly violates their own policies, including the Acceptable Use Policy, Code of Conduct, and Terms of Service. According to their own guidelines, reviews must be:✔ Fair✔ Fact-based✔ Non-defamatory✔ AccurateYet, when I reported these violations with clear evidence, the company's response was simply:"Reviews are 100% tamper-proof. We do not accept review disputes."Let’s break this down:1️⃣ "Tamper-proof" only means that users cannot edit or modify reviews after posting them.2️⃣ It does NOT mean TrustedHousesitters cannot remove reviews that violate their own policies.3️⃣ Their own terms explicitly state that they can and should remove reviews that contain false, misleading, or defamatory content.So why haven’t they acted?Simple: because ignoring the issue and copy-pasting automated responses is easier than actually enforcing their own rules.The “We Do Not Accept Review Disputes” Excuse is Completely FalseNow, TrustedHousesitters is hiding behind another excuse:"We do not accept review disputes."Here’s the problem:🔹 I never disputed the review with the other person.🔹 I never asked for a revision or negotiation.🔹 I simply requested that the company enforce its own policies.This is not a case of a disagreement between two members. It’s a case of enforcing platform rules, which they are refusing to do. Instead of handling this properly, they are pretending the issue doesn’t exist.A Company That Never Admits Its MistakesThe truth is, they prioritize their image over fairness.They refuse to correct injustices and, worst of all, they provide no legal alternatives or formal complaint mechanisms.Warning to Future MembersIf you ever receive a false or unfair review that violates TrustedHousesitters' policies, DO NOT expect help.The company will not review your case fairly, will ignore you, and will hide behind meaningless excuses to avoid taking action.If this is how they treat their paying members, what does that say about their true priorities?Think twice before trusting this platform.

name: Kristine Malnaca
title: Here's a review based on our feedback
text: Here's a review based on our feedback**TrustedHousesitters: A Lifeline for Pet Owners, But With Caveats**TrustedHousesitters has been a fantastic resource for finding affordable and caring pet sitters in Dublin. The platform's premise of connecting pet owners with individuals willing to exchange house-sitting for accommodation is brilliant, especially in a city with notoriously high hotel prices.  We've had some truly excellent experiences with responsible sitters who prioritized our pets' well-being above all else.  The peace of mind knowing our furry friends are in good hands while we're away is invaluable.However, there's a growing trend that needs addressing.  We've encountered a few sitters who seem more interested in a cheap overnight stay in a comfortable home than genuine pet care.  Requests for favors unrelated to pet or house sitting, and an overall lack of focus on our animals, have left us feeling uneasy. While the platform offers a cost-effective alternative to traditional pet care, it's crucial to remember the primary focus should be on the animals and the home, not a budget-friendly vacation.Despite these occasional hiccups, the platform's price point and the availability of genuinely caring sitters make it a worthwhile option for pet owners. text: If I Could a Give Vayama ZERO Stars .... like many of you, my Int’l flights were Ultimately cancelled by the airline because of Covid. Luckily, I purchased the tickets on a credit Card and contested it with the bank.  Vayama lied to the bank as well, saying that it was MY DUTY to contact the airline.My advice to you, 1). Don’t be tempted next time to buy through an outside of the USA virtual travel agency, just to save +/- $100,  2).  If you do, make sure you keep a transaction contact log including conversations, dates, times, and names.  3).  For your protection, and to retain your dispute rights, ALWAYS use a credit card, NEVER a debit card.    4).  Keep copies of all emails, save copies of screen shots.  Vayama underhandedly disabled the “send copy of email to myself” feature from their website, so unless you save a screen shot, you have no record and they will NEVER respond.In short, buy the ticket directly from the airline, or from a more reliable travel agent that is based here in the USA and who will actually answer the phone when you get stranded someplace, or if you need follow-up with your booking.

Call it 7 weeks total.Update 4: July 7 I called Visa to dispute charge but was told after 60 days not possible as I bought ticket in Nov. 2019. End of story? We'll see. text: On April 5th, 2020, I received an email from Vayama notifying me that Aeroflot had cancelled my r/t flight from Los Angeles to Moscow. Since this was an involuntary cancellation and Aeroflot had suspended all flights from LAX, I was due a refund. Vayama instructed me to do nothing and not to contact them as they would be the ones initiating the refund request. However, 1 month later, I still had not received my refund so I sent Vayama an email asking why. Immediately, I received the same impersonal automated reply telling me to do nothing and that it may be weeks before I received a refund. The Department of Transportation rules for all airlines flying in or out of the United States in regards to tickets purchased by credit card, is very clear and that all travel agencies or airline ticket agents must refund the full amount of the ticket price, including any associated add-on fees within 7 days. Since the COVID-19 Pandemic, the DOP has publicly further clarified that those rules are still in effect and that neither the airline nor the travel agent may modify this. I spoke with Aeroflot's main office in Moscow who told me that Vayama must initiate the refund request since my purchase was done through Vayama. They also gave me a direct contact to an Aeroflot rep in Los Angeles who told me they have no record of Vayama ever initiating that refund request. Therefore she was unable to process my refund and could only offer me a travel certificate good for future travel on Aeroflot which I declined. She encouraged me to contact Vayama again to request my refund. The Aeroflot rep also told me that is a very simple process on the part of Vayama and that it only takes a few seconds to make the request. To date, I have not received a response from Vayama nor has my credit card been debited with the refund. Due to the circumstances arising from the pandemic, I have been patient and understanding but 6 weeks and counting is a lot more than 1 week. I am very disappointed at Vayama's lack of service to me especially since I even purchased their optional "service" package.

title: No Customer Service When Anything Goes Wrong
text: I've been booking travel for my family for over ten years and used dozens of online travel agencies as well as booked directly with airlines. Budgetair is one of those companies where if you buy from them, you should expect absolutely zero customer service if anything goes wrong. If nothing goes wrong and you fly your original itinerary exactly as booked, you'll be just fine and might save some money. But as soon as something happens, even if it is out of your control like an airline schedule change, you will be completely left alone with no means to reach them, and in my case without a ticket even after paying them the full amount of the ticket. In my case, I booked a roundtrip and the airline changed the schedule of my return flight. Budgetair could not issue me a new ticket with the new itinerary for well over two weeks. While I was on my vacation, I had to use the silly online chat (they do not have a phone number) to contact them every day. The chat agents sounded like robots every time and would simply repeat the same thing over and over, telling me to keep waiting and be patient. When it was getting closer to my departure date, I got impatient and started asking them exactly when I can hear any update, they replied "in under 24 hours" a total of three times, but I never heard back any of these times. It is very weird to me how the chat agents cannot do anything and just keep saying they have "sent the request to the relevant team" but they cannot tell me what the problem was or why they were unable to issue the ticket. When asked how much longer I needed to wait (this was probably the 20th time I contacted them for this issue), one of the agents even said that the "team cannot provide a timeline" when it was 72 hours from my scheduled departure. Ridiculous. In the end I got in touch with the airline myself and begged the airline representative to take over the booking so that they can reissue my ticket without going through Budgetair's non-existent "team". Had I not contacted the airline, I would still not have a ticket on the day of my departure and would practically lose over 1000 dollars worth of a ticket and then need to buy a new ticket. I'm very sick of this company now and would probably never use them again. When you book with them you take a risk. If everything goes as planned you'll be fine. But if anything starts going wrong even when it's not your fault, their awful customer service means that you'll be left to your own devices to figure out how to get to your destination.

name: A Hewmun
title: RV Share is an absolute nightmare of a…
text: RV Share is an absolute nightmare of a company—stay far away! I booked an RV on March 4th for a family trip, shelling out a ridiculous $1,600 for just 4 nights. I told them exactly where I was going, spent over a month studying the area and the RV, and made campground reservations to ensure everything was perfect. My family—kids included—was buzzing with excitement for what was supposed to be an unforgettable getaway.Then, on April 8th—ONE DAY before I was set to pick up the RV on April 9th—I got a notification that flipped my world upside down: the RV I booked and paid for over 30 days ago was canceled. No warning, no reason, just a gut punch out of nowhere. I was in the middle of packing when it hit, and I couldn’t believe it. The day before pickup? Are you kidding me?It gets worse. RV Share didn’t even have the decency to apologize. No “sorry,” no discount on another RV, no help finding an alternative—nothing. Just a smug, heartless “Screw you, too bad” vibe that left me stranded. I scrambled to contact them, but their customer service was a black hole: no answers, no support, just silence. They took my money and ran, leaving me with a canceled trip and a family to disappoint.The emotional toll was brutal. My kids were crushed—they’d been counting down the days, and I had to look them in the eyes and explain why we weren’t going. All that planning, all that excitement—wasted. It’s not just upsetting; it’s infuriating. RV Share didn’t care one bit about screwing us over.And here’s the real warning: this isn’t a fluke—it’s how they operate. Dig around online, and you’ll see this is common practice for RV Share. They lure you in with promises of a great trip, take your hard-earned cash, and then cancel at the last second with zero remorse. It’s predatory, plain and simple. People need to know what they’re signing up for with this sham of a company.Do NOT book with RV Share. Save your money, your time, and your sanity. Go with a business that doesn’t treat customers like disposable trash. RV Share is a scam—they don’t deserve a single star, let alone your trust. Avoid them like the plague.

text: This is a very fraudulent company. If anyone is seeking to rent an RV, do not go thru the process of renting from RVshare. This company breaks its own rules to make money. I rented a camper in OK in Sept 2024 for 4 days. First of all when I went to pick up this camper, the owner never showed up to do the out paperwork to go over any damage before I rented it. Camper was stored at a public storage facility. I had to call him to find out about how to get in the camper. I checked the lights before pulling it away and the entire right side lights didn't work. No brake lights , no turn signal. I drove it away anyway because I already paid for it and there was no time to find another one. I returned the camper on the return day 4 days later and still the owner was not there to receive the camper so no in paper work was completed like he was supposed to do per rvshare rules. 3 days later I received an email from rvshare stating that owner found nothing wrong with the camper and was releasing my security deposit of $500 back to me and that this transaction was completed. A couple of weeks later I receive an email from rvshare that the owner filed a claim for damages and I was asked by rvshare what kind of damage there was. I didn't know of any damage. The only thing was that my wife found a piece of plastic molding on the floor when we picked it up. That was it. On Oct 10th I received an email from rvshare that they were charging my credit card $398 for damages. I looked at my credit card account and there was a pending charge for that amount. I immediately called a Claims adjuster for rvshare and she explained that was for some sort of damages when i had the camper. I had to pay for insurance when I rented the camper. Company policy. She never did tell me what the $398 was for and I never did revieve any claims paperwork showing what I was paying $398 for. I told her that I was cleared by the owner on Sept 5th and my security deposit was returned. She told me that there could be more charges later. I asked for what and she couldn't tell me. Later that afternoon I received an email from her saying this account has been closed. I called my credit card company and had my card locked and closed in case anymore fraudulent transactions occurred. I will never ever deal with this company again.

text: Disgusting, AVOID at all costs as a renter. The RV we rented was run down, taped and zip-tied together, the owner wasn't present and provided old zoomed out photos to RV Share, within minutes of being on the freeway after collection the awning dangerously swung off, we pulled over to find it had only been propped on with one rusted threadless screw, had a number of holes where it had been reattached previously. We spoke to the owner immediately on the platform who was disinterested and told us to just 'screw it back on'. Upon return, we were later charged our entire deposit plus another $600 that they just took from my card without informing me. We sent time stamped photos as they requested, gave the full description of what happened showing all of the issues that the owner didn't disclose (with location and time stamps from collection) as well as the evidence of what had happened when we set off showing all of the holes where it had been screwed back on again previously. They didn't even look at any of it, they will take your money without informing you. Their 'customer service' is non-existaent and Kyla is one of the rudest people I have ever encountered. They did not send a breakdown of what was being claimed for, they did not send any documentation of any of it and just took money from my card. STAY AWAY FROM THIS SCAM AGENCY.

title: FRAUDULENT PRACTICES
text: DO NOT RENT FROM RV SHARE. We were VERY mislead by the RVshare listing that we rented. The tires that were on the back of the RV, were not only BALD - two of them completely blew (and I mean SHREDDED) 1 hour into our trip. We were left on the side of the highway (US 16 - which is a minimum MPH of 70 with tractor trailers blowing by every 2-3 minutes), from 10:45 p.m. until 5:45 the next morning. WE had to pay out of pocket, $1600 to have the two tires replaced that should have been replaced prior to our trip, and have not been reimbursed by either the owner or RV Share. Not only was our safety completely jeopardized, but we were not able to get ahold of the "24/7" roadside assistance that RV share claims to have. After calling the number on their website, 6 times, waiting on a hold tone line for 30 minutes EACH and every time, the call would end and hang up on us. THIS IS FALSE ADVERTISEMENT AND FRAUDULENT. They left PAYING customers in an extremely dangerous and potentially fatal situation, and they have STILL not made this right. We spent $1560 on the RV, plus $1600 on the two tires that should have been replaced PRIOR to our trip. We lost an entire day spent sitting along the side of a dangerous highway, while waiting for someone to come and fix our tire.Also, this RV was overall a complete disappointment. The advertisement claims it sleeps 8, however the owners screwed in the table settee that is supposed to fold down into a bed, (and FAILED TO LET US KNOW prior) rendering that space completely useless. This is false advertisement. On TOP of that, the entire side bump out motor (that had "two" sleeping areas) did not even function. We had to manually push the entire slider out, so that our space was usable for sleep. It took all members of our group, to open the slider, and all of us to close the slider from the outside in on our final day. The bathrooms were dirty and looked like they had not been cleaned in years - dust and dirt and general grime. The master bathroom overhead window/vent was completely falling apart and unable to be closed, letting in bugs constantly. The doors on the master bedroom didn't even close, because they were off the rails. Not only has RV Share not provided us with a reimbursement for the money and fees that we paid for out of pocket, they don't respond to emails, they provide you with a claims specialist that does not help either and says that they are surprised that someone from their team has not yet reached out, and then goes MIA. RV Share is a complete waste of your time. You are going to be sadly mislead on any RV that you rent. This is our second time, and LAST time renting from RVShare, as BOTH experiences were completely misleading and there is no quality assurance on the RVs they are comfortable and COMPLIANT renting to paying customer.

text: We rented an RV and faced numerous issues, yet were unfairly charged $1,387 for damages we did not cause even after paying $347 in insurance.Booking & Pickup: On April 15, 2024, we contacted Nedra Woods, the RV owner, to rent the RV for 3 days. We negotiated early pickup and late drop-off for $100 each, and finalized the booking on April 19. On May 1, the owner informed us that the RV had a damaged door that couldn't be fixed in time. The door could NOT be closed from the INSIDE. She offered a $200 discount, which we accepted due to our travel plans with friends. Pics attached.Condition of RV: Upon pickup, the RV was dirty and had several damages. We documented the dirt in the bedroom and on the couch, and the exterior damages. At the campground, we found the awning inoperable due to duct tape. Despite owner's assurance that the awning was functional (!), the tape prevented it from moving and removing the tape revealed the broken frame, making it unsafe in the wind. We never left it unattended or open overnight contrary to the baseless claims from the owner. Pics attached.Safety Hazards: The rear left luggage compartment couldn't be locked and opened while we were on the road, requiring us to tape it shut. The exterior light and some power sockets were non-functional, leaving us reliant on the awning's LED lights. Pics attached.Incident with Rear Window: While parked, my sister tried to open the rear window, which immediately shattered without force. We cleaned the area and taped the shades to secure the RV, storing the window frames in a luggage compartment. Pics and video attached show that it couldn't have been hit by a tree, as owner baselessly claimed.Despite comprehensive evidence (photos, videos, and comments), RVShare unfairly charged us $1,387. This charge is unjustified as we did not cause the damages listed. We demand a fair review and resolution of this matter with full refund for this upsetting, aggravating and frustrating experience.

text: This was a horrible experience. The door broke early on during the trip (not our fault). The RV Share representative had mentioned that there was a problem with the door getting stuck when we went to rent it, but we did not realize exactly what he meant. We thought that he meant that it was just a little hard to open. However, we soon realized that when that door got stuck, it became IMPOSSIBLE to open! We had to climb in and out of the passenger door the entire time, which was very difficult. Roadside Assistance refused to help us, declaring that it was not an emergency. Second, it was supposed to sleep 10, but it truly only slept about 6, and we had rented it precisely because it slept 10. We NEEDED it to sleep 10 people, so that was extremely deceptive. When we confronted the RV share representative with this fact, he claimed that these upright recliners could sleep 2. These recliners only reclined partially rather than fully flat, so there is no way in which most people could actually sleep in such an upright position. Also, there is no way that it even comfortably slept even 8 adults. Maybe it could comfortably sleep 6 adults, but even that would be stretching it. The first night, we couldn't even get the table/bed to work properly, so it only slept about 5. Third, the insurance and fees were a total racket - way expensive! Fourth, the bathroom stunk. The backup camera is not to be trusted when backing these things up. My husband accidentally hit something, and it made a very small dent in the back, and so we lost our entire damage deposit.  We will never rent from them again!

title: I rented a motorhome from RVShare
text: I rented a motorhome from RVShare.  Price was decent, but the insurance was really high even for the highest deductible price.  Insuring it with my own insurance company wasn't an option.  My insurance company would have added the week's rental to my policy for less than $20 rather than the almost $500 insurance through RVshare.  I also paid a $500 security deposit.  The motorhome owner seemed very nice.  The motorhome was pretty nice.  My trip was fine except when I got to my destination, my brother noticed there was a flat tire on the inside dual tire.  He also said the other tires were in horrible condition from sun and weather exposure.  He was upset at the owner for sending me with them in that condition.  I wasn't used to driving something tall and I brushed up against tree branches.  That damaged the awning and paint finish.  My brother said for the awning to fall apart the way it did, it like the tires had to have been already in horrible condition due to sun and weather damage.  The 24 hour roadside service person agreed with his conclusion.  I spent a half a day in the tire shop.  I returned the RV.  The seemingly nice owner fraudulently charged me with generator hour overage which I absolutely did not use it more than a couple hours.  I disputed the overages.  RVShare withdrew the $1000 (which added to the $500 security deposit is the $1500 deductible) plus the $200+ overages from my bank account without notice as soon as damage and overages we're reported and before the dispute or insurance adjustment even had a chance to get started.  It is impossible to talk to anyone at RV share who is located in the USA.  Their international customer service people are helpful before the trip, but can't do anything for you afterward.  I contested the withdrawals and the overdraft charges with VISA.  VISA ruled in my favor and refunded my money, but now I can't get a hold of anyone to solve payment of the damages.  RVShare has non-existent customer service after the sale, bad business practices of withdrawing money from bank accounts prematurely, and absolutely no communication.
