name: W. Bunn
title: We made a reservation for a car
text: We made a reservation for a car. The plane was late and when we got there the office was closed. Went there when they opened the next day and was told there was no car available. We honored our side of the contract but evidently AVR doesn’t feel the need to honor their side.

name: jared sandoy
title: Prepaid reservation was cancelled on a…
text: Prepaid reservation was cancelled on a pretext and then was insulted by staff.

name: customer
title: Rental agency from Hell
text: Rental agency from Hell! They repeatedly emailed me the same directions for how to get picked up at the airport by calling a phone number. No one ever picked up! After an hour of waiting and trying to call them I finally got in touch with someone in the reservations department who sent me completely different directions! When I asked why I was repeatedly sent the wrong information the person on the phone couldn’t comprehend my question. I repeatedly asked to speak with a supervisor, but she wouldn’t get one. Once I arrived at their rental counter at the hotel they could have cared less that I had been at the airport for over an hour after landing. Surprise surprise when I asked to speak with their manager, they weren’t there. When I returned the car, guess what? The manager wasn’t there even though I had been told they would be. What a terrible company that treats customers like crap! Avoid these people at all cost!

name: Zak
title: Awful company, avoid!
text: Arrived at pickup point to call them at 12.04pm on  a Sunday following delayed flight.  Recorded message that they close at 12 on Sundays even though it’s an airport pick up.  No sign of this on booking confirm.  No reply to email asking for a partial refund.  Terrible company, do not use,

name: Russ Wiltsie
title: Absolute poor service
text: Absolute poor service this company gives. Located in California near LAX (Manager Alisha and others) rude classless company to deal with.  They gave than 48 hours notice to let us know that because we did not prepay for our rental they will have no vehicle available when arriving. Forcing us to re-rent last minute.  Never use this company anywhere at all.  Horrible company.   Can’t make this garbage up. It’s like the Sienfeld skit.

name: Anand Gm
title: DO NOT RENT FROM THIS COMPANY!!!
text: The minute we arrived at Airport Van Rental on June 13th, to pick up our pre-booked van, our vacation plans screeched to a halt.  There was no one there.  We lugged our belongings from our rental car, expecting a quick handover, only to be met with a deserted office and a sinking feeling in my stomach.  Then came the email - the one containing crucial locker access instructions, buried in my spam folder!  Finally, after wrestling with a rusty key and locating the van, after transferring our luggage from our rental car to this van our relief was short-lived.  The engine coughed, sputtered, and died.   Two hours crawling around in the hot Las Vegas sun, with a screaming toddler in tow, trying to contact a company that didn't seem to exist, pushed us to the edge. The road side assistance that we had taken did not work either. We called the number on the back if the key for hours and only heard music.Defeated, we piled back into our friend's car, our dream vacation itinerary replaced by the nightmare of scrambling for extra hotel rooms and a looming Airbnb cancellation fee. We ended up booking 3 rooms in Las Vegas for the night, cancelled our Airbnb at the destination and made a Royal mess of the plans for our rest of our vacation. From that day onwards till date I have been trying to contact the manger of this amazing organization but no one responds. DO NOT RENT FROM THIS COMPANY. They appear cheap but they are not worth the hassle.

name: Amir Malik
title: The worst service i have experienced
text: The worst service i have experienced. It is contactless facility in Phoenix. Finding the van was hassle at 1st, They never returned me my $200 deposit stating that gas tank was empty. This was not true.The Van was half tank when i took it & pictures were sent too.I filled the tank to same level before returning. They said that their agent says that tank was empty which i know is a lie.Stay away from these scammers

name: Jensen Marshall
title: DO NOT RENT FROM THIS PLACE
text: DO NOT RENT FROM THIS PLACE! Please save yourself the time & headache & spend a little bit more & rent from a regular car rental place. They take forever to pick you up from LAX. Then they bring you to the back of the four points Sheraton hotel to get your car. The same person that’s checking you is the same person running out there to get your vehicle. I paid for my reservation ahead of time on Priceline & when I checked in, the lady told me that they DO NOT rent without the additional $13.71 supplemental liability insurance. Even though my insurance covers rental cars. Mind you I did not rent a 12 or 15 person van. When I booked those before, I was told about my insurance not covering those transport vehicles. This time I only got a regular dodge minivan, and I was still charged an additional $68.55 for the SLI. What am I supposed to do when I’ve been waiting all this time to pick up my rental car, decline it & allow them to cancel my car reservation that was already paid for? It is the biggest scam & I should’ve read these reviews before renting from them. I have absolutely learned my lesson & will never rent from them again. I’m still disputing this extra charge with AVR. Do yourself a favor & rent with someone else who won’t scam you! Also the van was not cleaned at all. DO NOT RENT!

name: lacie tran
title: Horrible and dangerous experience
text: Horrible experience! I really wish I would have read reviews before booking via Kayak.First it took over a hour for the shuttle from the airport. Apparently they offer this service via the hotel the rental location is located in. Tried calling numerous times and no answer. Finally talked to someone who said 10 minutes, took another 40. Once we got there the car they gave us was dirty and had scratches and dings all over it. Check with your insurance company that they cover rentals. Because we were unsure we felt pressured to purchase theirs for additional $100.As soon as my husband started driving the car he told me it didn’t feel correct. We drove for about a hour, the car definitely was in need of serious repair. It was actually endangering our lives as it would not respond when you stepped on gas, and then would surge fast.Of course no answer on the way phone lines. We went all the back almost 1.5 hours at this point due to traffic. They really were not concerned,and only because we insisted on a new rental, they gave us one. Also acted like it was a big favor because upgraded. The new one was fine, although also dirty and damaged. The entire 9 day trip I felt unsettled if something was to happen what would we do. I wanted to return one day early, but of course was never able to talk to anyone. When we did return it, the lady didn’tWant to come out and inspect the car with us.We refused to leave until they did as we didn’t want to be charged for the damage that was already there. HORRIBLE company that had no issue putting our lives in danger, never apologized either

name: john myers
title: Never Rent from AVR Van Rental
text: Almost a month later still waiting on a refund from a van I canceled over a week early. The two vans we did get one didn’t have AC and the other shook so bad it was hard to drive. Get getting the run around in a refund.

name: Richard Bradley
title: Service was terrible
text: Service was terrible. Vehicle was dirty and the agent that helped me was very nasty. Ghetto!!!!

name: Bob
title: Fraudulent business practices
text: I prepaid for a van rental from AVR on 4/12/24 through Priceline online. At the same time I was paying for the van online, I also purchased the insurance that was offered. On 4/15/24 when I attempted to pick up the van, I was told that the insurance I purchased through Priceline was not valid and that I would need to purchase "their" insurance for $55/day. I told the agent that I did not want the insurance and that the contract did not state anywhere that I needed their specific insurance. When I asked her to show me in the contract where it stated that, she then changed her story indicating it was a Nevada law. I know this is not true. Since I had already prepaid for the van, I was told by the agent that I couldn't cancel and would lose my money if I didn't purchase their insurance because they would not give me the van until I had paid for their insurance. When I asked to speak to a manager I was told that I couldn't talk to anyone else. After nearly hour I finally gave in and gave her my credit card. I was charged $592.63 for a 7-day rental which is much more than the original $55 I was originally told. I never received any documentation indicating what was covered, etc. The business practices of Airport Van Rental are fraudulent, but it leaves the renter with no choice but to pay the fees.

name: Raphael Leib
title: THIS COMPANY IS NOT TRUSTWORTHY
text: This company is among the worst I have ever dealt with!  I booked and paid for a van rental on March 19 for pickup on April 6. On March 29, I received a one-line email saying "Thank you [my name], your rental has been successfully cancelled." After an hour of calling anyone I could find (they do not make it easy to reach a human!), I was finally told by one of their agents that they had overbooked their vans and had to cancel my reservation, and that I would be refunded the $827.19 I had paid.It is now April 17 and I still have not received my refund. I called their customer service line and after another very long wait, I spoke with someone who claimed my refund had supposedly been issued on April 12. No explanation as to why it took them 2 weeks to do this, assuming they really did it at all. I never received any confirmation of the refund, nor does my credit card statement indicate that the money was refunded. I have filed a formal complaint with my credit card company and hope they can resolve the matter.  This company has already caused me a massive inconvenience; here's hoping it doesn't become a costly one, as well.

name: Aaron Lang
title: Horrible
text: Horrible.  This is by far the worst experience I have ever had at renting a vehicle.   We are trying to transport kids/parents for a robotics competition and have us picking up at the wrong location.    They dont have a van where we are flying into and they won't refund our money!

name: EJ Johnson
title: AVOID - AVOID - AVOID
text: I booked and paid for a 7-passenger minivan a month before I arrived. They told me they would reach out to me with specific directions a few days before I arrived. Never heard from them. On the morning of my flight to LAX, I finally called myself to determine how their process works. It was at THAT time they told me that they had no minivans, but they would put me in a 15 passenger full-sized van.  I didn't want a full size van, but I had no choice since I was already at the airport.  Maybe not a huge deal to drive a bus, but then they charged me MORE for the rental, and also INSISTED I had to buy special insurance because I was now driving a 'commercial vehicle'.  What an absolute scam!  They lied over and over to me, while being disgustingly rude while doing so.  Never EVER will I again even think of going back, and I'll share my experience with everyone and anyone!  Rent somewhere else if you wish to work with an honest, polite, and less expensive rental company!

name: Rufaro
title: I didn't like the long process to get…
text: I didn't like the long process to get the vehicle. I also didn't like the fact that the rental car did not come with a license plate on the car. Tried to get the company to get me a license plate but they did not. Only emailed me a paper. Especially in Atlanta, not having a license plate restricted us from parking in several areas of the city. I also didn't like all the additional fees that I was not made aware of until it was time to check the car out. Had to pay an extra $400-500 dollars without my prior knowledge. Having initially payed for the rental on Priceline, the original price compared to the price after the ridiculous amount of fees was astonishing.  Also didn't like the return process. Had to drop the car off in an Airport garage and just leave the keys and ticket inside. Did not feel comfortable leaving the car unattended like that and not being sure if they were going to be able to find and retrieve the car in a timely manner.

name: Scott Ames-Messinger
title: CANCELED A PREPAID BOOKING A WEEK BEFORE OUR TRIP
text: A WEEK before our trip to Austin, Texas, Airport Van Rental CANCELED OUR VAN that WE HAD PREPAID.When I called, I was told they'd call back and they never did. Later, I called back and was on hold for 40 minutes. The next day, I called back and was directed to someone who was not the manager. This person refused to transfer me to the manager, Tupou Fifita.They did not try to secure another van. They did not move a van from another location. They did not connect us with another rental agency. They did *absolutely nothing* to try to fix things.We have 9 people and all the airport cars have been sold out in Austin for 2 MONTHS. There's simply not other airport options. I have no idea how our trip will continue given how incompetent and unhelpful they are.

name: Heather Nolan
title: TERRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE - DO NOT USE!
text: Terrible customer service.  Impossible to reach an actual person.  Hours of operation are not clear.  I do not recommend this company.The details:  Our connecting flight was delayed which made us a day late for our rental.  I tried calling the company to make sure we would still have our rental the following morning when we were due to arrive.  I left a voicemail since there wasn't anyone to answer the phone.  The next morning, I called first thing and also received the option to leave a message.  Since I had done that the night before, I opted to send an email to make sure we had something in writing.  At this point I was getting nervous that we wouldn't have a vehicle upon arrival.  I called back a few times and was advised by the recording that there was "1" caller ahead of us.  Finally, I thought - I would have a chance to speak with a real person and explain our situation and  hopefully confirm our rental.  After 55 minutes of holding (I have the screen shots!) I finally decided to rent with a different company.  We paid much more than we needed to but we were stuck at that point.  After a 10 day family vacation I forgot about the experience until we got home and I was catching up on emails and found the confirmation from them.  There was never a call back or a return email from my attempts to reach them over 10 days ago. All that to say - I can not recommend this company.  If I ever hear from them and there is an explanation to all of this madness, I am willing to update my review at that time.

name: Angy Customer
title: The most horrible experience ever
text: Car reserved was not ready. Had to wait an hour. Finally offered us a car that was less than adequate. We were threatened by the manager and told to sit down and if we didn't like it we would have to wait another hour for them to clean out another car. Worse company I have ever dealt with.  No customer service at this place and dishonest.  Took two hours to get a car.

name: MC
title: BEWARE!!!! I am out $700!
text: Unfortunately, at this point, I would leave a negative star review if that was an option.  November, I reserved two vans for LV. Next day I received an email confirmation for LA. After no return emails, I called and spoke to "customer service". They said they can change the reservation after checking with the LV office.  I asked if I would get an email confirming that the reservation was successfully changed. She said their system can't provide that confirmation, but she could "email me a screen shot of the confirmation when it is approved." NADA!  Long story short, after 6 weeks of multiple calls on a weekly basis only one reservation has been refunded.  Noone can seem to tell me why I am not being refunded for the second van.  "I see it has been flagged for an escalated response." "I should hear something within 48 hours." NADA.  Noone can forward me to accounting so I asked who to contact. I was given the name and number for a Marcus. I have left two VM and NADA and NADA!  The lack of professionalism and customer service is astonishing!  I am guessing after this review; it will seal the deal that they will rob me of close to $700!

name: Shahidah Nicole
title: If I could give 0
text: If I could give 0, I would. We prepaid for a 15 passenger van to help transport 13 people for a trip to Grand Canyon that we has been planning for almost a year. We were all meeting at the rental spot since we flew in from all over the country only to find out they the van we prepaid was not available. We were basically being told oh well as 13 of us stood there stranded. We had an airbnb in Utah so not uber-able (they orig offered Uber). After going back and forth, them threatening to call the police if we didn’t leave, then found a van. The so called manager left the employee there after threatening us, past their 4pm closing time, never to be seen again and said she didn’t get paid enough for this. We just needed transportation. The van they found was super raggedy with holes in the seat, wires hanging from the console, holes in the armrest, door not aligned so it required an outside person to slam to close it, stains on the seats, and finally sounding like it was gonna cut off at every light. We were desperate so we had to take it. It was getting late and a holiday weekend. NEVER AGAIN!!

name: Romas Ju
title: Run away form them
text: I'm from europe, rented a car from AVR. despite I took insurance they also took the $200 deposit. When the car was returned they could return me the deposit, claiming the card was blocked. I've contacted my bank,confirmed the card is ok, used it in another store - but they still couldn't process the refund and said they'll mail me a check - which I cannot use in europe. So now I have to file a charge back. I suspect they do it on purpose. "Support" is very ignorant.

name: Carol Hill
title: Never rent anything from AVR Van…
text: FYI never ever rent a van from AVR Van Rental. We rented a van to take grandkids to the beach and cleaned it out better than it was when I got it and when I returned it except for a little bit sand on the floor of a van that was 4 years old that had 144,000 miles with worn out seats and worn out carpet and I am being charged a $400 cleaning fee. Also, when I picked up the van the gas was 30 miles until empty and I left it with 137 miles until empty!  I will be disputing this charge with my credit card company.I learned my lesson never rent a van from a less reputable company such as AVR!  Rent from Capps Van Rental.

name: Wiam Bitar
title: Very bad customer service
text: Very bad customer service , hidden charges and no refund policy , I have lost USD 1350 for renting a VAN from LAX airport , once you arrive to their office they ask for additional insurance which is almost double the price of your paid rental , they don’t refund . Stay away of them

name: Pete
title: Closes at 4pm at an airport?
text: I only have experience with the Las Vegas AVR.When booking online they don't mention their hours are 10am to 4pm every day! Was told there was a charge for after-hours. No idea how much, just very glad i paid for cancellable (48hr before pickup)You cannot phone them (You can but always an answering machine that has a full mailbox). Phoning reservations after booking online is hopeless, Such poor phone quality that you are guessing what they say, and such attitude from them. The chat person seemed nice but they only answer questions between 15 and 1/2 hour after you ask them. I don't have 3 hours to waste dealing with them.

name: Denise Davis
title: FAR FROM THE TRUTH
text: First and foremeost, I thank God that we did reach our destination and returned safely as well.  However, I reserved a 15 passenger van and was told that it would be a new van.  Upon arrival to the pickup location, we were greeted by the most rude individuals.  It was approximately 3 PM and they kept telling us they were closing soon.  The van they chose was a 10 passenger, NOT NEW and looked like it had been through a war zone.  And the inside of the van was filfthy, the seats wer worn and torn covered with stains, the headrest was broken ans so much more!  I could not believe that this was what I received for the $758.  Regretfully,I was told that it was the only van available and because I had a church event planned, I had to accept. On their website they state "all our vehicles expertly maintained and hen you rent a van from Airport Van Rental, rest assured that you’re getting top-quality vehicles and the most dedicated services at the lowest possible prices."  At the Atlanta location, this is far from the truth.

WE LOVE  TO COME TO  LAS VEGAS !!! Definitely coming back.

name: Lisa Monreal
title: I wish ZERO stars could happen
text: I wish ZERO stars could happen. This place is the absolute worst. I rented an SUV one week prior to my trip. I got to the airport and there is no sign for them to stand by to get picked up. I called about 10 times and got a voicemail with a mailbox that was full before I got someone to answer the phone. When I finally spoke to someone she informed me that they only have 12 passenger vans left even though I had a reservation for an SUV. I attempted to call every other place and ended up calling about 10 different places that were all sold out. I attempted to call back and again it took about 30 minutes of calling over and over again. Finally they tell me that someone will be there in 10 minutes to pick me up. I waited 45 minutes before calling back again and still no one was there. I was then put on hold for a while and then I was told that they are all sold out of everything and cannot help me. So I was stuck at the Denver airport with no car and had to take an Uber that cost me $200 to get to my hotel. This place is terrible and I hope no one ever rents from them. They had zero people skills and even the customer service was rude and told me - well they didn’t charge you - oh well thank you for not charging me. I have never been more disgusted by a business in my life

name: Customer
title: Pay Less but expect less
text: The car was beat up on the inside and the outside. The car drove like a golf cart, which isn't ideal for a mountain vacation. I was very upset when the employee sold me a toll pass, which I believed I needed, and then once out on the roads the tolls were all closed. I was quoted $12/day for the toll pass and was charged $13.50/day. Biggest issue was when returning the car. They have very clear instruction on how to drop the car off after hours, however you are unable to follow the instructions. There is a phone number to call and the mailbox was full. You are suppose to leave the parking space and section on the voicemail, but the spaces are not marked. So I left a rental car, unlocked, with keys in it, at a park n fly which was scary as the policy states that any damage occurred to the vehicle while parked after hours was my responsibility.

name: Catherine Knox
title: They deserve ZERO stars.
text: They deserve ZERO stars.I book travel for a football team through our company, and try to get large vans whenever possible.  I booked three 12-passenger vans six days ahead of travel time.  While the agent (Alexander) seemed helpful, he had a thick accent and was difficult to understand, so I did as much of the transaction as possible in an online live chat that I got sent to my email in order to be able to verify details.There were a few times where the agent seemed impatient with my questions, in fact even said 'look at conversation above, I already told you,' but I put that down to English perhaps not being his first language.I paid a $1 deposit to hold the vans and then had them email me the paperwork to pay for all three up front on my credit card, which I did.Over the next few days, I tried to contact the company several ways, including email (no response),  online chat (sometimes no response, other times a response but not very helpful), and phone calls (mostly no answer, once the hard-to-understand Alexander who assured me everything was in order and acted impatient with me for asking questions, and once an EXTREMELY RUDE woman who said she was 'only an office person, I can't help you' and when I said that I understood, and nicely requested to speak to a manager about my concerns, she said 'yeah, I'll have them call you,' and HUNG UP ON ME without getting my name or number).Today, the day my team is flying in and is due to pick up the rental vans, I received a call from a woman named Keisha (who sounds suspiciously like the rude woman from yesterday only in a better mood) who told me she's sorry but they overbooked so they are putting my group on STANDBY!!!  I am appalled at this horrible customer service and told her to cancel our contracts and refund all payments immediately.  This has been one of the worst companies I have ever dealt with in any capacity.  I cannot say enough about how much stress and extra work this has created, trying to shuffle things around and now get vehicles rented at the last minute from other sources. My team is still on their flight and I haven't even been able to inform them of this nonsense yet because I am too busy trying to find other rentals.DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY.  AVR is TERRIBLE.

name: Shirley Schmitt
title: Experience was poor
text: Experience was poor. Van was not as I expected and a ton of hidden fees.

name: Loretta Crawford

text: Lakreisha explains really well about the deposit.. thank u

name: Holly Paxton

Then was called and said I’d have to remake my reservation, so I did that  (with a higher price because my initial booking price wasn’t available) and then was told I can pay it before I come because of my daily limit and now I’m told I can’t even do that. Of course now that we are three days from our vacation I can’t change or cancel without being charged.I should have stuck with enterprise or Avis like I always do!

name: Carlos Perez

text: GM Toby Holton of the Atlanta location is a horrible person he acted like he is running a criminal organization where he is the mob Boss. name: Tawana Marable
title: The Worst!!!!
text: The Worst!!!!This was the worst experience that I’ve ever had renting a vehicle. I reserved a 15 passenger van in Las Vegas for 5 days. When I arrived at the rental office, the lady there was less than thrilled to see me. She didn’t even acknowledge me as I waited. Whatever happened to good customer service? She tried to push expensive, and extra insurance on me. It got to the point that I had to call my agent on her day off to prove to her that I was covered. I guess my word wasn’t good enough. Although I rented a 15 passenger, I ended up with a 12 passenger van. I settled for that, but I wish that it was clean. The seats were so nasty , that we had to put plastic bags down to sit down. The seats were also torn and raggedy. It was very dirty. I also thought that most rentals start you off with a full tank of gas. Not in this case. It was below half. I went back in to complain and ask for a different vehicle. She stated that that was all that they had, and wasn’t apologetic at all. If it wasn’t peak season, and my family of 11 wasn’t depending on that for transportation, I would have left that work van right there. When I spend my hard earned money for something, I expect to be treated with respect. She didn’t even pretend to care. I will never ever rent from AVR Las Vegas again

name: Diana Castro
title: Horrible service from start to finish
text: Horrible service from start to finish.  The front desk person was very disrespectful and made racist comments.  The van was old and smelly. The tank was almost empty. The poor van almost doesn’t make it back because the engine was dying. The windshields didn’t work and made a squeaky sound. We came back to return the van and the same guy who rented it to us said he couldn’t gave us back the deposit.Lesson learned, never pay too cheap!!  Is better the extra cost for good customer service and safety.

name: Michelle L.

text: We had a good experience with AVR Dallas.  We were honestly concerned when we booked and read the reviews.  To be honest, we took a last minute flight and they were our only and cheapest option.  We had to wait fir them to clean the van once we got there which wasn’t ideal, but the were friendly and accommodating.  The van wasn’t beautiful but it got us where we needed to go so we were happy.

name: Ellen Jones

name: Jeff Aucoin
title: I will never rent from AVR again
text: Where do I start??  I rented an AVR van in Houston to take a trip with my family.  When I arrived at the location on the scheduled pick up time the van was dirty inside and out.  The employee told me he needed to clean it inside.  After a 45 minute wait outside, he asked me if I wanted him to wash the outside.  I told him I would take care of it at home before my trip.  We confirmed weekly rates, free mileage etc.  When I returned the van, I delivered it clean inside and out without damage. I finally got customer service on the phone, had to dispute the whole thing with them and my credit card company.  They had also falsely represented that I turned the van in 4 days after I did. text: BEWARE! This was the absolute worst experience ever. We had reserved a 15 passenger van for Dallas/Fort Worth from Aug 11-16. When we got there, there was 1 person working and a room full of mad customers, none of which were given a shuttle and we had to find our own uber and spend another $20 just to get back to the airport, and almost missed the flight. name: Shawn Cunningham
title: NEVER...EVER...AGAIN!!! Spend the extra money!!!
text: If I could give them no stars in Los Angeles I would!!! This was by far one of the most hacked experiences I have ever endured with my wife and 2 kids in the middle of the night!!! First off, when we got to LAX we had to call to get instructions on how to get to the rental office...no big deal, but I called and they said one of the drivers would be there to get us in their van. First red flag was the fact that we were told we had to go to the top level, where non of the other rental companies are, and look for “CL Parking”...we could find “CL Parking”. So I called again and was told “it’s over by the hotel and parking lot pick up”. Went over to that area, still couldn’t find “CL Parking”. We walked up and down the level, talk to an officer and asked them where it was, and they told us that rental car company pickups are all on the same level and we needed to go back downstairs. So all 4 us wheeling our bags around went back down to the lower level AGAIN!!! Couldn’t find “CL Parking”!!! I called a 3rd time and asked what EXACTLY am I looking for, because it’s been over an hour since our plane landed and we first contacted them. The person put me on hold and said and when they came back said we should have someone there in about 15 minutes or so...it’s a white passenger van that said “CL Parking” on it. One would think that the van would be clearly marked, right?? So we were looking and looking and waiting and waiting and finally about a half an hour later a white passenger van with small lettering near the bottom! The driver, Arthur, was extremely nice and very helpful. He took us to the van rental office and dropped us off.  This place was sketchy at best!!! It was really poorly lit with paper signs taped up telling us where we needed to go. There was one other passenger with us upon pickup at the airport and she had to leave the rest of her party at the airport to get dropped off at the rental office. They only wanted to pick up the drivers and leave the rest of their party at the airport...not gonna happen in my case!!! I’m not leaving my wife and children alone at LAX while I hop in a van and leave them alone for god knows how long!!! When we finally made it inside the office, it was no better...uncomfortable was the first feeling that came to mind, but we waited, and waited, and waited in line for our turn, which seemed excessive because there were more people working there than there was customers!!! Maybe about another half hour later the woman in front of me, that was by herself, spoke up and said “excuse me guys, I have a reservation” to which the gentleman who was clearly in charge told her that “he’s busy and would deal with her when he was done”!!! At that point, I looked at my wife and said that’s it, I’m done, I’ll call an Uber and go somewhere else. So while I was standing in line I cancelled my reservation online, on my phone. As we starting walking out the guy in charge said “what’s the matter, where are you going?” And I then informed him that I cancelled my reservation online. He could have cared less. He said “oh” and went on doing whatever he was doing. When we got outside the driver that had picked us up at the airport was pulling back in with more passengers, so I asked him where the closest rental car place was, or how to get back to the airport. He was very apologetic about the situation and told us that he had to run back to LAX and would bring us back and drop us off so we could get set up with a different rental car company. He started putting our stuff in the back of the van and the “guy in charge” came outside and asked what I was doing. I told him I was trying to rent a car, at which point he snapped at me about canceling my reservation. As we stood in a shady part of some random neighborhood with my wife and 2 kids in the middle of the night after having dealt with the situation since hours earlier. I lost it on the guy!!! We got in a screaming match in the parking lot. Long story short...Don’t!!

name: Lynn Culhane
title: LAX Airport Van Rental Review
text: If you want an extremely dissatisfying experience, fraught with unprofessional employees, this is the place for you. I reserved 182 days in advance. After an arduous journey to even get to the rental place (involving 2 different shuttles and standing in a parking lot, out in the heat, with all of our luggage, to catch the second shuttle), I entered the Airport Van Rental (AVR) building, only to be greeted by at least 4 other disgruntled parties who did not look impressed, as they were waiting for their own van rentals (which were late).I was informed by the employee who assisted me, that I would not like any of her answers (at least she was honest- that I appreciated). She said there are no vans available right now, but you will get "something" sometime today. Thank goodness for vagueness.  I reserved a 15 passenger van, only to be greeted by a 12 passenger van. Unfortunately, the group I was travelling with were ALL afraid to conquer LA driving, or else I would have abandoned AVR and would have gone elsewhere to rent two regular sized vehicles. However, I was far braver and had no choice but to rent a larger passenger van from AVR! I would even have brought an absolute stranger with our group and rented two 8 passenger SUV's to avoid this place (hind sight is 20/20).  It gets better, continuing reading...The VAN arrived two hours late and don't forget the wrong one, not the 15 passenger we had reserved. However, we were told that AVR could not give us a time when a 15 passenger would be available, so we relented and accepted the 12 passenger (which we received no discount for a smaller van rental). Now, due to the extra time it took to shuttle to AVR and the LONG wait to rent the van, I got to waste time in rush hour, yeah!Upon entering the VAN, the olfactory senses were walloped by wafting urine and sweat. All seats were cloth and soiled. I immediately asked for air fresheners… what I received was a lite mist of some crappy spray that lasted until I reached the first corner. Well, at least I got to shop, along the way to our destination, for air fresheners at TARGET (we don't have target in Canada anymore, so I enjoyed being able to shop there and erect a forest of Pine Trees in the van). If you closed your eyes real tight you'd swear you were in a real forest somewhere nice, definitely NOT this lousy land barge that wreaks of other humans odors.Fast forward to day four, when I used the windshield wipers to clear dirt off the window at night, as the glare was awful. The driver’s side wiper was ruined and didn't remove anything. It only spread the dirt around, making it difficult to see. Now I had the pleasure of finding a gas station, to properly clean the window, at least I got to Ace Venture my way there to avoid striking objects. One would think that AVR would check all lights, fluids and wipers as all have to do with safety. Not this place.At the end of the trip, I followed the directions given to me, and dropped the VAN off at the adjacent building CL (parking), as it was early in the morning. I asked for a receipt and the attendant stated he didn't have any and that I would receive an email soon, confirming that I had dropped the VAN off. This is an important fact to remember.Almost 48 hours later, I get a call that sounds like this, verbatim, " When are you gonna bring our Van back?” I said, "I dropped it off Saturday.” The employee reiterated where is our VAN, when are you gonna drop if off? I said I am in Canada and I don't have your van. We will look into it and get back to you. ….Click the phone is hung up. This was a conversation that lacked any form of etiquette. I REALLY appreciated this person calling me at 23:10 hours on a Sunday evening. This made me worry all night that I got duped at the airport and someone actually stole the van. Never did get a call back from them.I then called the General Manager the next day, Mr. Batchelor. I told him about all of my concerns and he asked “where is our VAN?” At this point it became painfully obvious, this business has no form of inventory control, professionalism, common courtesy, they are void of core competencies associated with success, professionalism and interpersonal dynamics. Mr. Bachelor ended the conversation stating he would get back to me, he never did. I am assuming they located their van.At a bare minimum I would have expected AVR to reimburse me for the pine forest I purchased, to mask the odor of the urine express. Instead, Mr. Batchelor had a battery of excuses to address all the concerns I had. I also advised him that I had a discount card that was not honored, silent response to this as well.It pains me to rate AVR a star. I think a moon would be more appropriate. I truly hope someone other than the General Manager reads this review and develops a strategic plan for this location. The plan should include professional development across all domains. If the General Manager reads it conduct a SWOT analysis of you and your team. I am sure you will find something to work on. If you’ve done a SWOT do another one the first one didn’t work.Overall, I would avoid this place at ALL costs, unless you want to author a review like this.

I was traveling from South Carolina to Portland, OR with my seven children (ages 2 – 14), by myself for 3 weeks. I rented a van from AVR to accommodate my family during our vacation based on online reviews and price. It was not inexpensive (over $2,000). When I booked the van I was under the impression that the van rental office was located at the Portland airport.A few days prior to my departure to Portland, I found out different, when the Portland office contacted me to let me know their airport shuttle was not running. As a lone parent with seven kids, I was very concerned about how I would be getting to the rental location. The location told me they could provide me with one Lyft ride. I was very upset because it is not possible to take all my kids and myself in a single Lyft and I was not willing to leave some of my children at the airport or have them ride with a stranger to the rental location…my whole family needed to go to the van location at one time.I called the 1-800 customer service number for AVR to try and resolve this issue. They assured me that the location could get two Lyft drivers at the same time. I arranged with a family member to meet me at PDX to help me with my kids and make sure they were not riding alone with a stranger. When I arrived at PDX I called the van location to arrange transportation to pick up my rental van. They were adamant that they could only summons one Lyft driver at a time and that I would have to leave half my kids at the airport and then they could summons another Lyft driver or I could pay for another Lyft myself. I asked if they could use the van I was renting to come get me and my kids and was told that was absolutely not possible. They did not care about my situation and were unwilling to help me at all! I am grateful I had a family member meet me at PDX and could help me and was able to order another Lyft and ride with half my kids.When I got to the rental location, I was told that AVR would take off the cost of the Lyft ride to the rental location, but not the $4.00 tip. Are you kidding me!?!?! I was not supposed to tip the driver who had to take a longer time due to my having car seats, luggage, etc? I am not that kind of person. Apparently, AVR (at least the Portland location) is that type of company. Furthermore, when I asked how I would be able to get back to the airport, I was told they would be able to drop me and my kids off in the van I had rented. Why couldn’t they do that to pick us up?!All the miscommunication and horrible service on AVR’s part got my vacation off to a very rough start. Had I known that the customer service was so poor at the Portland location I would have rented from another company. I am so disgusted that this company did not care about me or my family, at all!

title: The worst customer service I have seen in decades...
text: The worst customer service I have seen in decades.The lies upfront to your face, the tricks to get more money from the customer, the lack of trust...I was appalled that I was told that my international insurance would not be accepted so I had to purchase theirs. I have been using the same insurance for years in so many different countries, and this is the first time I am told this.  The reason given was that "it's our policy, it's in our handbook" and when I asked to see where it is written, the answer was "you can't, I don't have the handbook here".After I insisted politely a few times, she "found the handbook" and started reading through it, only to "be surprised" that I was allowed to use my insurance as long as I could provide proof that it covered this vehicle in California. For this I had to call my insurance provider, put them on the line with the person at the car rental for them to be convinced... wow, really.A lie up front and then making it as hard as they could for me to get away without buying their overpriced insurance...One thing I am sure is that I will never go back there.Oh, and note: ACE and AVR are the exact same thing, so switching to the other one won't do you any good.Please be advised that you will have to pay extra for:- full insurance- liability insurance- fuelOne of their tricks is to ask you if you want to pay for refueling at the end of the trip. If you say no, then they pick a van which has little fuel left in the tank. But instead of the normal car rental companies that let you return empty if it was nearly empty, they here tell you to bring it back at 1/8th full (basically 1 bar above empty) because that''s the current amount of fuel in the tank.  They do this because they know that there is no way anyone could guess correctly how much fuel to put in to hit that exact 1/8th, so people will always over-refuel, and the company will take that for free.There is so much scamming, animosity and bad intentions in that place that it makes me sad

title: Awful experience with Wisecars
text: I had an awful experience with Wisecars where the customer service was also extremely unhelpful. First, they screwed up my booking, where I had selected to collect the car from Heathrow and return at St Pancras. When I received the booking voucher 48 hours before the trip, I was surprised the returning location was changed to Heathrow. When I called in, the customer service just shared he wasn't able to change the booking and asked whether I wanted to cancel the booking. I had to call Enterprise to change the return location myself. The second surprise was upon car collection where Enterprise was pushing to take up their insurance as they would claim against me if anything happened and I would have to claim myself with Wisecars, which was not mentioned upfront during the booking process. The insurance coverage was also not sufficient for car's value. Although their policy stated I could cancel the insurance coverage any time up till collection, they didn't honor it when I called in to cancel the insurance coverage. I haven't received the refund up till today. In then end i had to pay an additional 560 pounds to Enterprise for their insurance coverage, premium rental location fee & VATe.Rachel's response was "Any additional insurance requirements from the supplier can be found in the terms and conditions that are accepted during the booking process. We always encourage customers to review these details to ensure they meet their needs before completing a reservation." If Wisecars is genuine on providing a good & trustworthy service, all these important details should be stated clearly in booking process when they are selling various types of insurance package to allow a customer to make an informed decision as the customer will not be well versed with the details of the arrangement between Wisecars and the car rental company. There is no way for a customer to know that the insurance coverage is not sufficient for the car's value although the customer is buying the comprehensive package as the car model is not fix upon booking and the customer will also not be aware that the insurance package is not from car rental's insurance company.It was an extremely bad experience, and I will recommend anyone to avoid renting through Wisecars in order not to have a bad experience at the start of your holiday.

name: Emily Silk
title: DO NOT FLY WIZZ AIR
text: DO NOT FLY WIZZ AIR. I wish I could give them zero stars. They clearly do not care about their customers and have predatory policies that are meant to squeeze every last cent out of you rather than provide good customer service. I understand that you get what you pay for here but that is no reason to have a no refunds policy no matter the circumstance. I had a flight credit left over from a previous flight that I had to cancel (I have never flown Wizz Air before this but the price was right until my unforeseen circumstances made led to my cancelation). I went on the app to book a new flight with my credits before they expired and as I was booking my flight I got an error message. I realized I was short a few credits and that I didn't have a credit card added to my account to cover it. So I added a credit card made sure the credits box was still checked and hit next and was charged THE FULL AMOUNT for the flight. I called Wizz Air to try to rectify the situation and I was told that Wizz Air has a no refunds policy without a hefty cancelation fee (even though I had booked a flex fare). When I told them it was an app issue they accused me of lying and saying they had no proof that I was intending to use the credits and thus there was nothing that could be done. I told them that if they refunded me I would be happy to stay on the phone and rebook that flight immediately to prove that I wanted to book the flight with credits. Instead of trying to find a solution with me I was refused the opportunity to speak to a manager, I was spoken over with scripted lines that did not address my concern, and then I was hung up on. Wizz air claims to be a completely digital platform but you cannot be if your app fails and there is no recourse when that happens. I ended up having to pay the cancelation fee (which was almost half the cost of the ticket) because at this point I would rather lose money that fly with an airline that treats its customers like this. So the price is never right here. Save your time and your sanity and book with Ryan Air, Easy Jet, or any other airline.

name: Nathan
title: They may appear cheap but they really aren't
text: We booked a holiday to Turkey through a 3rd party website and Wizz was the company flying us over there. On this 3rd party website it said we were aloud an onboard small luggage bag and a rucksack. When we arrived at the airport it turns out that they only allow a rucksack and you have to pay extra for the small suitcase which they call "priority" which at this point, was too late to do on their app and I ended up paying £113 to store 2 small suitcases in the baggage hold as we were already there and already had the 2 small suitcases. Bearing in mind i had already paid an extra 80 odd quid to take a large 20kg suitcase with me. So after finally sorting this out and getting on the plane it would seem that the cleaners took a day off as the floor was littered with crumbs and bits of this and that from the previous flight. Ok, its a cheap airline, im not expecting the Ritz. About 30 mins to an hour into the flight the food trolley comes out but by the time it had served about 10 people and got to me, oh what do you know, theyve got no sandwhiches left. Surely they would have thought ahead and stocked up on all items that are being advertised on the menu so there is enough food for everyone right? Turns out, no they dont stock up regularly. Its also worth mentioning that every other airline Ive flown with allow you to choose your own seats for free once the 24 hour check in window opens but that is not the case with Wizz, ohh no. Even when the check in opens you still have to pay to reserve any of the available seats or you will just have to sit where they randomly assign you to sit even though on the flight, everyone just gets up and sits where they want regardless. Anyway, we get to Turkey and i immediatly buy "priority" tickets on the app for the return flight which comes to a further 43 quid for the 2 suitcases as that is far cheaper than the £113 ive just had to pay at the airport, although still a piss take considering all this was originally advertised to me as included (fair enough, on the 3rd party website, not Wizz's). So on the way back to England, i dont know if this is because i paid priority or not but the woman at the lugge desk tells me i can put my small suitcases in the baggage hold for free if i want. Well ive already paid an additional 43 quid to take them on board with me so no, your alright ill do what ive already paid to do thanks. Once again, plane has crumbs and bits all over the floor and what do you know, still no sandwhiches on board. If you dont mind surving on pringles and nuts for 4 hours then this is the flight for you but i would like something a bit more substantial to be honest. So in summary: YES, they will get you there but youll likely have to pay for many hidden extras along the way and dont expect there to be much to eat on the plane because the flight 2 days ago have already eaten everything.

Their so-called “24-hour cancellation policy” is misleading and doesn’t protect honest mistakes.I had no choice but to pay a change fee of 848 RON, plus a fare difference, which brought me to paying almost double the cost of a normal ticket. I paid nearly the same amount again just to fly the route I originally meant to book.I contacted customer service, explained the situation, emphasized my loyalty, but they didn’t care. It felt like talking to a wall. I understand that the employees in customer support can only do so much and need to be backed by the right internal policies and clauses. But that’s exactly the issue: the company gives them no room to support loyal passengers, even when it’s clearly a minor and honest mistake.Wizz Air’s rules show zero flexibility or goodwill, even for frequent flyers. It’s not just about this one mistake, it’s about how a company treats its loyal customers when something small goes wrong.So be warned: Wizz Air will charge you for your ticket twice if you make a mistake, even if you notice it immediately. It’s really not that difficult.Thankfully, another crew member eventually stepped in, gave me a sick bag, and offered some water. But I was visibly unwell for over an hour and a half, and not once did anyone check on me after that. I've just about managed on my own, but honestly, a little kindness would’ve gone a long way.Instead, the crew seemed far more focused on pushing overpriced perfumes for hours. Truly disappointing. name: Mr Tibor  Bozso
title: Damage control.
text: My Experience with Wizz Air: Delayed but Well-Handled**I traveled to Hungary on March 27th and really enjoyed my flight to Budapest. Wizz Air's planes have more legroom and more comfortable seats compared to Ryanair, and the staff were friendly. It was a great five-star experience—you truly get what you pay for.However, on my way back to London, I faced a **15-hour delay**. I’m not basing my review on the delay itself, but rather on how Wizz Air handled the situation.Of course, everyone was upset at first, but I appreciated the way the airline managed things. They provided **food and drink vouchers every three hours**, which helped make the long wait bearable. The flight back to London was quiet—we were all exhausted after the stress and frustration of the delay.The next day, I filed a **compensation claim**—a quick 10-minute process. I didn’t expect much, but I figured I had nothing to lose. To my surprise, Wizz Air responded within **five days**, approved my claim, and sent me **€250**, which I received just two days later. I could have claimed more for additional expenses, but I was satisfied with the compensation.Delays can happen anytime, and I understand that. What matters is how a company handles them. Wizz Air resolved my case fairly and efficiently, exceeding my expectations.My advice? **Communicate with the airline and submit your claim**—you might be pleasantly surprised. Despite the delay, I’m a **happy customer** in the end.

title: Wizz Air: The Absolute Worst Airline Experience
text: If you are looking for the worst airline experience of your life, look no further than Wizz Air. From the moment you book your ticket to the second you (hopefully) land at your destination, this airline will test your patience, your sanity, and your will to live.1. Hidden Fees and Scam PricingWizz Air is the undisputed king of hidden fees. Think you’ve booked a cheap flight? Think again. You’ll pay extra for everything—printing your boarding pass, selecting a seat, bringing a normal-sized carry-on, and even breathing on board (okay, maybe not that last one—yet). Their so-called “low-cost” tickets quickly turn into a price comparable to a much better airline.2. Delays and Cancellations Without ExplanationExpect your flight to be delayed—or even worse, canceled—without a shred of communication. If your flight is canceled, don’t expect any compensation or assistance. You’ll be left stranded in a random airport, begging for information from their unhelpful and rude staff, who will simply tell you to “check the website” while smirking at your misfortune.3. Incompetent and Rude StaffSpeaking of staff, Wizz Air seems to have a strict hiring policy: only employ people who genuinely hate passengers. From the check-in desk to the cabin crew, you’ll be met with indifference, sarcasm, and outright hostility. Have a problem? Too bad. Want a solution? Not happening.4. Cattle-Class Seating and Filthy CabinsThe seats on Wizz Air planes feel like they were designed for medieval torture. Zero legroom, rock-hard cushions, and seats that don’t recline. Oh, and if you thought they cleaned the plane between flights, think again—crumbs, stains, and mysterious sticky substances are all part of the Wizz Air experience.5. A Customer Service Black HoleEver tried contacting Wizz Air’s customer service? Good luck. Their call centers are either nonexistent or staffed by people who couldn’t care less. Emails go unanswered, complaints are ignored, and if you ever get through, they’ll probably just hang up on you.Final Verdict: Avoid at All CostsFlying with Wizz Air is like playing Russian roulette with your travel plans. If you enjoy stress, frustration, and financial scams disguised as budget travel, then go ahead and book with them. Otherwise, save yourself the nightmare and fly literally any other airline.

title: Wizz Air failing to compensation under (EC) 261/2004 rules
text: Our experience with Wizz Air and the awful experience we encountered.We arrived at the airport on February 6, 2025, at around 5:20 PM for our 8:00 PM flight from Tromso to London Luton (flight W95422). There were no notifications of flight delays, and everything seemed normal. We were called to the gate around 6:30 PM, so we assumed there were no issues.At 7:05 PM, we were first informed of an issue due to weather. The flight had been re-routed to Bodo Airport in Norway for refuelling, but we were told the flight was not cancelled and would be returning later that evening for our journey home. The new estimated departure time was around 10:10 PM. While this was frustrating, everyone was understanding, and we continued to wait, as we appreciated the weather was out of Wizz Airs control and ultimately our safety is of utmost importance.Later that evening, another announcement was made stating the flight would not be returning and had now been cancelled. Passengers were asked to return Duty-Free items, collect luggage, and proceed to the customer service desk for hotel accommodation.We were then kept waiting at the customer service desk for another 2 hours, with the promise that they were organizing accommodation. However, just before midnight at 11:50 PM, passengers were informed that Wizz Air staff were unable to find any hotel availability and that passengers would now need to book their own accommodation and raise a claim to cover the costs.Wizz Air directly lied to passengers. When we phoned Hotel Moxy, they were initially reluctant to take our booking as they said they were holding rooms for Wizz Air (due to the cancelled flight) and were waiting for Wizz Air to call them back to confirm how many rooms were needed. After we informed Hotel Moxy that Wizz Air had told us to book the rooms directly ourselves, they allowed us to make our reservations.The next day, upon returning to the airport for our new flight and seeing the same staff on duty, we decided to re-approach them to question further (and to gain some video evidence). We inquired why they had told passengers they were unable to find accommodation when a local hotel was just waiting for a call back from them to book the rooms. A member of the airport staff confessed that Wizz Air did not book the accommodation because they decided the cost would be too much to pay in one go. When I pushed further and asked what if passengers didn’t have the money to book and pay for a hotel themselves, I was told that some passengers had spent the night at the airport.This is not acceptable. Wizz Air not only kept everyone waiting for an unnecessarily extended amount of time at the airport on the promise they were sorting accommodation, but they also directly lied to customers (just before midnight) saying they were unable to find hotel availability. Wizz Air has a duty of care to passengers and are legally governed by Regulation (EC) 261/2004, but they take no responsibility and were happy to leave passengers stranded at the airport all night to avoid paying hotel costs. It is virtually impossible for passengers to book hotels themselves at that time of night, especially when local hotels were holding rooms for Wizz Air, meaning when passengers called directly to book, there was no availability showing (as rooms were being held for Wizz Air to call back).My family arrived at the airport around 5:30 PM and left at midnight. At no time were we offered any refreshments, and when my husband asked if there was somewhere to fill his water bottle, they pointed him to the toilets, which is unacceptable.Since returning to the UK I have completed all the Wizz Air claim forms and raised my complaint, but all communications have been ignored.  As a result of this, I will allow them until 1st March and will then apply for a County Court Judgement (CCJ) and then subsequently a Third Party Debt Order in order to recover the debt owed to me.I am seeking compensation for cancelled flights, hotel, taxi and food expenses, wasted time at airport and admin time completing multiply Wizz Air claim forms that have been ignored.Just to add, I have phoned, emailed and logged complaints on various occasions, my claim raised on 09/02/2025 ref b9efa7f9 is still showing as open, but all other relating claims ref fd45beab, 04f18382 and 098fcb51 where I’ve specifically asked for updates, have simply been merged and closed down without any update given.  In addition my claim for flight cancellation compensation 9d62e02c and 0833cc54 have just been closed down with weather as an excuse, but other airlines were able to run as per normal, so I don’t believe weather suffices as an excuse not to pay these claims.

We had already booked and paid for the hotel so were tied to Wizz's flight schedule at this point, and had to rebook the flights.The flight went okay, but they continued to send reminders for the wrong airport and flight dates in the run up to the day which caused a bit of panic.It was £14/person to book seats when checking in early otherwise it was a check in 24 hours prior and the seats would be randomly allocated. We left it to chance, having been given seats at least relatively close together (if not together) with every other airline before, but of course Wizz put our 4 seats in different corners across the plane from each other meaning we had to book them at £14/person to be sat close by.We also chose the £2 uplift for 2 of us for the additional legroom and when we got on the plane, these were normal seats and the second row back rather than the first as shown on the seat map when booking. Since contacting Wizz, they're of course denying these were extra legroom and have no answer as to why those seats were £2 dearer (if not for extra legroom). I'm not spending my days arguing over a £2 uplift with them...... but let it be known, Wizz will do everything possible in their power to scam the odd few quid out of you. Our flights might have been cheap but we're now nearly another £100 down from their mistakes. name: Consumer
title: Complaint Regarding Unprofessional Conduct and Baggage Policy Issues
text: Dear Wizz Air Customer Service,I am writing to express my profound disappointment with the experience my family and I had during our recent flights with Wizz Air from Budapest to Jeddah and back. This was our first time flying with your airline, and regrettably, it will likely be our last due to the following issues:Baggage Policy Confusion:I completed the online check-in and purchased Non-Priority tickets, under the impression that a carry-on bag would include a small suitcase, as is common with many airlines. However, upon arrival at the gate, we were informed that only a small backpack (maximum size: 40 x 30 x 20 cm) was allowed without WIZZ Priority. This information was not clearly communicated during the booking or check-in process, leading to unexpected stress and additional charges at the gate.Unprofessional Staff Conduct:At the boarding gate, Wizz Air staff were unaccommodating and, at times, rude. Despite this being a religious journey for many passengers, the staff showed no empathy or willingness to assist. They demanded on-the-spot payments for baggage, with threats of denying boarding if payments were not made immediately. When my father agreed to pay the substantial fee in cash, the staff refused to provide the appropriate change, stating it was our responsibility to have the exact amount. This level of unprofessionalism is unacceptable and does not align with the standards one would expect from an international airline.Timing of the Issue:What exacerbated the situation was that all these complications arose after we had already completed the check-in and passport control processes. At this stage, passengers should be able to proceed to boarding without encountering such issues. Addressing baggage policy discrepancies at the boarding gate, rather than during check-in, is highly inefficient and causes unnecessary stress for passengers.Passenger Left Behind:Alarmingly, one passenger, who had successfully passed through check-in and passport control, was denied boarding at the gate due to issues with his visa being in an old passport. This decision was made despite the passenger having valid documentation and after clearing all prior security checks. Such actions not only cause significant distress but also reflect poorly on Wizz Air’s operational procedures.Recommendations:1.	Clear Communication: Ensure that baggage policies are explicitly stated during the booking and check-in processes to prevent misunderstandings.2.	Staff Training: Provide comprehensive training to staff on professional conduct, cultural sensitivity, and effective communication to handle situations with empathy and respect.3.	Efficient Issue Resolution: Address baggage-related issues at the check-in counter, prior to security and passport control, to avoid last-minute complications at the gate.I hope that by bringing these concerns to your attention, Wizz Air will take the necessary steps to improve its services and prevent such incidents in the future. I look forward to your response and a satisfactory resolution to these issues.

name: Marcostilio La Croix
title: **Review of a Shameful Experience with Wizz Air: Disability Ignored**
text: **Review of a Shameful Experience with Wizz Air: Disability Ignored**My experience with Wizz Air was one of the most humiliating and frustrating I have ever had while flying, and I hope this review can make not only the company but also others who find themselves in similar situations reflect.I travel a lot for passion, but the rigidity of Wizz Air's policies made this trip a true nightmare. The flight in question was on February 10th at 21:25 from Marrakech, Morocco, to Rome, Italy. I am a person with tetraplegia, and in my case, I have absolutely no ability to move independently. Due to a traffic accident, I have undergone several surgeries and have prostheses in my body. This airline automatically assigns window seats to passengers with disabilities, without any possibility of modification. This rigid approach not only fails to consider that every disability is unique, but it is also extremely complicated to mobilize a person weighing 90 kg and standing 1.90 m tall. Often, the operators do not have the experience or skills necessary to handle such situations safely and respectfully. Forcing me into an inadequate seat is not only uncomfortable but also dangerous for my health. I felt treated like a mannequin, and it was humiliating to experience this in front of other passengers.Additionally, upon arriving at the airport, I was assigned to enter the aircraft from the rear. I was lifted by four operators and had to navigate more than 30 steps in this situation, without the necessary precautions. This lack of attention to safety and respect for people with disabilities is unacceptable.A particularly alarming aspect was the handling of my wheelchair with a lithium battery. After following all the indicated procedures, it is unacceptable that I was asked for documentation again once on board! This caused further delays, making the entire experience even more frustrating. Above all, it is a clear security risk that the airline decided to place the lithium batteries in the cargo hold when they should have been transported in the cabin with the passengers. Are we sure that all safety regulations were respected? Was the safety of the passengers put at risk with such negligence?Finally, there is the issue of bathrooms on airplanes. It is unacceptable that a person with a disability like me cannot access a bathroom, or that the facilities are so inadequate for those who genuinely need assistance.Wizz Air must do better. It is time for airlines to begin treating passengers with disabilities with respect and dignity, rather than as a number to be managed in a cold and bureaucratic manner. This has undoubtedly been the most negative experience of my life as a traveler, and I hope my words can lead to change.I hope others can avoid experiencing such a shameful and inhumane situation.

name: Moayad Saeed
title: Feedback on Wizzair.
text: I booked a return flight from Luton airport to Sphinx airport in Cairo, Egypt. Flight No. W9 5318 on 7th Dec 2024. Flight confirmation code: GW78JX. The return flight, from Sphinx to Luton, which was scheduled for 7th Dec., was cancelled and we were stranded in Cairo. Apparently Wizzair doesn’t have a company representative in Sphinx airport, but there is a third party company which does the work for Wizzair.When the return flight was cancelled, the staff in Sphinx airport were VERY really very UNhelpful. They told us lies. They said that they will ‘rebook’ flights for us and we don’t need to do anything. But that was lie. And they said that we will be taken to a hotel and we can stay in the hotel until we can travel back to the UK. That was lie too actually they booked only one night for us in the hotel even though the earliest flight back from Cairo to Luton was 3 day away. We were told that we will have full board in the hotel. That was lie too. Actually Wizzair representatives booked only breakfast for us.So, we (the passengers of the cancelled flight) had to have very long and stressful discussion with the hotel staff to convince them that we need to stay at least 3 days in the hotel and not only one night, then we had to have another extremely stressful talks with the hotel staff just to get meals. All this should have been arranged by Wizzair without our (passengers) involvement. But unfortunately Wizzair representatives didn’t show up at the hotel at all, and we didn’t have any way to communicate with them there in Cairo. We were absolutely stranded in a hotel in a foreign country. We were only able to talk to the hotel staff and the hotel staff used to communicate with the airline via a third party company. We spent about 2 full days talking and demanding our rights to the staff in the hotel who they passed the details to the third party company who in turn passed the details to Wizzair. It was very stressful situation, especially when the hotel staff kept telling us that we need to vacate our rooms and check out, when Wizzair representatives didn’t even respond to the hotel staff, initially. It was the worst experience I have ever had with an airline. And I do travel a lot to different countries with different airlines.Eventually, and after 2 days of very difficult and stressful talks with the hotel staff, Wizzair accepted to extend our stay by 3 days and we were offered breakfast and dinner only (no lunch). Well, that should have been arranged at the beginning when we first arrived at the hotel.In the meantime very big thank you to the hotel staff, who had to bear and handle all this trouble.P.S. on the flight there were families with very young babies who suffered the most as we didn’t know when the hotel staff are going to throw us out just because Wizzair was not responding to the hotel communications.Regarding booking a replacement return flight, that is a whole story by itself. So, I had to pay £92 to buy only a return Wizzair flight back to Luton. Now 1 month has passed and I still haven’t got a refund back from Wizzair, even though I sent Wizzair 2 emails and I filled a claim form. It seems I am going to have to contact the UK AviationADR. Well, but, I have to wait for 8 weeks before I can contact AviationADR. Oh, that is not to mention I lost my National Express Coaches ticket which I was supposed to take at Luton airport on 7th Dec. to take me back home …I will never use Wizzair again, not because of the flight cancellation but because of the way we were treated by Wizzair staff while we were stranded in a foreign country.

title: STAY AWAY FROM THESE SCAMMERS!
text: I had a terrible experience with Wizz Airways. They overbooked the flight by 27 passengers — almost the capacity of another flight — and left us waiting all afternoon on a standby list on 25th September in Skopje. Eventually, they offered to rebook us on another flight the following day and assured us they would cover any travel expenses caused by their overbooking. I had no choice but to accept. The taxi driver from the airport said this always happens with Wizz Air.The next day, I flew back to London from  Skopje in the very early hours of the morning. This disruption completely derailed my business plans in London and caused me a great deal of stress.In September, I submitted my expenses along with all the necessary receipts. After waiting a couple of months and following up several times, I only received a partial reimbursement, not the full amount. Worse, there was no explanation for how they calculated the payment or why I didn’t receive the full reimbursement. It was incredibly frustrating.I filed another claim for the remaining balance, but once again, I was only partially reimbursed. After waiting several more months, I am still owed the outstanding balance they promised to pay. This process has been nothing short of a nightmare.I’ve now submitted another claim, but I fully expect to wait yet another few months and potentially receive nothing at all.Who are these people? What kind of customer service operates like this? They behave like scammers. I strongly advise everyone to stay away from Wizz Airways. They may appear affordable at first glance, but they fail to deliver quality service — both in terms of the flight experience and their handling of expenses.

name: SR
title: Terrorized by Rodents
text: I am posting my review here because Vacasa did not post it on their site.  Our vacation reservation was in May 2025.  When we arrived, the grounds were lovely with lilies and other wild flowers lining the walkway in a secluded neighborhood.  The ocean view radiated a serene atmosphere.  Upon entering the rental, it appeared to be clean with the exception of the window blinds and closet bifold doors.  They had “caked-on” grime.  The shelves weren’t as bad, but still dusty.  However, the kitchen and bathroom sinks and showers were clean.  There were no screens on the windows in the upstairs rooms or living room and kitchen so we weren’t able to air the house out without bugs flying in.  We didn’t realize before renting that it was a three-story home and you had to climb steep stairs either way to get to a bedroom.  It’s an old house and could use some TLC.  Unfortunately, our stay became a nightmare beginning with the first evening.  We noticed after the fact that in 2016, another vacationer wrote a review about how they could hear mice scratching behind the walls. Well, as eyewitnesses there in 2025, the mice were liberated and found their way through the walls. The first night at 11:00 pm, as I was relaxing on one of the couches, I saw a mouse run into the living room.  It saw me and turned around and ran back into the entryway.  I immediately contacted Vacasa that night and they sent pest control out the following day.  The pest control person set some traps in the house and caught two.  We thought we were good to go, but then again around 11:30 pm the next evening while coming out of the downstairs bathroom getting ready to call it a night, I saw a robust mouse run down the stairs heading straight for me.  Looked like it was traveling at lightning speed, almost in flight. Apparently, this was its routine and neither it nor I was expecting to see each other. As it landed, I scared it, it scared me and I saw it make a hard skid in time to slide under the door track right before it could touch my foot. It was quite creepy and traumatizing, sending my bp soaring. I contacted Vacasa, but they offered no solutions.  We are two seniors and it was a 4-hour drive home. Needless to say, we were stuck and didn’t get much sleep.   We left our vacation early.  Vacasa did not check in with us at any time to see if we were okay, offer a partial refund, nothing. The one positive thing is the pest control person. He was very supportive and even gave us his personal number to contact him at any time if we saw another mouse.  Unfortunately, whatever charm the rental first held was ruined by the rodent problem. One would hope Vacasa would at least offer a discount or something for our negative experience.  The price wasn’t cheap.  Since the incident happened, and through many inquiries on our part, Vacasa has still not responded.  We’ve lost complete confidence in renting from Vacasa.
