name: Kristin
title: Vacasa has its positives and negatives
text: Vacasa has its positives and negatives.  Positive is they were very easy to get ahold of when our code to get in our unit was not working.    A new code was sent and we were able to access our unit.   The unit was very clean and we enjoyed our stay!      The negative with Vacasa was their lack of flexibility.    Our daughter was graduating college which is why we booked this home.    Her pinning ceremony was on the day we checked in, 5/2 and it started at 4 pm.    Check in time was at 4 pm.   We asked for an accommodation, early check in, for an hour earlier as we have a dog that could not be taken to the pinning ceremony.    We were told no - the HOA had rules about early check in, which, after staying there I question if there was a HOA at all.     I asked about renting the day before (5/1) and was told I could do that.   The cost was way more than the advertised price on the website - by more than $100.00.   I questioned the higher price and I was told it was due to a cleaning fee.  I told them they didn't have to clean more than once as we would be staying the whole weekend and I was already paying the cleaning fee.    I was told that was the price although the gentleman I was speaking with understood my frustration with the duplicate fees.      I opted to speak with my husband before booking the extra day and got back to Vacasa that very evening via email letting them know I wanted to book the extra day.    I was emailed back that the extra night was no longer available.      I continued to check the website periodically and noted that the unit was advertised as available all the way up through 5/1.    I can only surmise that because I questioned the fees when I first inquired about the extra day, I was blocked from getting the extra day even though I said I would pay the extra fees.     Everything did work out.   I was able to accommodate my dog while we were at our daughter's pinning ceremony.   But it did leave a bad taste in my mouth.  It felt like because I questioned the extra cleaning fees, I was blocked from renting the obviously available home one extra day which would have been additional money to the homeowner of this lovely home as well as Vacasa.

title: Vacasa: Cleanliness Guaranteed Until You Actually Need It
text: I rented a Vacasa property and arrived to find it unclean and clearly not ready for a guest — despite their “hospitality-grade cleanliness guaranteed” policy. I followed their rules and reported the issues within 24 hours with photo evidence. Their response? They told me I should’ve just let maintenance or housekeeping come in during my stay to fix what never should’ve been wrong in the first place.Let me be clear: I booked a vacation, not a cleaning appointment. Their policy says to report issues within 24 hours — I did. It says nothing about being obligated to let staff enter or do anything else to qualify for resolution. They ignored my concerns until I mentioned a chargeback, and only then did they suddenly “escalate” the issue. Too little, too late.To make things worse, at another Vacasa property (currently sitting empty and spotless), they’re refusing to allow early check-in unless “the system generates it.” So I’m literally in the driveway, waiting for a computer to decide I exist.Vacasa talks like a premium hospitality company but acts like a vending machine with attitude. title: Very enjoyable
text: We thoroughly enjoyed this older home during our 8 day stay. With two floors, our family of 6 had lots of room, and we enjoyed the private pool and dock. Although there wasn’t a lot to see when snorkeling around the dock, a tour boat picked us up at the dock for an amazing day of snorkeling elsewhere. The dock was also very suitable for fishing. Our 8 year old had a lot of fun in the pool, but the older kids didn’t spend much time in it because of its small size and shallow depth. The pool and grounds were well maintained. Water pressure in the house fluctuated quite a bit, but was adequate for showering, and we never ran out of hot water. The WiFi wasn’t great, and often my laptop worked better when it was paired to my phone, which had a 2 bar cellular connection. We lost utility power for over an hour one night, but weathered the situation without difficulty. It would have been nice to have had candles available, but they were provided the next day. Our Vacasa concierge Gineli was very helpful in addressing our many questions, and had good tour recommendations. We loved being on Ambergris Caye, with its natural beauty and quaintness, and the fun of driving a golf cart all over the island. Our stay at View the Blue house fit in well with the rest of the experience. Its minor deficiencies were negligible, and we really appreciated the privacy that it afforded us. I would highly recommend this Vacasa rental.

name: Susan Agrillo
title: A Cautionary True Story
text: My boyfriend and I rented a pet friendly house in San Diego for the month of July, 2025 from VACASA on the VRBO platform for over $14,000. Knowing how popular the month of July is, we were being proactive by renting early.Then four months ago, VACASA informed us the house had been sold. They offered us another house which we accepted. A month later, they advised that house was no longer available for some cryptic reason, and they had nothing else in the San Diego area.At this late date, we have had difficulty finding anything suitable. We had made ancillary plans with friends for this time frame, and for my son to visit, as well as plans for a day trip starting in Balboa Park. Now all of these plans have to be revamped. We are now looking at trying to find something in August.A refund has been offered, however in light of the cancellation of both rentals, I am very disillusioned with this platform. It is deplorable that they disregard their contractual obligations.

title: Misleading information and ignored concerns
text: I am writing to file a formal and urgent complaint regarding my current stay at a Vacasa-managed property in Orange Beach, Alabama.Before booking, I contacted Vacasa directly to confirm that the outdoor pool at the property would be open during our stay. I was explicitly told that it would be. This was a critical factor in choosing this condo, as I have stayed here before and booked it specifically for the pool— my small children prefer the pool to the Gulf, and it plays a major role in our vacation experience.We arrived six days ago and were shocked to find out that the pool has been closed for two years. I was misled by your team, and it’s clear now that I was given false information. To say this has disrupted our vacation is an understatement — it has completely altered our plans, frustrated my children, and caused significant disappointment for our family.Since our arrival, I have been in constant communication with Vacasa. Over the past six days, I have received nothing but vague reassurances and empty promises that someone would “follow up.” To this day, I am still waiting. Not only was I lied to before booking, but now my ongoing concerns are being ignored. This is more than poor customer service — it’s gross negligence and a failure to uphold basic accountability to your guests.I have documented proof, including screenshots of the communication, where I asked about the pool and was told it would be open. I am more than willing to share those as part of this complaint.I am requesting a timely and sincere response to this matter, along with an appropriate resolution and explanation. I believe Vacasa has a responsibility to provide accurate information and to address guest concerns with integrity and care. I hope this situation can be handled professionally and fairly, and I welcome the opportunity to share the documentation of our communication to assist in resolving this issue.Edit: to your reply: it is no longer about the pool but your lack of getting back to me and misleading me about the pool. Please take responsibility for YOUR actions not that the pool was closed.

name: LB
title: Stone Wall Mountain - Eureka Springs, AR - JUST SAY NO
text: To say we were disappointed would be an understatement. We had 7 people staying here and everyone was super excited after seeing the pictures etc. of the property. Once we got there and began to bring our things in all that excitement went right out the door when everyone in different parts of the house began seeing things such as multiple holes in the walls, broken chairs, a broken table (with a TV on it no less I might add), broken tile in many different spots (with sharp edges), broken window, missing or broken knobs on the appliances, the back door frame falling down due to wood rot, a nice hole in the front porch roof due to wood rot, the back door handle loose/broke, a “hot” tub with a tarp that looked like it may have been on it but when we arrived we found the tarp in the yard and the “hot” tub was 78 degrees…… and just the overall dirtiness of the place in general.Everyone got a good laugh out of the Vacasa Door hanger we found that stated “This Home has been cleaned to Vacasa Premium Clean standards by our professional local home care team” If this is truly the case then they either hired “blind” cleaning people or Vacasa seriously needs to reevaluate their “Premium Clean Standards” as nothing about the house was clean. The were dead bugs that we cleaned up in many areas around the house on the floor and window seals, spider webs throughout, something that was spilled on the kitchen counter that was sticky, crumbs and food on the couches in the living room, a bathtub that looked like it had hair and mold around the jets, a grill that was flat out disgusting and took us a good 25 mins to clean it before we even wanted to use it to cook on…..basically things that if they had truly cleaned this place there is absolutely no way you would have missed this stuff.We took pictures of many of the items we saw after we checked in and texted them to the Vacasa number only to be told that the “local team” would reach out to us shortly and that they had created a ticket to have the issues taken care of “right away”. We never heard back from anyone locally and they also asked if it was ok for maintenance to enter the home when nobody is there and we told them that was fine. I will add we never heard a word back from Vacasa about the issues reported or from anyone local for our stay so I am not holding out much hope that they will actually address most of this stuff.The sad part about this is the fact that the house has a lot of character, and I feel it could really be a nice place to stay and relax but it truly needs some TLC before it should be rented out again. Numerous items either need to be fixed/repaired or thrown out, I mean come on the dining room table has a chair in plain view where the arm was completely broken by a previous guest and it has a nice screw sticking out of it, the TV is sitting crooked on a table with a broken leg that if you move it away from the couch I am certain it would fall, there is tile in multiple locations with broken and missing pieces including one by the shower that actually has sharp edges and we had to cover it with a towel as we were concerned someone would slice their foot open getting out of the shower.  Numerous holes in the walls, a broken window etc. etc. You get the point…..I am sure this review will not really get much done at the property as it looks like many of these issues have been like this for quite some time…..we even found notes from previous guests complaining about many of these issues quite some time ago yet they obviously were never addressed and/or fixed. The “Manager” responses on previous reviews state that they have taken many of the same things I mention here into account and brought it up with the local operations manager, yet the issues are still here so obviously they don’t care to fix these items. (Here’s an idea…..maybe find a new operations manager?!?!) They also comically state that “We are dedicated to maintaining our homes to the highest standards, and your feedback plays a crucial role in helping us identify areas for improvement“ yet again, nothing looks to have changed with many of these items and from the sounds of it this home has been in need of some TLC and repair for quite some time.I would highly recommend anyone looking to come to Eureka Springs and stay at this property to look elsewhere until Vacasa and ownership seriously investigate fixing things and cleaning this property up.P.S. this same review was sent to Vacasa but they have yet to post it. I find it funny they can respond here within a day, but I posted to their site 3 weeks ago and they have yet to post the review. They also state the same thing over and over in their responses.  "They take the concerns very seriously and the review has been shared with the property manager to address all issues reported"....yet many others have reported the same issues, and they are still not fixed.

title: Nice place
text: Excellent place. We especially liked the layout of the beds in the second bedroom: great for kids. Also loved the hot tub. The primary bedroom could use fewer pillows on the bed. It was nearly impossible to clear the bed for sleeping without creating a fire hazard along the radiator. The primary bathroom shower door seemed to be installed improperly; it was meant to swivel to allow for easier ingress/egress, but it couldn’t be moved without scratching the tile. The checkin policy is unnecessarily dogmatic. Our travel got us there 30 minutes prior to checkin time. I asked for an early checkin, but was denied. We did arrive 30 minutes early and sat in the parking lot. No one entered or exited. We went in right at four. A five star management company would go to the small trouble of checking with the cleaning staff. If they’re already done (as they were in this case), say “yes, no problem”. This obviously makes for a much more positive customer experience.

We did a shrimp boil and had to use 4 different pots, if you want to do a shrimp boil, bring your own big pot.  You need to be careful of the back door.  It has a mind of its own and locks after a certain period of time and we couldn't get the code to work.  You will need to walk around to the front door.  We also couldn't figure out how to turn on the lights on the dock so it made night fishing difficult.  The mushroom lamp in the room with bunk beds has a short in it and need to be replaced or fixed.  Also, we brought our own 2 ply toilet paper and we could have used kleenex .  The items listed are only for the owner to advise renters of.  We will for sure rent this house again.  It's super cute.

name: Biggie G
title: A Deeply Disappointing Stay
text: A Deeply Disappointing Stay – Proceed With CautionWhat was meant to be a meaningful, celebratory weekend for our family turned into a series of frustrations that left us feeling ignored, disrespected, and thoroughly disheartened. I wouldn’t recommend this property to anyone—especially not when there are far better-run hotels and Airbnbs in the area that actually care about their guests’ experience.1. Inflexible and Unaccommodating Staff:We had requested an early check-in, as our daughters were flying in from opposite coasts for a rare and precious family reunion to celebrate both my husband’s and my daughter’s boyfriend’s birthdays. Given that we were also required to check out four hours earlier than usual, we hoped for even the smallest gesture of flexibility. Instead, we were met with robotic, unsympathetic rigidity. No effort was made to work with us or even acknowledge the nature of our request. It felt cold, impersonal, and frankly out of touch with the spirit of hospitality.2. Misleading Listing – No Central Air Conditioning:The listing makes no mention of the fact that the home lacks central air conditioning. In a region known for warm weather, this is a basic amenity guests reasonably expect—especially when the price point suggests a level of comfort and convenience that simply wasn’t delivered. This omission is deceptive at worst, negligent at best.3. Power Outage – Zero Support or Contingency Plan:Midway through our stay, we experienced a power outage that lasted close to six hours. We were left without lights, appliances, functioning bathrooms, or any kind of communication or guidance from the property managers. There was no offer to assist, no resources shared—just silence. For guests paying premium prices, being left to navigate a blackout with no support is unacceptable.4. Appalling Customer Service and Disrespectful Communication:Adding insult to injury, my father received an email from a member of the administrative team that was riddled with typos, poorly formatted, and dripping with condescension. Rather than address our concerns with professionalism and respect, the tone was dismissive and patronizing. It was as though they forgot they were in the hospitality industry altogether.Final Verdict:This was by far the most disappointing vacation rental experience we’ve encountered—and we travel often. The combination of misrepresented amenities, poor communication, inflexible policies, and outright disrespect is inexcusable. If you’re considering staying here, I strongly encourage you to look at one of the many hotels or other Airbnbs in the area. You will almost certainly receive better service, clearer communication, and a more hospitable environment elsewhere. This property simply isn’t worth the headache.

text: This trip was important to us for personal reasons. The purpose of this special 5-day stay was to get away, forget the issues we are facing and relax. title: BED BUGS! Amazing stay turned horrible with extremely disappointing corporate support!
text: It started with a seemingly normal stay in Mammoth Lakes, CA (Meadow Ridge 37 (VRBO Property # 2451906)): easy check-in, property well-maintained, no issues! Everything you’d expect from a corporate conglomerate of VRBO and Vacasa Property Management. We arrived on Wednesday and stayed till Sunday for a ski weekend.On Friday morning, some folks in our group started noticing hives and rashes on their bodies. We just figured it was environmental - maybe brushing up against some pine, maybe pollen, or something they ate. Everyone was itchy and took plenty of OTC meds, but limited help.On Sunday morning, we proceeded to start the check-out process and discovered bed bugs under one of the mattresses!! We squished a few of them and noticed blood coming out of them - which was our rudimentary validation of what caused the hives….they were indeed bed bug bites.We called VRBO and Vacasa and were told that we can evacuate the property and the local team would come check on the situation and give us a call to discuss next steps.It’s been over a week at this point. Limited to no communication from Vacasa, VRBO threw up their hands and said it wasn’t their problem, and now we’ve been punted off to 2 different companies (Sedgwick and Rental Guardian)….with little to no actual communication or response.Honestly, we’re just looking for a little courtesy in letting us know how to navigate this situation and playing fairly given a lot of inconvenience, very likely bed bug infestation in our clothes and homes, and really bad daily medical issues. It seems as though Vacasa and VRBO are not interested in taking this situation seriously and really dropping the ball, in addition to blatantly breaking their respective terms and conditions - which articulate “clean and safe” stays and properties.I’m hoping this post will get someone’s attention that can help work through our situation. To date, the only people we’re aware of that are involved are the Assistant Manager for Vacasa in Mammoth Lakes) and Qualified Manager, CA license #2B88261 who is part of Sedgwick Claims Management Services, Inc., CA license #2549023).

name: Adam Mott
title: Vacasa - False Advertisement
text: We booked Sunflower Unit 111 in Steamboat Springs for our winter vacation. We chose this unit because of its slope side location and the Vacasa Shuttle Service that was advertised as being included. Prior to booking we confirmed the shuttle service was in fact included, and we confirmed again prior to making our final payment. Having stayed in Steamboat with Vacasa the year before, we knew how important the shuttle was with 2 toddlers. With a rental car not an option for us Floridians because of the snowy roads, Ubers not an option because of the lack of car seats, and the city bus not a great option because more often than not it requires long walks from the closest bus stop to our actual destination as well as wait times for the bus alongside busy roads in the snowy freezing elements - there isn’t a reasonable alternative to the shuttle when traveling with small children. That is why the shuttle was so important to us and our 10 day vacation, and one of the main reasons we booked this unit at this elevated price. When we arrived, we contacted the shuttle so we could go get groceries, and we were informed that the shuttle service was no longer offered. We called Vacasa customer service and requested to speak with a local manager to try and find a fair solution. We shared screenshots of our text and email communications with Vacasa that clearly documented the service as included. We were told multiple times, via multiple follow up calls that we would be contacted by someone local, but that never happened. We called and emailed each day, for the first 3 days of our stay, until it was evident there was not going to be a fair resolution. Vacasa did email us on the 4th or 5th day of our stay to inform us that they were going to credit us $180 for the inconvenience, and as a result, they were closing out the complaint. As a result of Vacasa’s handling of this we were forced to find private transportation, and my wife and I had to split up to take Ubers for grocery runs etc., and use the City bus when appropriate as a family. The cost of the private transportation and Uber rides were over 10x the credit that we received. We would have never booked this rental had the shuttle service been accurately advertised, and had the reservation agents not confirmed its inclusion. At over $1,000 per night, we could have stayed at many other accommodations with this service. We’ve stayed with Vacasa 6+ times over the last few years, and this experience was the reason we will not stay with Vacasa again.

title: Loved Las Cascadas House #3
text: We stayed at a resort on our last trip to Cancun, but, we needed a bigger space this year because of the size our group.  Renting the Las Cascadas House #3 worked out great! text: Within 20 minutes of entering the rented property, I contacted Vacasa to request a different accommodation or return of my payment. The front doorway was dirty. There was a dumpster right outside the building overfilled with garbage and discarded mattresses. The ceiling must be thin as I could hear the upstairs neighbors walking around. I called Vacasa immediately upon noticing these issues and they stated a local manager would be there in about an hour to confirm the problems. We waited almost 3 hours but no one showed up. I called Vacasa again and informed them I was leaving immediately because of the condition of the place. No return call for 4 days! Then they offered 50% off for a place I couldn't stay at because it was gross. They don't communicate well and ignore they listed a place with substandard level of cleanliness. Finally, they sent me a page to review the place and when I submitted my negative review, they didn't post the text of my review; they did post there were 4 reviews (only the text of the 3 better reviews were posted!) I wonder how many negative reviews are removed which is VERY misleading to the public! Update: The 50% off is NOT sufficient. Keep in mind they offered 50% because I "abandoned the property (I left because of the condition of the place). Remember, they stated a representative would be there in an hour (we waited 3 hours and no one came). Vacasa did not provide a clean place to stay. Essentially, they did not provide the service that any renter expects (a clean place). Be careful! If the place is not clean, they will still charge you for the place.

name: Alan Goodno
title: Avoid Vacasa – Terrible Customer Service and Misleading Listings
text: We recently rented a home in Colorado through VRBO, but it was managed by Vacasa, and we had an absolutely awful experience. An unexpected snowstorm made it impossible to reach the property on our check-in night, so we found alternative accommodations. When we reached out to Vacasa, they assured us the driveway would be plowed that night. The next morning, we arrived to find the driveway completely untouched, buried under more than 9 inches of snow.Vacasa then told us that with a proper 4x4 vehicle, we could access the home—something that was not mentioned in the VRBO listing. Buried in the fine print of an email sent days before check-in, they included this requirement, but even with a 4x4 vehicle, the property was inaccessible. Their solution? Park at the top of the hill and walk down. This was completely unrealistic, as there was no safe parking, and we were traveling with elderly family members (ages 82 and 81). Asking them to navigate an unplowed hill in the snow would have been reckless.The customer service was shockingly unhelpful. Instead of finding a reasonable solution, they refused to take responsibility, claiming they have no control over what is posted on VRBO—an absolutely absurd excuse. This is a classic bait and switch.We ended up securing alternative, safe accommodations outside of Vacasa, and we will never book with them again. If you're considering renting through them, don't. If you're a homeowner thinking about listing with them, think twice—they do not care about guests and provide little to no support when issues arise. Terrible experience, terrible company.

title: Great unit at kona bali kai #207
text: Great unit at kona bali kai #207The top things we liked about this unit was the location and the spectacular view from the second floor balcony. We spent a lot of time on the balcony listening to the ocean, watching the waves roll in and crash onto the shore, watching the surfers, and watching the beautiful sunsets. You can leave the balcony doors open and listen to ocean as you fall asleep at night.Access to the unit was great. It is located between two sets of stairs and there is an elevator by the stairs to the right.Your initial entry is by an electronic keypad type lock. Once in you will find a physical key you can take along so you don't have to enter a 10 digit code each time you enter the unit.There is both outdoor and indoor (under the complex) parking. Two parking passes are provided with this unit.The unit itself was very clean and comfortable.The unit has a king size bed and there is plenty of drawer space so you can unpack your suitcases and get them out of the way. The kitchen is well equipped and has sufficient supplies for four guests. The unit has a new (at least looks like) washer dryer combo, and it very quiet.The unit is located in a great location with easy access to the downtown area and shopping. You are probably two or three miles from downtown kona so most people will need a car to get there. There is a safeway supermarket a few miles away.The complex does have a pool and spa which we didn't use however they looked very inviting. We saw others using both. They are surrounded by a fence with a locked gate where you need the token on the room key ring to get in.I highly recommend this unit to people traveling to the kona area, especially if you want an ocean front room. I don't know if or when i'll return to kona, but if i do i'll be certain to check the availability of this unit.

title: Rented a house in ski country, NH
text: Rented a house in ski country.  Had no heat in half the house for 2.5 days.  That portion of the house was 54 degrees.  Attempted to call customer service on the first night.  I was given the run around until I finally told them I was going to post a horrible review for them.  Then the local manager who had been monitoring the conversation called me and scheduled a maintenace guy to come out the next day.  We had to meet him and he arrived at 11:15 AM so half a day was wasted.  Turns out the furnance zone was broken.  So we spent another cold day and night and the repair guy came out and fixed it at noon the next day.  Then I read a previous review posted 6 days before our arrival which clearly indicated that there was a problem with the furnance and they had bought fire wood to keep the place warm enough for their weekend.  We also bought firewood to keep the place warm enough.  I contacted Vacasa and asked for one day of our rental refunded because we had to deal with a problem that they knew they had and we had to spend our own money on firewood, not to mention losing half a day of our trip so that we could meet the maintenance guy.  Took a while to get a response and when I finally received on they only refunded $100.  The rental was in the high $200 a night.  The $100 refund is ridiculous.  We were in northern NH and had we not gone out of our way to get the heat fixed the pipes would have frozen in the kitchen (it was very cold at night). That and they knowingly rented a house that didn't have a fully working furnance.  Unreal.  There were also many broken items in the house including the coffee maker in an area with no close coffee shops.  Just stems from poor management.  I will never rent a vacasa house again....never.  They need to get their act together.

title: The unit was comfortable but…
text: The unit was comfortable, but we had several issues. First off, someone was parked in our garage spot (which was very difficult to park in because of the location in the garage and very tight space).  We eventually ran into the person and kindly asked them to move. We never received a call back from “local management,” to address the problem. It was in the negatives outside, so we really wanted to park indoors.  Secondly, the code given to enter the unit did not work, so Vacasa gave us the code for the entire building to enter the unit, and that did not feel secure. Thirdly the stove kept tripping the breaker when cooking. Additionally, normal cooking kept making the fire alarm go off, which was loud and frustrating. Finally, the fire place made a loud noise, so we kept it off. We only got one call back about the stove, and it was 7 hours after we alerted Vacasa.  We will not rent this unit again until we know these issues have been resolved.

title: Terrible experience, false info in rental posting, zero help from Vacasa
text: Electronic lock would not work. We stood in the freezing cold for over 10 minutes while we tried to talk the Vacasa rep into giving us the manual combination.  This was at the emergency number that was provided for instant communication, but obviously the representatives were not on or near the site.We arrived after a snowstorm, but the 30 steps up to the home had not been cleared or lit to allow for safe passage. We asked the emergency reps why the steps were not cleared and were unsafe, and they could not answer, stating that we would have to ask the folks in the local office.Ad said the home was “ski in/ski out” and we were very disappointed to find that it was not. We had to drive up and down the mountain, as we could have done with a much cheaper rental.  Very misleading and false advertising. Vacasa says ski and ski out which means you are next to the slopes, it does not apply in this situation as you cannot ski across the road and between the other houses that are actually skiing/ski out. They have signs that say that people cannot cut through because they are private. Therefore, there is no access, thus they are not “skiing/ski” homesSomeone else was parked in our single designated parking space for two days in a row. We could not park there so we contacted the emergency number. Had a long text conversation with representatives who would not call for a tow company, kept referring our concern to the “local office” (which closed on Friday and would not reopen until Tuesday), and told us we could not call for a tow truck ourselves. The emergency reps were not helpful at all.We also tried to contact the local office multiple times as well, but no one would call us back and they have no one responding for emergency or urgent needs. We continue to call back Vacasa’s emergency  support line and they said the local office was aware and would respond directly. We waited out for 48 hours for responses to multiple calls to the emergency lineWe then left a day early, as Vacasa couldn't guarantee we would have a parking spot at the unit we rented on top of the mountain, the emergency number representative told us to just drive into town, park at the grocery store parking lot and then figure out how to get back up.One of the emergencyrepresentatives told us to contact the Sugar Mountain staff because it was an official sugar Mountain no parking sign, but the person we were directed to contact responded and later emailed and told us they no longer worked thereVacasa said they would give no refunds or reimbursement and that there was no guarantee it was a ski in/ski out rental (but acknowledged that their site said it was) and also that there was no guarantee of parking, even though the site said it had one reserved space. They told me that if parking was not available, we needed to go a mile into town, park at the grocery store and find our own way back.My Vacasa experience was horrible, they continue to have lies about amenities and location of the house on the ad, and refuse to help. We still have not received a call from anyone 5 days later.Vacasa has repeatedly said they have no refund policy even though they did not deliver anything close to the experience promised.  It’s a shame that they can just lie and fail to support the safety and access of their customers and withhold money by hiding behind excuse after excuse.

title: Scummy company that robs its customers
text: Don't take OurBus if you think there's any chance of you having to cancel your bus. In 2019 I had to cancel a couple tickets for another passenger not being able to go due to a family emergency. Instead of a refund, OurBus gives you credits for future bus rides. Okay, other public transportation services give out full refunds so not ideal, but fine. When the credits were issued to me they stated that their policy was the credits DO NOT ever expire. I figured I'd use their services again in the future and kept tab of my credits.Fast forward to this week. I finally had a reason to take the bus again and went to use my credits. Surprise, surprise-- they were gone. I thought it must have been a mistake in my account and reached out to customer service, only to be told that their policy changed and that credits are only valid for 5 years after being issued. Despite the policy being different when I was given my credits, they refused to grandfather me in or give back any of my $100 worth of credits. Wouldn't even extend the expiration date to 5 years from when the policy changed. Would not budge or work with me at all despite me being a regular customer in the past.So basically I had $100 stolen from me. No services rendered, no refund given, and no credits to be seen. Not sure who was in charge of this terrible policy, but it definitely ensured that I will never ever be using OurBus again. I'd warn others about their scummy policy so they don't leave other customers high and dry.Edited to add: read the company's reply below for exhibit A. Don't be shocked if they suddenly change their new 5 year policy to be even shorter at the end of the 4th year so they can just pocket your money without providing their service. Clearly if I had known OurBus would not honor its policy I would have just filed a chargeback on my card while I could. Buyer beware: there is zero reason to trust this company or its word.

The driver confirmed that he was working with OurBus, and she even received a call from OurBus while she was in the taxi.The driver issued her a receipt and advised her to contact OurBus for reimbursement. However, when she got to her dorm and called OurBus, they claimed that the taxi she took was not affiliated with them and refused to process the reimbursement. She explained that the driver had verified her OurBus confirmation number and even provided a receipt, but they continued to insist that he was not associated with their company.She attempted to contact the taxi driver, but he did not respond. After I responded with "yes," the chat sent me the tailored amount of my refund (minus the fees). I thought the process was completed. When I didn't receive written confirmation of my cancellation via email, I communicated with the chat again and this time a live person took over and informed me that I was not eligible for a refund or even a credit, because I missed the time deadline to cancel and I did not follow the steps to cancel. So even though the chat provided me with a refund amount and did not provide any further clear instructions, I the customer must take full blame and lose $51. The company doesn't have enough courtesy to provide at least a credit for a future ride. This company is desperate. I WILL NEVER USE THEIR SERVICES EVER AGAIN IN LIFE.

title: I have been reading a lot of negative feedback…
text: I have been reading a lot of negative feedback here about Cardelmar. But I think people mistake the services of Cardelmar which only is to provide a voucher with a cheaper fare to any rental car company they deal with and an insurance to cover the franchise in case of damages to the vehicle, and the car rental company itself. If I'll be late to pick up the car I assume I have to make contact with the rental car company, their phone number is written in the voucher. By instinct if I'm presented with a company I don't know, I will check the reviews on the internet or rent from the major ones where I know they will be professional. Cardelmar stipulate on their contract that any extra insurance fee from the rental car company can be declined because they cover the insurance part. The one company you need to be careful of is the rental car company itself, and avoid the ones you don't know. I have been using their service for 3 years, 2 times renting a car in the Netherlands, one in Spain and one in Sicily. In Sicily, someone through a ball or kicked the side of the car and left a dent, and driving the awful roads full of holes and bumps of Sicily damaged the tires and the wheels. Well, when we gave the car back, the agent of Locautorent who is the intermediary for Alamo pounced at the wheels first and said they were considerably damaged, it was like he knew right away where the car would be hit. after a useless argument that one would consider it is the normal use of the car in that part of the country, with the dent on the side, they charged me 980€. I was really thinking that if some other car rental company would try to make me pay more than the voucher, Locautorent found the good way to make you pay much more. It was like being cheated and helpless. Back home I called Cardelmar and the lady on the phone said they knew locautorent was known for this practice. She also said I was fully covered with the insurance I took with them and after sending all the appropriate papers, I should get a refund. All of this happened on Sept. 20, 2020. I received an email yesterday saying that everything was OK and I'll get the refund within 21 days. To conclude, to my knowledge Cardelmar are good and competitive, and they do their job providing a better rate than directly with the car rental company. We have to keep in mind small rental companies will try their best to make more money out of you. Sticking to the majors will surely leave you out of trouble even if they are a bit more expensive.

name: Ly
title: Hard to reach, slow and difficult cancelation
text: People, save yourself some hassle. The price is too good to be true right? See until they bite you.Here is what happened:- Booked a car online (with Thrifty via AutoEscape/Caldermar)- Tried to change the reservation, emailed AutoEscape, no reply for two weeks- Called Thrifty, they said NO RESERVATION for OUR NAME in the day we booked.- Tried to call them via several phone numbers (NL, UK, DE), all of their phone deactivated. Seriously.- Checked online that AutoEscape is part of Caldermar, so I submitted complain to Caldermar- Being called back, with 'Unknown number' phone number.- At this time I had enough, I want to cancel the reservation. The guy said yes he can cancel the reservation without fee. But first confirm it with Thrifty.- My ticket being closed, saying that Thrifty confirmed my reservation and will send me reservation code to my email and call me back.- No email received, but there's lady from Thrifty called me. However, the price is different (the extra kms is 600% more than agreed upon. Yes, 7 times more), plus extra pick up fee.- Didn't agree with that, so I went back to the ticket. The ticket has already been closed, I can't reopen it unless I call customer service or send an email. Can't make new ticket.- I sent an email to 'contact' and 'klantenservice' , none replied until now. The second one give me an error delivery failure notice.Seriously, this is still half of the hassle. Brace yourselves.- I called the customer service, asked to get ticket reopened- Ticket was reopened- I entered detail asking for change of booking- Ticket was closed, saying they can't help- I called the customer service, asking just simply to refund all the money- The guy said it's ok, he will refund the money without any cost- The money was refunded, but NOT in full- I called the customer service, they say can not help to reopen the ticket, I need to send an email to those email address. Why? Somebody else did reopened the ticket without email conversation.- He admitted that the administration fee should have not charged to me, but he can't help so I need to send an email (which never replied/gives error, see above)- At this time I got a bit fed up.  I explained the problem again, I was angry, I was firm but I made sure I didn't shout, that was hard. I said maybe it's easier to just claim the insurance via credit card.- He closed the phone call. Seriously. I dont remember the name but I called on 23 of February around 10.30, reference number is stated below.- I took a deep breath, called them back. He said he will send me an email that I can reply.I'm still waiting. I will keep you guys updated.UPDATE 1:- Didn't receive any reply until afternoon- Called customer service, after reading my ticket, this guy explained that I need to pay admin fee (duh!). So I explained why I think I do not need to pay admin fee, and two of his colleagues confirmed that they agreed on that.- So, basically I asked firmly, what was the chance of me getting full reimbursement? If the chance is too low, I will just try to save more hassle and call the credit card company since I have insurance for this. He explained that I will have high chance of getting my money back and he'll help me to write a note to 'klantenservice' about the problem. This guy was helpful.- After several hours, I got my ticket reopened and they asked my IBAN for the reimbursement of admin fee (finally.. at least, almost finally)- So I sent it to them and wait for reply.PS : Guys, if you purchase something too cheap to be true, please use credit card, at least you are entitled to insurance. It seems that the credit card company have more power and authority.Still waiting for my money back, will add update if I receive something.

title: So far always a good experience!
text: I have rented cars at Cardelmar 6-8 times over the last two years. The car rental involved has been either Europcar or Avis, and I have picked up and returned the car in Munich.My car renting has every time worked out very well! That is of course partly due to the good work of Europcar/Avis, but I am also very satisfied with the services of Cardelmar:**The homepage is easy to use and provides you with useful filter functions. The types of cars I’m looking for are more or less always available, even when booking on short notice. Somehow, prices provided are also reasonably stable.**I’ve so far never had any bad surprise, when picking up the car. A car from the ordered category (or better) has always been there, and there has not been any misunderstanding about the time period of the booking. I never needed to pay any more than the price announced by Cardelmar. (By the way, the attitude from Europcar/Avis staff was so far extremely professional. No attempts to make my rental more difficult/expensive, because I did not book the car directly with them.)**I always choose the “Coverage without excess” insurance. In my experience this insurance from Cardelmar is substantially cheaper than buying it directly from Europcar/Avis.When renting last time I damaged the car by parking clumsily in a narrow parking house. This meant, that I, for the first time, had some use of my insurance. My experience:**Most important: I quickly got the money, which I had to pay to the car rental, back – within a week after providing the receipt to Cardelmar, the money was paid out!**Clear instructions on what I needed to provide to Cardelmar. Staff was efficient and friendly. I called Cardelmar three times, and every time got through very quickly to an attendant (in comparison it was ‘mission impossible’ to call Europcar’s customer service…)**The technical interface (homepage / call center) was less impressive, though. The routine to open a ticket at Cardelmar’s homepage did not work. OK, when calling, a friendly attendant did it manually for me, but it was still a bit annoying. Some links to essential information at the homepage did not work. When calling, the dial-in menu I had to go through before getting connected to the attendant was not logical at all.SUMMARY: I am very satisfied with Cardelmar, and will for sure continue using them! To make a good experience even better, they could improve/correct a few things in the technical interface, though.

title: DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY - Go direct to the car rental company.
text: Just back from a holiday to Sardinia after using Car del Mar. I stupidly didnt read the reviews before using Car del Mar and just went on the cheapest price on a comparison website. I booked the car 4 days before travelling.Here is a comprehensive list of what went wrong:1. The website didnt work so i couldnt enter my details online.2. When i called up and booked the car, the gentleman on the other end got my email address wrong so i didnt get my confirmation email until  the day of travel when i phoned up to check. I appreciate that this can happen but the mistake wasn't one letter wrong it was a completely wrong email address which given i had spelt it out to the operator twice was disappointing.3. The price quoted on the website was £141, I asked for a sat nav as well which they said was £28 but they said they wouldn't charge me until i got there as they needed to speak to the local team to confirm if they had one. Checking my credit card statement before i left they had charged me £159 (the invoice they sent didn't itemise the costs) so i can only assume they had already included the fee. Once i arrived at the car hire place at the airport, the actual rental company i was renting from said that CardelMar hadnt contacted them about the sat nav. Thankfully they had one spare in the office but they charged me £28 so i paid twice which is fun! (Looking at the other comments and experiences i will try to chase this as a refund but do not hold out any hope!)4. As with some of the earlier posts you will read be very aware that Car del mar is a broker NOT the actual rental car company. What this means is that if you get insurance with Car del mar and had an accident, the local rental company would make you pay them for the damaages and then you would have to claim this back from car del mars insurance. Thankfully i didnt have an accident but if i did i may have ended up having to pay a lot of cash up front and then having to go through a pretty laborious process judging from the other experiences to get my money back much later.  Whilst this fact is in your insurance contract i think it is not very clear at all and if it wasnt for the fact i work in insurance and know what to look for then i wouldnt have spotted it.Because of what i read about the company and its insurance policy i actually bought the rental cars company own insurance (£30) for peace of mind as i didnt fancy being significantly out of pocket.Overall my recommendation would be go direct to the car rental company rather than use this middlemen as they are not good at all.They may come up as the cheapest but i would avoid them if you can afford it.
