(in other words, pay for another insurance)A short walk to the car park, I had to wait in yet another queue so that I could be given a car. The staff miserable and unhelpful. The fuel policy with Sicily by car is to take it full and return it full. It was not full when I took it; but I didn't fancy waiting in a queue to try and explain this to someone who is not interested.On returning the vehicle, there was no petrol station near and I ended up taking the car back with exactly the same amount of fuel as I had received it. When the staff member inspected the car, after I waited in a queue, she told me that the car was not full and she will have to charge me 28 eros plus the amount to top up the car. Luckily, I took a picture of the dashboard with the mileage and amount of fuel so she altered her paperwork to reflect this.(I wouldn't be at all surprised if money is taken from my credit card though!)All in all, it all seemed very chaotic and Sicily by car staff could do with some customer service training although i'm sure they are not in the slightest bit interested.

name: Paul Berwick
title: Could be better
text: We was given a car which the air conditioning did not work but only found this out during our hour drive to our house in Italy sweating like mad. Made a phone call the next day and was told that we had to return to the airport to change obviously incurring petrol and toll road cost. Was not given a choice as a car would not of been driven to us. Once I changed the car  had no problem.  Desk staff was friendly and helped

name: GEL
title: Awaiting refund of deposit
text: The car hire was smooth and hassle free (despite being expensive - Sardinian price hikes). However, we were promised a refund of the £520.54 on the evening of car return and 48 hours later this has still not been recieved.

name: Jody Dale
title: Super service
text: Very easy to book, excellent service on collection and dropping off car. Would recommend.

name: Jasper
title: Easy experience
text: Collecting and returning the car was very straight forward. All details are explained and the rental was full to full.

name: Roberto Scaffardi
title: Car Del Mar hire car
text: We hired a car from Pisa airport with Car Del Mar though at the airport they were called Sicily by Car.Car was fine and drop off was fine but had to queue for over an hour at Pisa Airport when collecting the car. All the other car hire companies had much smaller queues and this was by far the longest I have ever waited to collect my hire car.

name: Kevin M
title: No problems, as long as you're realistic - this is a budget company.
text: I was a little wary after seeing some other reviews of Sicilybycar, but my experience at the Florence airport location was very positive. The car was actually slighter better than the one I expected, with no change in price. The staff were polite and spoke excellent English (I wish my Italian was that good).There were some small scratches/dents to the back of the car, but an agent was on hand close by to check these over and amend the contract accordingly - as long as you're sensible and check the car before leaving this shouldn't be an issue. The car ran perfectly throughout my trip.Additionally (as I've seen in other reviews) the car was a bit dirty on pickup, but for about €50-75 cheaper than the competition you'd have to be an idiot to complain about this - just spend €5 and take it through a car wash if you're that finicky!All in all I would recommend Sicilybycar if you're a sensible traveller who's looking for a cheaper option.

name: Ian Douglas
title: Ridiculously long wait for our car!
text: We chose CarDelMar based on price but it was a false economy.Arriving at Brindisi Airport at about 10am in the morning, we joined a queue of people with only one person serving.Finally, someone else joined them but it took a good hour to be served.They then directed us to the cars where somebody would meet us with the keys. Nobody was there for about 20 minutes.Once we got into the car, we realised there was no Sat Nav (which we'd requested). Went back to the office where we were told that they didn't have any. No apologies or anything.The car itself was fine and the return drop off went smoothly but I'd rather pay more in future to a more reputable company.

name: Lynn Evans
title: Beware booking cheaper cars on line!
text: I booked a 7 seater car with full insurance cover (I thought).   On arrival it appeared I only had a 5 seat car booked (the incorrect code was inputted by Car Del Mar).   Fortunately (it was 11.00pm) there was a 7 seat available.   Europcar informed me that the insurance was not full insurance and if did have an accident I would have to pay for everything and then claim the money back.   This is not made clear on the booking form and needs to be in black and white.  Since I was concerned abut the insurance I then had to take further insurance out with Europcar.  The whole experience cost me an additional 521 euros - in retrospect it would have been much cheaper booking direct with the provider.  I am still awaiting reimbursement for Car del Mar who tell me it can take up to five weeks in busy periods.

name: Rebecca, London
title: Uncomplicated Car Hire
text: The booking system was uncomplicated and easy to do on-line.  We had no problem with the car or the returns procedure even though our flight was earlier than their opening times.  Only minor grouch was they are so popular that there was a very long queue for pick up!

name: John Pearson
title: As described, but slow service
text: Relatively painless booking once all the small print found and read. Check in VERY slow at desk. 3 people behind desk but only 2 actually serving customers. Clients in front clearly had issues with their bookings which meant a half hour wait until we were served. Thank goodness there was no queue !Car as described but obviously visible damage not marked on paperwork.

name: Alban Brindle
title: Poor service - avoid
text: Started out by having to wait over one and a half hours at the rental desk.Also the car was damaged on receipt and I am being charged for this.Company best avoided.

name: John Romero
title: Poor
text: The first staff member that served me was very unhelpful however his manager then got involved and was very good.  I returned the car yesterday and now it seems I've been hugely overcharged.  I'll call Hertz directly but i have to say Im not surprised.

name: Barksy
title: very easy. polite and punctual service
text: It was difficult to find the mini bus from the airport when we first arrived.  I flagged the bus down in the car park. The guy was helpful and friendly. The car hire centre is 10 mins from airport which isnt clear on first booking page this needs changing. But the car was magic. Clean, in excellent working order and ready to go. Hiper were laid back, spoke good english and didn't try and sell me extras. A quick demo of the car would have been nice as it was a Fiat and dual transmission and it kept talking to me in spanish and had no idea how to change it to english. But was a joy to drive. On drop off it was easy to find and quick to check out. I arrived early and they were happy to help.The minibus arrived in 5 mins and dropped us off right at the airport door.a good experience as I was apprehensive from other reviews id read. Would use again. good job!

name: Tim Oakes
title: Overall good experience, but unresponsive to email inquiries
text: We had no difficulties with CarDelMar, but when we needed to make adjustments to our booking, they never replied to our emails and were difficult to reach by phone.  Ultimately I reached them but not without several persistent attempts

name: Stephen Williams
title: Holiday
text: Wasn't happy they took money from my account thought the card was just to hold

name: Reto Gräflin
title: Flight delay, no car !
text: Car Del Mar has arranged a rental agreement with Gold Car. Unfortunately our flight was overbooked. Only when I was outside the airport, I was able to contact Car Del Mar Hotline, which was only after agreed pick-up time. Car Del Mar refused any assistance. I should have informed them immediately. This is an absolute no go. Never again with Car Del Mar !PS: We've contacted the rental company, they confirmed that it will not be easy to keep the car reserved until tomorrow, but the clerk was talking to his boss who has now managed to hold the car reserved at Palma de Mallorca for us ! That's what I call service, Car Del Mar only takes money, nothing else.

name: Kevin Brown
title: Easy and best value
text: Easy to use and was the best value

name: H M Lewis
title: easy rental
text: friendly and helpful staff,car good value for price we paid.Only criticism is lack of instructions on line as to where to pick car up from area P4 was not mentioned.

name: Jens Wulsten
title: Dubrovnik
text: Everything was perfect, young, friendly crowd at the counter.

name: Richard Lee
title: Mallorca hire car
text: Overall very good, took out the fully comprehensive insurance, and fuel full to full option, and still a reasonable deal.  Some hassle confirming the level of insurance,  but all ok in the end, and all detailed on web site.  Actual car was from Hiper car in Palma, very good service and new clean car provided, with no hard sell for additional insurance.I would use them again.

name: Dan Hodgson
title: Booking was easy, but car hire company had no record of us!
text: Site seemed cheap and easy to use. However upon arriving at Faro airport, the car hire company AutoRent, had no record of our booking. After a nervous 10 mins, and lots of phone calls it was sorted!Not sure if an issue with Cardelmar or Autorent so 4 stars

name: Christopher Simms
title: Beware the Car Company
text: We booked through CarDelMar who for their part were fine- booking was simple and I was able to contact them easily when the card payment was problematic.However the Car Hire company SICILY BY CAR are complete con artists. When picking up the car (fiat 500) there were two large paint defects which were not marked on the paperwork as already present. We found a worker who said don't worry about them its ok but eventually marked them off as present on the paperwork. It was a very 'its ok no problem attitude'. So we used the car very carefully for the next 6 days which was fine. When returning the car the same worker said there was new damage to the car we had made. A very small 5 cm rubber mark which we believe was probably already there. However he said 'don't worry the insurance will pay for it'.When arriving at the desk the guy said' so you have to sign here and pay 800 euros which you can then claim back off CARDELMAR for the collision/accident you've had! We couldn't believe it we felt that they were trying to con us. So I picked up a cloth and some spray from the bucket on the floor, went back to the car, and removed the rubber mark easily in one minute!We then insisted the desk guy came back to see the 800 euro collision- which wasn't even there. We were then refunded our 800 euros which barely an apology.I seriously think that CARDELMAR should remove this company.CARDELMAR please email me if you wish for any further details.Many ThanksCat Ross & Chris Simms.Please

name: millerista
title: frustrated by being sold insurance I couldn't use, and having the buy a insurance a second time
text: I was not at all impressed by CarDelMar.I arrived a the car hire partner at Heathrow (which isn't actually at Heathrow. Its about a mile outside the main airport. It took me about half an hour to work out how to get to the hire place, and then a further 20 minutes to make the journey) thinking all costs were covered by the fcat I had bought inclusive insurance as part of the package. When I arrived, I was told I needed a credit card to cover the deposit of £1250. I don't have a credit card and was not aware this was required unitl I arrived. I was then advised I could ring up CarDelMar and cancel the insurance part, then taking out insurance with the local partner and avoid the need for a credit card. CarDelMar didn't pick up the phone (I was on hold for over 10 minutes) so I was forced to pay again for new comprehensive insurance from the local provider.Once you arrive at the car hire place and have made plans (my friends mother was waiting at a train station for me to pick them up in my hire car) you are basically a captured market. Faced with walking away, leaving my friends mother at the train station and not being able to arrive at the location for whcih I had booked the car - or pay again - I paid again.I have checked the terms and conditions in the invoice and voucher sent to me my CarDelMar and can find nowhere any reference that rules out the use of visa debit cards as a means of setting down a deposit. There is also no reference to the fact that I could take along cash in its stead.I wouldn't recommend CarDelMar to anyone.

name: Christian
title: Everthing okay!
text: No problems, everything perfect!

name: Eva
title: All great
text: Everything was as expected - we got the car we booked, was in good condition, baby seat was available - everything went smoothly and fine. Would recommend to anyone.

name: Suhail Khan
title: You get what you book !
text: I rent very often and this time it was after quite a while that there were no hidden surprises at the rental desk. My hire was in Bastia, Corsica and the company was Citer which I guess was operated by Enterprise. The pick-up was quick (although I arrived a little earlier than my booking time so had to wait a little before the car was ready but still picked it up earlier than scheduled and had to return it slightly earlier as a result of that - fair enough!).Return was very quick and easy as well ! I will continue to use Car Del Mar for my future bookings and trust the ratings against their hire partners on the booking portal.

name: Mr Gary Wilson
title: No problems
text: Car booked through Car Del Mar with major rental co for much cheaper price than available elsewhere, including direct.  Got a brand new car with zero miles on the clock.  All went smoothly.  Based on this experience I would recommend and will use again.

name: Madeleine White
title: Mostly good
text: The staff were friendly, English speaking and helpful. The car we hired was brand new, so was fine, except that when the window got dusty, we realised there was no water in the windscreen washers, which was a bit poor. Otherwise, they would have got a 5star rating.

name: Nuno
title: A tremendous ripp off.
text: In a few sentences.I booked and paid the car rental for 1 week in Croatia.When I arrived Croatia to pick up the car, there were so many hidden fees, that I ended up paying the DOUBLE than what was agreed on with CarDelMar.I really thought CarDelMar would be a broker to avoid being scammed, but it turns out to be just another way of scamming people.I absolutely don't recommend using this service.

name: Karim
title: Awful Car Hire Partner
text: The car hire partner AutoRent had given me no problems when collecting the vehicle but upon it's return, decided to charge me for damage that was already on the car when I picked it up and in fact as it turns out, gave me a car that was not safe to drive. When I refused to pay, they held me at their desk until I coughed up the money and then thinking that I didn't understand the language, the man who I was dealing with told the shuttle driver to delay me in taking me to the airport. The driver didn't because he was a decent human being. The man who I had the misfortune of dealing with goes by the name of Victor Silva, and he is absolute scum!

name: Chris Morris
title: impossible to pick up car after hours! no response from Car Del Mar!
text: I was supposed to perform an after-hours pick up w/ Ace Car Rentals in Auckland, New Zealand on 2015-05-30. Since Ace Car Rentals was not actually at the airport, I needed to get transferred to the Ace Car Rentals site from the airport. The Car Del Mar voucher said to contact Ace in order to find out the location. However, Ace was closed because it was after 6pm. Therefore, I was unable to go to Ace and pick up our car, and was forced to do a last-minute car rental from another agency.I have filed a ticket with Car Del Mar and have also tried contacting them via phone. When calling them, I was on hold for approximately 45 minutes and was unable to reach anyone; the Car Del Mar system automatically ended the call at that point. I have not heard a response from Car Del Mar in the two days since I have filed the ticket.Please refund me the $146.59 USD (transaction made on 2015-04-15) I paid for this rental.

name: Hans Martin Fleischer
title: super Serivce, super Preis, gerne wieder
text: Perfect Service. Quick Pick up and Drop off ( both less then 5 min)

name: Tomasz Szapajko
title: All very good
text: I booked Hyundai Tucson off road, but finally got Hyundai IX35, 4x4, diesel, automatic, 36000 km on the clock. I was pretty impressed. Looking at the price I paid it was really good deal. No problems on returning the car. The car was checked throughout, which took about 5 minutes, but everything was OK.Thank you Cardelmar, thank you Procar, for nice car and smooth cooperation.Looking forward to deal with you again.

name: Ulrich Muehlenhoff
title: Hertz Marseille
text: Shiny new car, No problems. Office easy to find and friendly, uncomplicated staff.

name: Phillip Gray
title: Malaga car hire - Enterprise / ATESA
text: ATESA staff were extremely helpful and professional. Both Estafanza's who checked our car out and in couldn't have been more helpful.Only gripe I have is with the credit card deposit of €150 which was debited and credited back on the return of the car. This incurred a loss of £8 for basically handing over my card as security!Why does the card have to be debited?Surely the possession of the debit voucher should suffice.

name: Ronald Charles Suter
title: Very good service
text: The car was ready when we arrived and the handover was very simple we were soon off and away.The return was even easier, the guy came out checked the vehicle and we were again on our way to checkin.Excellent service

name: H. B.
title: Wartezeit im schwach besetzten Citer-Büro am 17.05.15 ca. 9.00 h über 1,5 Stunden, wie schon vor zwei Jahren, unerträglich
text: Citer mangelhaft, Car del Mar ok.

name: JEFFREY DALEY
title: very good  service will use again.
text: Had no problem with Cardelmar,

name: MMR
title: Cheap and smooth
text: It was very smooth to book, rent and return.It was cheapest in many website in my case.

name: Ian Johnston
title: What more could you ask for..
text: We booked a Ford S-Max, and got a Ford S-max. We always choose zero excess to avoid any painful bills at the end. CarDelMar offer a reasonable price for this, and well worth paying that little bit more for the peace of mind. No problems at the Hertz counter picking up the car, the lady spoke Spanish, English and German, and perhaps a few other languages, so no communication issues.  The car had about 4000km on the clock, so pretty new. A few more horsepowers under the bonnet would have been nice but with the speed limits in Mallorca, it was fast enough. All in all, great price, great service and 5 stars all round.

name: Adam Braunton
title: Not as smooth as it should have been
text: We booked an Alamo rental through Car Del Mar.  The prices are obviously the attraction, and when collecting the vehicle with the pre-paid voucher the Alamo agent who served us commented on what a great deal it was.  Unfortunately he must have processed the order incorrectly, because on returning the vehicle we were additionally charged the full amount for the rental, effectively being charged twice.  Alamo refused to acknowledge that there was ever a voucher, even when I pointed out that the receipt included the words 'CARDELMAR'.  These are problems with the Alamo process and I have reviewed them separately and appropriately.  Alamo being a dead-end, I turned to Car Del Mar to resolve the issue.  In summary:- Car Del Mar operate under European office hours, making contacting them by phone from San Diego difficult.  A 24 hour system or even a recorded message directing me to the online ticketing system would have helped.- The first person I spoke to was unsympathetic, and clearly only interested in directing me to the online ticketing system.  I would have preferred to resolve by speaking to someone, however he was so dismissive and otherwise unhelpful it didn't give me confidence that I would be helped in a timely manner.- The ticketing system is good, but the turnaround for my ticket was slow. I mentioned this on Twitter and Car Del Mar assured me that this was just the high demand at this time of year.  I would have appreciated this expectation-setting when raising the ticket.- The initial response to the ticket was ridiculous - 'Did you present the voucher?'.  I already stated that I had presented the voucher and the the Alamo agent had commented on the deal, besides - how else had I picked up the vehicle?- I did eventually secure a refund for the charge applied by Alamo.So in summary, I would consider using Car Del Mar again but I would assume that the initial vehicle checkout was incorrect and would need triple checking, and much more diligent in checking any receipts from the hire company.  Neither of which should really be necessary.

name: Hannah L
title: Wouldn't use again
text: Not a problem with Car del Mar as such, but they were the booking partner.  On arrival (on delayed flight, 10pm, with 21 month old, and me, pregnant), called car hire company (Auto-rent) only to be told our booking had been cancelled. Replied that it hadn't, and we were there.  Man arrives, then speaks to his boss, says he can give us a car, but only if we pay again. Get to car hire place, i prove to him I've paid, still make me pay again.  In addition, charges us an 'out of hours' collection fee (on booking paperwork, says office is open 24 hours, and there is no out of hours charge - 20 Euros for a 3 min journey).  When I argue with him about this, he offers to take us back to the airport and leave us there.They say it won't be their mistake, but if it is they'll refund. Get a call the next day (which obv i have to pay for), and it is their fault - no further explanation, so they refund.  On returning the car, same man is there, he doesn't even look at me, gets his colleague to deal with me, explaining situation to him.  No apology.  Would NEVER use again.

name: Phillip
title: Very smooth & no hassles
text: Everything was fine, except that Alamo changed ownership between booking & collecting, but it was only a minor glitch.Returned the car at 4.30am when all was closed but dropped keys in dedicated box & took the shuttle.

name: Leslie Wilson
title: great car rental
text: I booked with auto-rent through car del mar, this company now supplies a shuttle bus to take you to your rental car and is not located on the airport grounds anymore. It was  a quick 3 minute journey to the location of the car and we only waited for 4 or 5 minutes for the shuttle bus to pick us up, quick easy transaction for both pick up and drop off.

name: John Martin
title: Very good but why was an automatic so expensive?
text: Service was excellent. One small point - I thought a second driver was included in the price but was faced with an extra 39 Euros on arrival. I didn't need it so I didn't pay it.

name: philip stone
title: Car hire in Alicante Airport
text: Booked a car via CardelMar for 11 days, using Atesa, very reasonable cost, no problems with the full/full,  (they took a deposit on my card for 150 Euros, but refunded it a couple of days after when returned.  Atesa desk very helpful and courteous, no pressure to take additional insurance.

name: Anne van den Bergh
title: Excellent both in reservation and customer support
text: We rented 2 x 2 cars for our trips with friends and family. Although the reservations were made at different car rental companies, everything was perfectly organised: the voucher, the cars,and also the support when one of the companies had made a mistake in the invoice and charged our credit card with too high an amount. Car Del Mar solved the problem very quickly.

name: Frederik
title: Good quality, helpfull staff for small price.
text: In comparison with other rental car companies, this is a good choice. We had a car and got offered an upgrade at arrival. Quick and friendly service.

name: Roger Claridge
title: Car hire in Lanzarote
text: Very good service.

name: F.U.More
title: Atesa - good prices, good service
text: Bad an Opel Astra, was like new,

name: Mick
title: Last minute booking
text: Very good prices, smooth process and didn't have to print anything in order to go to the car rental (ProCar). Will recommend.

name: thingswelike
title: Good price and good service
text: Everything went smoothly, so we didn't have to make use of their insurance, which would have been the real test of the company, but I found the website fantastic (especially regarding fuel policy and working with reputable companies).Upon arrival at Enterprise/Atesa in Malaga, they were super-helpful. Really slick and not at all 'out to get you' like some of the stories I've heard.Car was very new, exactly as we wanted and unmarked. When we handed back, a quick walk around the vehicle was all that they did and pointed us to our departure gate.All-in-all the car rental service was first class and we will definitely use again.

name: MGL
title: Clear and efficient
text: Arrangements went as planed and outlined with the booking form.  Will look to se again.

name: Neil Smith
title: First class service from start to finish.
text: Booking the car online with CarDelMar was a piece of cake. Kept informed right up until the travel date. Arrived at the airport to collect the car from Centauro. Service was great and it was exactly the car that I had booked (Fiat Panda). Fuel deposit returned the same day I returned the car. All in all faultless.

name: laszlo zimmer
title: perfect service for an amazing price
text: The title says more what I could say. Thank you

name: sonia lee
title: impressed
text: happy with the web site, easy to use. car rental company Atesa were most kind and helpful, though were very busy and had to queue for an hour, they did give us water. everything was well explained in english, no pushy sales for extra cover and easy drop off. already booked with car del mar, using atesa again.

name: Holger Drozyn
title: good service
text: we found a very good service in Faro as well as by arrival in Faro as by departure. The staff of CarDelMar was very friendly and helpful. We can recommand CarDelMar.

name: Page
title: What a SCAM!!
text: We booked a car in Italy because it was CHEAP! We needed it for 4 hours to go from Napoli to Rome. At just under 17 euro, they were 35 euro cheaper than any other company listed through Skyscanner. We did not see our confirmation email (it had been sent to our spam folder) so we called the following day to confirm our reservation and the price. We were given our voucher number and told to go to Locauto in the Naples airport to pick up our car. I specifically asked again about the price I had booked and was told that yes, 16 euro was charged to our card for the rental. We  arrived at Locauto to pick our car up and were charged an additional 87 euro! By the time we were picking up the car, we had little other choice as we needed to make a flight 5 hours later. Locauto said it is Car Del Mar's fault for not properly informing us and we should complain to them. Car Del Mar says we should contact Locauto to complain and that we should have seen a pop up that said the company could charge an additional fee upon pick-up! Of course, we never saw such a pop up...This is a scam for sure and now that we read other reviews, we see that we should have been smart and checked the internet before booking with this company. Renter beware!!!!

name: Naomi
title: worked very well
text: have used an intermediary before and ended up with appalling service from the local partner. Using Car del Mar - could see who the local partner was at the start - so could avoid the previous firm. In Tenerife - had Avis car - very good. We had a puuncture and so returned the car and picked up a new one - in 15 mons. Excellent.

name: Anthony Turner
title: portugal car rental
text: Booked again through carDelMar as prices include cdw excess.   Auto Rent were very good and car was fine.  Faro is now forcing rental companies off site which is a bit of a pain - having to walk all the way to car park 4 to pick up a shuttle bus is just crazy.

name: Leszek Dembczynski
title: Excellent Experience
text: Easy, reliable, cheap

name: Roger Gwynn
title: blah
text: We hired a Ford Focus, boring but what the hell, it transported us about the place at a reasonable price

name: Peter Murphy
title: Good car hire service
text: Efficient car hire but the system of insurance needs to be addressed by the car fire partner who do not accept the full insurance of car del mar and say if you have a claim you must pay their excess and reclaim from car del mar. As an industry get it together !!!

name: Steven Mckay
title: Poor communication
text: Good car and friendly staff at airport.Booked from Sat 14th Feb- Sat 21st Feb and on the Wednesday of this week the car hire people phoned me to say that the MOT had run out and they must replace car. I hadn`t noticed that it had run out at end of Jan. I paid 30 euros extra to go to Spain and in retrospect could have landed in trouble and spoiled my trip.The car hire people said they`d come to where i was to replace it but they didn`t come nor phone to say they wouldn`t come so i was left hanging.Having UK phone it cost me to phone with them.Dissapointed!!!

name: Brian Shaw
title: CAR DEL MAR CAR HIRE IN FUERTEVENTURA
text: This is the second time we have used the service in Fuerteventura.  As before the car was provided by Avis at a very good rate with clear insurance coverage.  The car itself was clean and well-maintained and suited our requirements perfectly.  We have used CAR DEL MAR elsewhere on a number of occasions and always been satisfied.  CAR DEL MAR  has become our standard overseas car hire company.

name: Roger Bell
title: CarDelMar did well; Avis did not so well
text: There was far too long a wait at the Avis desk in Tenerife airport to collect the car.I booked a "Full to Full" car hire arrangement online with CarDelMar - Avis tried to sell me a Full to Empty arrangement.

name: Meredith Bowman
title: Overall Okay
text: There was nothing spectacular about our car rental experience. We choose it because it was the cheapest. Car was a bit dented and the seats were stained but it was in good working order. Service was a bit slow and not very accommodating. But as I said everything was okay.

name: Aidan Bell
title: Too many emails
text: A good, efficient service. I have no concerns or complaints, other than to wonder why it is necessary for me to receive so many emails. I have hired from CarDelMar twice now, and on both occasions I received ELEVEN emails between making my booking and collecting the car!

name: andrew pealing
title: Good service
text: Picked the car up from Cape Town airport. Paperwork was dealt with efficiently and the car was virtually new. Would recommend the service.

name: Christopher Stone
title: Simplifying the car rental process
text: I like the way that this company tries to simplify the car rental process.Selecting the cheapest rental firm and clarifying the level of risk one is prepared to take to control the costs.In this case I booked a VW Up and got a Nissan Micra. I liked the car with it's snow tyres and anti slip controls..very useful in the alps! It took us quite a while to find the fuel gage though as the LCD screen did not show this by default, (the owners manual was in German):not a good feature for a hire car!

name: Thomas
title: Completely satisfied
text: Processing was quick and efficient. The personnel were friendly and helpful.

name: Gabriel Serota
title: cardelmar
text: everything worked fine.

name: Anthony Stansfield
title: Excellent experience in South Africa.
text: Your Avis partner could not have been more helpful or easier to deal with.I would recommend Car del Mar to everyone.

name: Janco Freeke
title: Worst car ever
text: This was the worst car I ever rented... The front tires were completely worn, and was nearly the cause of an accident TWICE during our rental period... text: Arrived Los Cabos airport early Sunday afternoon with a prepaid reservation for an SUV to fit 7 people for a 6 day stay in San Jose del Cabo. Rental car agency (Europcar) that contracted with CarDelMar said they did not have a car for me even though my reservation was guaranteed and prepaid.  They said whoever else rented "the car" had not returned it and they could not contact them.   We were given a car that could only fit 5 of us, with the other 2 being driven by a Europcar employee and we had to pay the toll road fee for the Europcar driver to get all of us to our rental house in San Jose Del Cabo.  Europcar said they would bring our SUV later in the day to the house.  Needless to say we never heard from anyone that Sunday nor the following morning.  We were then told after many phone calls and much difficulty that there still would be no cars until at the earliest Tuesday morning.   Europcar main office informed us they had 15 cars for 34 reservations and we needed to be patient. By now we were 2 days into a short 6 day stay with no room for 7 of us and no other means of transport as all other car agencies were completely booked.  Finally, after many more phone calls, our limited Spanish and Europcar's limited English, we were able to have a van delivered late Monday evening.  The van delivered was the actual Europcar shuttle used to ferry car renters to and from the airport.This was a horrible experience.  After all was said and done we were told 40% of their fleet had been wiped out by Hurricane Odile back in September.  This reservation was made in November when they already knew they did not have enough vehicles to accommodate the reservation.  They should never have accepted the reservation, charged my credit card, and we could have made alternative arrangements and not missed out on two days of vacation.

title: Another Point of View is an awesome…
text: Another Point of View is an awesome location close to Boone.  The cabin is newer and nice to have separate AC units on all floors. Loved having a pool table on bottom level, would be a nice added touch to put a beer/soda fridge on bottom level for the fire pit and pool table.  After arriving and walking around the cabin we realized the floor was filthy.  Our feet were black within minutes.  You could see a layer of dust on the floor in the sun.  Alot of people like to use 2 towels after a shower and we were only offered 1 per person. After showering it would have been nice to have a rug or towel to step on because the floor gets cold and slippery.  The ice machine and water in the fridge didnt work so we relied on having to buy bottled water for our drinking needs.  I know we are in a mountain cabin and everyone’s sleep schedules are different, light filtering curtains would add a nice touch.   A couple throw blankets for the couch would be amazing for the cooler winter days.  But overall was an amazing experience.

name: Welborn family
title: Charming spring break escape
text: Such a charming escape. Our family had a magical week here in early spring enjoying clean, comfy, light-filled rooms; the well-stocked kitchen where things were easy to find; the wrap-around porch with lovely pastoral views; and the yard's fun features, including hammock, swings, and hot tub. My husband and I worked remotely for two days--fast internet (and a great mini-office setup in one of the bedrooms) made that easy, and our kids (5 & 10) stayed occupied with books, games, puzzles, toys, and more while we worked. The weather ranged from snowy to the high 70s during the week we were there, and we were comfortable through it all (and enjoyed roasting marshmallows in the wood-burning fireplace!). This place is well situated--a convenient home base for several fantastic hikes (left notes on a few of our faves in the guest book) and meals at restaurants in the West Jefferson, Boone, and Blowing Rock area. My only regret is that it was too cold (or we were too wimpy?!?) to tube on the New River, within walking distance of the cabin. Solid reason to go back!

name: Brad Childress
title: It was all a dream …
text: The house is a true haven. It’s spacious, beautifully designed, and meticulously maintained, with a perfect blend of rustic charm and modern amenities. The open floor plan provides ample room for everyone to gather and the large windows throughout the house (especially in the living room) invite the outdoors in, so you can enjoy the stunning scenery no matter where you are inside.One of the highlights of our stay was the deck – we spent hours soaking in the fresh mountain air, enjoying coffee in the morning, and watching the stars at night.It’s the perfect house for anyone looking to check out of their normal hustle n bustle and enjoy a Mountain refresh. It’s also less than 5 minutes from Beech mountain for any skiers and snowboarders that want a quick drive to the resort.

name: NRaleigh
title: We stayed at the Cozy Cottage…
text: Erin and I stayed at the Cozy Cottage for three days weekend before last.  Overall, we loved it.The location immediately adjacent to Appalachian Ski Mountain was just beautiful, and was fantastic for accessing Boone, Blowing Rock and/or Tweetsie Railroad. We have stayed in many Blue Ridge Rental properties, but this was the easiest from which to base a stay.One small improvement would be a low sign with the house number by the road, or a number on the house to make locating the property easier in the dark for late arrivals.  Yes, we got in late.The Cozy Cottage was just what we needed for a nice couples' getaway.  We did not use the kid's bedroom with its bunkbeds (just two of us).  The rest of the Cottage is nicely done but not overdone.  It has the needed essentials and is comfortable.  The kitchen is bright, clean, and had what we needed.  The living room is comfy, as was the master bedroom.   Just a note, there is not an ensuite bathroom, just a family bath off the hall.  It worked fine for the two of us.  Convenient washer and dryer located in the bathroom as well.  The Wi-Fi works well, as does the large screen Smart TV.  The deck is large and a great place to enjoy the trees and singing birds.  The parking is generous and directly adjacent to the house.  Very convenient.This may not be the flashiest of Blue Ridge Rental properties, nor the one with the most dramatic view, but it is indeed "Cozy" and is a solid value for the money.  We really liked it!

name: Jolly Brenda
title: It was a great mountain cabin…
text: It was a great mountain cabin experience.

name: Dickerson D'Ann
title: Awesome place to stay!
text: There was an Internet issue the day before we arrived. The office called to notify us, and the ladies were instrumental in getting the company out to repair it before our arrival. The house was clean, and the starter packs in the bathrooms and kitchen were much appreciated. We had a wonderful stay- what a beautiful location! The cabin was close to Blowing Rock and Boone. We traveled to both towns several times. Would stay again!

name: Chirico Deva
title: This home is AMAZING
text: This home is amazing.  The beds were so comfortable.  The property is amazing.  We had the GREATEST weekend.  Thank you!

name: Daniela De Pietto
title: fantastic Spring Break week
text: We rented the house for a week, and we enjoyed every bit of it.The house was clean, spacious and prepped and furnished with all you need.Everything worked well and we greatly recommend this place if you want to ski, explore the area or simply relax anytime of the year.

name: Bernadette
title: We’ll be back!
text: The home was beautiful, clean and had all of the amenities to enjoy a peaceful. We appreciated how family oriented the space was and how convenient the process of booking was. Also the granola gift was so yummy!

name: Ray Lynda
title: Always happy with Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals
text: We’ve used Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals exclusively since 2015 and have always been happy with their service. We typically book twice a year. Response times are fantastic and we’ve always received prompt & professional service. The only cabin rental company we’ll use in the High Country.

name: Daniel Gregory
title: Pros and Cons
text: Pros and ConsPros- Cabin was big, spacious, and had a lot of fun games (i.e. pool and ping pong).- Absolutely loved the deck and hot tub area!- Climate control was responsive and efficient, we've been to some houses where it takes forever to heat up/cool down- Location is perfect between Boone and Blowing Rock- Everyone we spoke to at Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals were incredible helpful, nice and pleasant. We will come back for future rentals just for our experience with the personnel.Cons- I wouldn't expect it to be thoroghly cleaned after every stay, but there was a large amount of dust on the walls in the master bath (especially the toilet area), indicating it and other spots hadn't been touched in a while- The water pressure in the kitchen sink was abysmal, not sure what had happened to it.- The front door doesn't latch so it gets blown open by wind unless the deadbolt is set

name: Stephens Melissa
title: Great location
text: Great location! Fully equipped home! Very welcoming and plenty of space for 21 people.

name: LYNN SUTTON
title: Third Time Renting - Great Experiences
text: We have rented cabins 3 times from Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals, and we have been very happy with the overall experience.  All 3 properties have been very well maintained and are exceptionally clean.  The communication has been great with the company.  We no longer look at VRBO when we want to go to NC mountains because the pricing and overall experience has been much better with Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals

name: Sharkey Paul
title: Thumbs up
text: As advertised

name: Ball David And Ronda
title: The cabin was so nice
text: The cabin was so nice.  It was in a good location to downtown.  The driveway  was too steep even with a AWD.  Thank  you.

name: Johnson Malrie
title: Little to no heat downstairs
text: Little to no heat downstairs, Screw sticking out on downstairs bedroom doorknob caused a cut, Downstairs carpet not vacuumed rubber bands from hair ties everywhere, dishwasher doesn't dry the dishes, Ice maker cutoff doesn't work leaving ice everywhere inside the freezer, washing machine not working, ladybug infestation in main floor near balcony doors, mold under glass top on dining table, Pets were finding food debris in numerous areas in kitchen and living area as well as under dining table, Hair on shower walls in master bath( not ours) and upstairs shower, first phone number on printed instructions for assistance was a random male not associated with Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals, After hours number had the same recording as the business office number, left message and got a return call saying they would relay our message, no one returned our call, We arrived Friday and placed our calls and a gentleman showed up Sunday without calling while the children were taking their naps. He acknowledged the problems and said someone would call us Monday. We checked out Wednesday morning and never received a call. My wife mopped the mud from the Kitchen floor on Friday night and we swept up all the food debris we could find. The flapper in the master bath sticks open and the toilet periodically ran until you removed the top and physically seated the flapper. The deck gates were broken and would not close with one gate completely off. The morning sun highlighted the cob webs on the ceiling light fixtures. The shuffleboard  is held together with ratchet straps and the Foosball table is broken on one end. The light on the microwave is out so no light for the stovetop while cooking. The dishwasher didn't clean the dishes well and some had to be hand washed. There was pink Goo on the bannister going to the third floor.How would you rate your service??

name: John K
title: Spring Break getaway in Banner Elk
text: Great Spring Break getaway in Banner Elk!   Home was just as described on VRBO. Location was perfect with day trips to Linville Falls, Boone, Blowing Rock, and Valle Crucis. Walking distance for everything in and around Banner Elk. Very clean and well stocked with attentive and helpful staff at Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals! We will definitely be renting from them again!

name: Lappin Kimberly
title: Such a great time in this cabin
text: Such a great time in this cabin. Was so wonderful we could bring our family and or dogs! Putting this cabin on our to go again list!

name: Barnett Melinda
title: CSR’s were friendly and tried to help…
text: CSR’s were friendly and tried to help but no follow ups were ever received. We had no power after the storm last weekend and water pressure was very low. The cabin book gave a number to call for power outage but they required a phone number to report outage which we did not have. I called BRMR three times simply asking for a ETA for power to be restored so we could make a decision on staying or leaving early. Power was out 24 hours. Never received a call back at all. Right after my third call I called BRMR to report power was on. Cabin had no emergency lighting at all and the pots and pans are in great need of replacement and were even dirty.

name: Shawna
title: Weekend at River Ridge
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our weekend stay at River Ridge! This was our second time staying at this cabin and we would stay here again. The cabin is comfortable and the hot tub in the deck was relaxing. Highly recommend!

name: Jadea James
title: Awesome staff
text: Awesome staff, very communicative and our rental was spectacular. We will definitely rent from this company again.Thank you!

name: Thompson Heather
title: This place was perfect
text: This place was perfect. It was quiet and cozy, perfect for our family and dogs. We had everything we needed. We will definitely be going back very soon!

name: Kelly & Michael
title: Smooth booking & great communication…
text: Smooth booking & great communication with all the right details.

name: Andersen Yvonne
title: We were caught up in Helene during our…
text: We were caught up in Helene during our original date and BRMR was very communicative and understanding. We rescheduled for March and had a great stay. Every communication was forthright and gave us all the details we needed. The property was just as advertised.

name: Gonzales Jesus
title: Another Great Stay
text: As always, the stay was incredible! My family and I use this location every year for our vacation and will continue to do so for the foreseeable future!

name: Bernard-Gantt Amber
title: Perfect Mountain Getaway!
text: This is a great house!  We were so impressed by how well stocked it was and how clean!  The beds were extremely comfortable.  All of our needs were met!  It was a perfect getaway spot!

name: ashley rhyne
title: My experience with BRMR was excellent…
text: My experience with BRMR was excellent on all fronts.They were very responsive and pleasant.  The home we rented was fantastic!  It was clean, attractive, and fully supplied from the kitchen to bedrooms and bathrooms.  We said next time we visit this area - we won't search anymore - we'll just come back here!

name: McKoy David
title: White Oak cabin
text: My 2 sons and I rented the White Oak cabin. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The rental was very clean, cozy,and quiet. It was close to anything you would want as in restaurants, grocery stores, or activities. I would definitely like to stay there again.

name: Newkirk Thomas
title: Great house that was stocked very well…
text: Great house that was stocked very well with everything we needed.

name: Wyatt Family
title: Great experience
text: We had a few unexpected changes but they managed everything with such grace!  We were very pleased with our experience.

name: Gause Tom
title: Highly recommended!
text: The house is perfectly located off of 221 making it easily accessible to the highway and major shopping. There’s an Ingles grocery store, CVS, etc. about 15 minutes away. The kitchen is well stocked with all necessities. The fire pit outside is perfect for a serene night by the fire. We will definitely be returning!Consider carefully about bringing more than two people because there is only one bathroom in the house in the master bedroom, which could be a problem if someone has to use the restroom during the night.

name: Rachelle M.
title: Awesome cabin, perfect for a winter y stay!
text: Awesome cabin, easy to communicate w management company.

name: NW
title: Had trouble at check in
text: Had trouble at check in. Cabin contained very little for cooking.

name: Glinsky Thomas
title: Great weekend with the family with Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals
text: Company was great to work with to book our weekend getaway. The property was as described and beautiful. Couple things that could have made it better would be the binder at the home seemed to have very general information regarding the area. Took us a while to find out where the closest grocery store was due to very rural location of the home. Providing us some details ahead of the trip such as "roads are under construction and may be difficult to pass" and that it's best to be prepared with food shopping ahead of your stay would have been extremely helpful. Also, additional details on all the amenities at the house and how to use them would have been great as well. For example: Sonos speakers for outdoor hot tub would not work and there were no instructions on how to connect. No instructions on the steam shower and it's use in the master bedroom. These were all minor but it would have made our stay a 5 star.

name: LB
title: We had the best time!
text: We had the best time! The house was beautiful and the staff recommendations were great.

name: Craig Donovan
title: Do your homework, ask for confirmation of maintenance records.
text: My experience was so poor that as I wrote up my review it went on and on and on.  So I've decided to highlight it simply.Rented Look Out Lodge for two weeks.  On third night had to leave due to CO2 leak that was discovered only after we required them to come and look at furnace because the fire department who responded to our CO2 alarm on second night said "we were here two weeks ago for this".While we were able to complete one week at another less desirable property (with non functioning fireplace and hot tub) BRMR did not refund the entirely of our missing week and required us to pay for the days in their poorly maintained CO2 cabin.I was worried that the effects of Hurricane Helene would be that there would be less activities for my family.  I never imagined (and guess owners don't either) that it would affect the ability of companies like BRMR to maintain their properties and endanger my family.

name: Shannon
title: Extremely disappointing
text: Rented a large house in Banner Elk/Beech Mountain area for about 15 of us. Five days before we were due to arrive we get an email informing us our reservation at been canceled and that we’d be receiving about 1/4 of the money back. We called the company and got it worked out. Upon arrival to the house later that week we found that it had not been cleaned. Multiple trash bags on the floor, beds unmade, bathrooms dirty, etc. We called to let them know and were told our only option would be to move all of us to a different house just for one night until it could be cleaned. It was about 9:30pm at this point with snow rapidly coming down, making the visibility and roads a huge issue. We were also going to ski early the next day, so driving between houses to transfer our things really wasn’t an option. We let them know we were uncomfortable driving and would prefer to clean the house ourselves and instead get a refund for the first night. After lots of back and forth the company agreed. We spent our first night doing hours worth of laundry and cleaning to make the house sanitary enough for us to go to sleep. Luckily some of our group found out soon enough to stop and buy sheets before arriving to the house. The next morning we left to ski and when we came back at the end of the day, the house had been cleaned but the sheets we had bought were gone. The cleaning crew likely mistook our sheets for theirs and took them with them. We let the company know and asked that they be returned but we were told that wouldn’t be possible. We just received word that our “refund” for the first night would only be about $400, which is not equivalent to the full price of the first night. Extremely disappointing experience to say the least, think twice before booking with this rental company.

name: E P
title: Wonderful views
text: Wonderful views, well stocked, and lots of amenities. The game room was nice, along with the fire pit. A good layout for families to spread out as well!

name: Woods Katie
title: House was wonderful and clean as…
text: House was wonderful and clean as always. Although, the kitchen was missing some key items, the trash bags provided were super thin and ripped and it was very cold and the pilot lights wouldn’t stay lit in either of the fireplaces.

name: Robinson Corey
title: Location was brilliant
text: Location was brilliant. The property itself was beautiful and possessed great character.

name: Kurt K.
title: Best In Class
text: BRMR staff are courteous, professional and truly want you to have a great experience in the home you rent. They try to get you in early if possible and are good about responding to questions quickly. The houses are always spotless and the maintenance techs are skilled and glad to answer questions as well.

name: customer
title: Great location and house has all of the…
text: Great location and house has all of the amenities.  Less than ten minutes from Beech Mnt restaurants and ski resort.  Kids(and adults) loved the game room.

name: Anonymous
title: Managing company incredibly quick to…
text: Managing company incredibly quick to respond to issues throughout stay no matter day/time.

name: Tiffani Snow Richard
title: VERY CLEAN
text: We chose a home through Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals as they had the best prices listed for the dates we wanted to stay. They have a variety of homes in all price ranges, and we were able to find the perfect cabin for our girls weekend. They were extremely informative once we booked regarding how to get to the home, check in/out procedures and made sure to provide plenty of warning that the home was AWD access only. We appreciated how clean the house was (I'm talking one of the cleanest rentals I've ever stayed in) and that they provided a binder full of information. We actually used the binder to locate a local pharmacy on the way to our outing at Beech Mtn. One of the guests in our group commented that the labels on the light switches were very helpful. There were more than enough toiletries for 1-2 nights and hot tub towels were provided. The only negative is that when we went to get in the hot tub the first night, the hot tub had no power. We unplugged the hot tub and plugged it into the outlet just above the one that it was plugged into and the hot tub powered right up. Unfortunately, we couldn't use the hot tub that night or all day the next day as it took time to come up from 64 degrees to 100 degrees. We were able to use it late on the 2nd night.  we did reply to an email BRMR regarding the hot tub when they emailed to see how our stay was going, but we never heard back. The string lights on the back porch weren't working either, but we did have the overhead light.

name: Judy Nobles
title: Wonderful cabin
text: Our cabin was very clean and the correspondence from the company was outstanding.  Everything was just as they said it would be.

name: Miller
title: Stay FAR away owners/renters
text: Stay far away from any rental managed by this company. Look out for AIRBNB and VRBO. I truly feel bad for property owners using this management company as they are incredibly negligent in their management, communication, and execution.We rented a home through their company for a weekend in blowing rock and had a disaster of an experience. We arrived at 5pm on a Thursday to no heat or hot water. After several hours of trying to reach their “emergency line” due to a gas smell in the home, I resorted to calling 911. Blue ridge sends their renters to an offshore call center at 5pm on a weekday with no one local to talk to. After we have spent several thousand dollars a night, this is simply inexcusable and poor customer service.Blue ridge was not able to refill the propane until the next day despite their statement saying “within a few hours”As it turns out, blue ridge management had neglected to fill the propane to the home and we had to pack up and leave with two small children in below freezing temps and icy roads. The fire department pointed out that there was no working smoke detector, carbon monoxide detector or working heat, and that the condo was not safe to stay.After repeated calls to blue ridge the next morning, a representative assured me that I would be compensated for the hotel stay we had to purchase since we were displaced by their rental mismanagement.After several back and forth emails with blue ridge representative, “Amy Wright”, I was informed that they had reneged on their promise to compensate. And that a refund of just the amount paid was “fair”.

name: Palacino Stephen
title: Amazing winter view and comfortable…
text: Amazing winter view and comfortable beds with ample space for everyone to spread out. Location was very close to the sledding hill which was great for the kids and made it easy to get around after a snow storm since the main road is always plowed.

name: Holland Kenneth W
title: Great house and great location for what we needed. We have rented again
text: Blue Ridge is always great to rent from. We have used them many times, and we always appreciate the great communication!

name: Macdougall Diane
title: Making reservations was fast and easy
text: Making reservations was fast and easy, very helpful staff, had an issue and was promptly taken care of! These folks are Great!

name: Rebecca H.
title: Renting from Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals for years and never disappointed
text: We've been renting through Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals for several years, and we have never been disappointed.The staff has always been polite, patient, and professional. The houses have been clean, comfortable, and more than we expected. We will continue to rent through them.

name: Patterson Ginger
title: Very unhappy this year
text: Very unhappy this year

name: Peter
title: Thank you
text: Your reservation process and quick response to our questions/needs before and during our stay were appreciated and not the norm for rental companies. It is what keeps us coming back to Blueridge Rentals year after year. Keep up the great customer service.

name: Ben
title: Beautifully maintained homes
text: Beautifully maintained homes, very responsive and helpful. Rented with them twice now and will go back again

name: Kolb Meghan
title: Home is beautiful
text: Home is beautiful! Loved waking up in master bedroom looking out at deer walking up the mountain. The kids bunk room is adorable and they loved having their own space downstairs to hang. The upstairs has a great floor plan for entertaining. It’s nice that it close to the main entrance because you can get to town faster.

name: Wendy
title: Having non-emergency issues is ok as long as you have someone help you resolve it.
text: This feedback is only about the customer service. As not every vacation is perfect to a tea, I am impressed on how Blue Ridge Mountain taking a time to review the 8 point issues we had during our stay in one of their properties. They were very welcoming of my feedback and a regular check-in during our stay was conducted.

name: Ryan O
title: Perfect Family Getaway!!!
text: The cabin was so much fun and perfect for our family. It was spotless when we got there and had no issues. We will definitely be back here next year.

name: SB
title: The house is beautiful and has most…
text: The house is beautiful and has most everything you would need. Our only problem was that the driveway is very long and steep and it was covered with so much snow that we couldn’t make it down the driveway in our SUV with 4WD until the second day. It felt like we lost two days of our vacation because of shoveling and salting the driveway and we still couldn’t make it down the driveway. I immediately called the maintenance team when we arrived but they said the didn’t plow driveways. When I called a second time to check again about plowing because we still couldn’t make it down the driveway, and because they also hadn’t delivered our firewood, they said they do plow driveways, but it still took them two days before they showed up. This was our third time staying in this home and overall I would recommend it but beware of the long, steep driveway if it is winter time. The pictures do not show the length or the steepness of the driveway.

name: Tommy
title: Great location and unit was very nice…
text: Great location and unit was very nice overall.  However, there was no bathroom sink.  At all.  Just missing.  That was just strange  Also called twice to try and get gas fireplace to work (we were in the mountains while it was snowing) and never received response. Talked with someone finally but no one really cared.

name: Payne Barbara
title: Our main complaint was with the…
text: Our main complaint was with the kitchen.  The oven door would not close properly and all the controls on the front of the stove would get very hot.  We had a toddler with us who wanted to be in the kitchen.   We had to watch her very closely so she didn't get burned.   I burned myself when I tried to turn on a burner on top of the stove.  That's whe I realized this was a significant safety hazard.  I called the maintenance number and was today they had nothing in the notes about the stove.l called the owner and she said it was Italian and she probably needed to buy a different stove.  She said there was one man at the maintenance office who has worked on it before.   He came on Tuesday ( this problem started on Saturday), and ended up putting 2 pieces of Gorilla tape on either side of the oven to keep the door closed.  He left a strip in the garage incase we needed more.  It helped but we still could not touch the dials without a pot holder.  Then the dishwasher didn't clean the dishes and we had to rewash most of them by hand.  Also, the cabinets were set back and it was difficult to get dishes, glasses etc.  Other than that the rest of the house was lovely.   The fenced yard was nice for our dogs.

name: Beth B.
title: Exceptional
text: The Heart Rock Lodge is everything you might want or need for a comfortable family vacation.  It is spacious but cozy, has beautiful mountain views, has a fully equipped kitchen with newer items, and comfortable beds.  Communication with the rental office was easy and we were well informed with important information.  Customer Service was quick to respond.  I highly recommend this Lodge and Blue Ridge Mt. Rentals and hope to return again soon.

name: Mccutcheon Robert
title: Renters Beware of Poor Service
text: I would caution renters from using BRMR.  We rented "Vilas Retreat" the weekend of 1/17.  We had a series of problems with maintenance.  To start the front door lock batteries were dead.  After waiting an hour for a call they got us in the garage.  Then the alarm went off and they didn't have the code.  Next we discovered the main floor heat wasn't operating.  We obviously asked for help and they said they would get back to us.  No one did.  The entire very cold weekend without heat on the first floor.  Finally, the BBQ had fallen over in the dirt..not burgers as planned.  I asked for resolution when we returned and they provided a $283 refund or 19% of our rental and a $100 credit for future rentals.  Ridiculous.  Insignificant and why would spend more $$ with a company that treated us so poorly.

name: Liz A
title: We loved it!
text: We loved this house and hope to go back someday! It was cozy yet roomy with fantastic views. The hot tub was a great addition. Communication was excellent.

name: Celetti Kristy
title: I called for maintenance due to our…
text: I called for maintenance due to our jets spitting out dirt and not being able to use the jacuzzi tub. Also, the hot tub didn’t quite get as hot as it needed to be. I was told that maintenance would come out but no one ever did.

name: Drew B.
title: Gorgeous, cozy cabin getaway
text: Beautiful cabin, actually even *more* cozy than we expected from the pictures. Gas heater is very strong and easily kept us toasty. Plenty of towels and blankets! Good dishes/cups/etc. and had coffee, tea and creamer available which was a nice surprise. Hot tub worked great and we had fun with it! We were very blessed with snow throughout the visit, and the grounds are beautiful to watch with snow falling. Overall everything we could have hoped for on a “snowcation”! We’d definitely like to return someday!We had a couple issues (the fireplace didn’t work and we had a pretty bad electrical short with the washer), but we were in contact with management during the trip, and after the visit they’ve followed up to genuinely try to make it right, so we are still very pleased.Last note: the owners advise you must have 4-wheel drive in the winter — this is true! We did and were totally fine, but a friend with front-wheel drive tried to stop by and couldn’t make it up!

name: Susan Hunt and Family
title: Aspen Family Ski
text: Office staff helped quickly to find us the perfect house for our family's winter ski Get Away - plus it was dog-friendly - reasonably priced too.  The home was very comfortable, roomy, clean, and had everything we needed and very close to Appalachian Mtn. Hot Tub was a bonus !Thank you, Blue Ridge - we will be using you again.  -

name: Davis Charlene
title: The rental company was great
text: The rental company was great. The house was good and accommodated us well. The only problem we had was that the hot tub & washer were not working but the rental company notified us a couple of days before arrival. The kids were disappointed about the hot tub but had a great time in the snow. House wasn’t ready until 430 but it was a holiday weekend so I guess they were busy. Appreciated the refund the rental company was able to get us since we were missing some amenities. They were great to work with & we ours use them again.

name: Karina Ribeiro
title: Would like to leave my feedback about…
text: Would like to leave my feedback about my stay here for these 4 days. I arrived at 4:05 and the house was all dirty. The cleaning lady arrived at 7 pm because I called to complain, but since there wasn't enough time to clean, the house wasn't cleaned. The next day I went to turn on the fireplace and it didn't work. I called to complain and they wanted to fix it on the penultimate day of my stay. The video game controller was faulty and the Jacuzzi wasn't in perfect condition either.

name: Kimberly
title: Beautiful views!
text: The views were gorgeous and the house is very spacious! We enjoyed the big hot tub. Our only small problem was that it could have been a little cleaner, especially on the main floor and kitchen/dining areas. As soon as we came in we had to sweep up and we found some trash in the couch cushions. Other than that our stay was great and we would come here again.

name: Gregory
title: Snowy Mountain Retreat
text: High end private community of Eagles Nest made our first experience in Banner Elk safe and special. Roads were plowed regularly made getting around less stressful than staying outside of a planned community with wonderful amenities. The wild life was plentiful and fun to watch. The unit is grand and we loved the "black bear" theme throughout. The house was well maintained but, the stove was missing a knob to control one of the burners, the hot water in the kitchen was frozen up for the first day only then was repaired. The right up is misleading showing 4 bedrooms when there are only 3.

name: Chelsey
title: Anniversary Trip with a Twist
text: My Husband and I rented a cabin for our 15 year anniversary it was a beautiful cabin “A River Runs Through It” we enjoyed our first two days there. We watched the presidential inauguration and the Buckeys win the Championship cozy by the fire! GO BUCKS! After the game we realized the pipes froze upstairs and the water came pouring into the kitchen just a few hours later. The ladies with BMR were angels! They had us in another cabin (Trillium) just as perfect as the first cabin within 2 hours. We were so relieved with the quick responses and fast transitioning to finish our trip. The Manager came out to the cabin at 1030pm to check on us. She was so sweet and helpful. Before we eventually left to head home (3 days later) we realized they refunded some money for our troubles and they explained the homeowner was very thankful we jumped into action and shut the well pump off so there would be no further damage to the cabin. All in all we will always use Blue Mountain Rentals for all of our trips! Absolutely wonderful customer service and hospitality!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

name: Chamberlain Jim
title: A little snow helps
text: What a difference a little snowfall can make. That, along with a great view of the ski slopes made our long week-end something to remember. Being medically challenged I was able to witness the enjoyment my kids and their children had ice skating, sledding, riding the coaster or just taking a walk. Unfortunately they were not able to enjoy snowboarding as our reservation was canceled due to the "snow storm" Sunday, Jan 19th. We will look forward to coming back to Sugar Mountain in the near future to check that off our list. Overall a very enjoyable experience.(On a housekeeping note for the owners, the coffee maker still had old grounds from a previous tenant, no instructions on how to light the gas logs and the Xmas tree was still up a month after Dec 25. I didn't allow these to affect my review of 5 stars.)

name: David
title: Spacious with wonderful View of Grandfather MTN
text: We had 2 families for an early weekend tubing/skiing trip. Had an awesome trip; plenty of space, super close to the tubing, 15 minutes away from Sugar Mountain, and the hot tub was a hit! Definitely would rent again.

name: Fields Jessica
title: Awesome cabin
text: Awesome cabin! Clean comfortable and fully stocked!

name: Amsalem Yaniv
title: The house is pretty new and modern all…
text: The house is pretty new and modern all spaces are wide, 3 living rooms, 5.5 bathrooms.. was perfect for us! all appliances are good brands and clean,Laundry room next to kitchen, huge balcony, amazing view from every angle of the house! Perfect location!

name: Cummings Melody
title: Great rental
text: We had a wonderful time. The house was beautiful, very clean and well stocked. We highly recommend renting this home.

name: Raffa Michele
title: Lack of response and caring by BRMR
text: It's easy to be fabulous when all is good, but when there is a problem, that's when you show how the company truly cares. We have rented from BRMR for years and this last visit is the first time we have had a problem. The lack of response shown when we had an issue has made it clear that this was our last rental with BRMR. I am sure that if the homeowner knew the lack or maintenance and care for the safety of their renters, they would choose a different rental agency to rep them.

name: Cumbus Teresa
title: The house was great
text: The house was great. Plenty of bathrooms for our family. Beds were comfortable. Would be nice to have a separate thermostat down stairs. Disappointed that no one ever came and checked to see why the gas logs wouldn’t work. We tried all directions given and was told someone would be calling and then coming. This never happened.

name: Aaron T
title: Great communications
text: Great communications, wonderful properties that are always as described, and responsive customer service.

That being said, they did an excellent job at clearing the roads in the neighborhood the next day - and they continued to work on the roads through the day.  We were so appreciative.  Of note - the "back road" to Beech Mountain was not an option while we were there.  There was actually caution tape to prevent people from traveling on it - again likely for safety :)  Hopefully this will open soon as I can see this cutting down on travel time from the community to Beech Mountain.

name: Kayla S
title: Cute Spot with amazing views
text: The property has gorgeous mountain top views. We had a little problem checking in because the code that was provided was incorrect. After a couple phone calls that all went to voicemail, I finally Received a text from blue ridge rental with the correct door code. Our stay was great, however the bottom floor did get chilly at night. Thankfully there were extra blankets and space heaters. Leaving the property was a hassle due to a winter storm dumping 9 inches overnight, which only called for 1-3”. Despite having vehicles with 4 wheel drive, one of our SUVs wasn’t able to make it up the driveway and slide down.. there were shovels and 1 bag of ice in the shed. However the shed was frozen shut and when we were finally able to open it, the key froze in the lock and snapped in half. After 2hrs of shoveling we were able to get all vehicles out of the driveway. Very thankful for the kind neighbors that helped us!! So be mindful of potential snow storms and bring only big trucks! Aside from the driveway issues and the delayed responses from the rental property company, we loved our stay, loved the house, and would definitely stay here again!

name: mark guice
title: Fraudulent Practices / Scam Alert
text: I am appalled by the experience my family and I had with Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals, a company that exemplifies the worst customer service I have ever encountered. My wife has been dealing with them, and its been nothing short of a nightmare. They included in their rental agreement that they are not responsible if you cannot access the property, fully aware that you won't be able to navigate steep mountain roads in snow and ice. This blatant disregard for guest safety is unacceptable.We recently rented a house for two nights spending $2400, only to find ourselves stuck and unable to reach the property. The drop-off on one side was so steep that if we had slipped off, I would not be here writing this review. As someone who drives a Chevrolet 2500HD and has experience driving in snowy conditions, it was still impossible to make it up the mountain. We ended up with no place to go but back home, leaving us incredibly disappointed and out of pocket.Despite my wife reaching out to their customer service, they promised callbacks that never materialized. It's clear that this company is fully aware of the dangerous conditions of the subdivision roads yet continues to rent properties without any concern for the safety of their guests. They make you sign an agreement stating that you won't receive a refund, effectively trapping you in a situation where you are left with nothing but frustration and financial loss.We refuse to be scammed and will continue to share our experience on every single platform available until we receive a refund. Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals is a ripoff, and we strongly advise against using their services. They need to be held accountable for their actions!

name: NM
title: Below average customer service
text: I have rented with Blue Ridge Mountain Rental at least 4 times but I won’t be using them again. The customer service provided was not satisfactory. I felt like they didn’t care about us. When we arrived the driveway was packed with snow and there were 2 large long boxes weighing more than 200 lbs each, occupying the driveway. There was no way to move them without a forklift. We tried to move them ourselves because we needed more space. We had to constantly be rearranging our cars because there was not enough space due to the packages. To make matters worse the house did not have a shovel for us to use. There should have been one accessible. There were no instructions stating we had to bring one. When I called to ask about plowing the driveway and removing the delivery I was told they were short staffed and probably wouldn’t be able to help. No one followed up with me.  If they expect people to do their own shoveling they could provide a shovel. The next day, the fusebox was tripped so we needed to reset the breaker. The breakers were behind locked doors. How is this allowed? The temperature was 58F downstairs. We waited over 3 hours for maintenance to call us. We finally got tired of waiting and went searching for the keys. We figured out where the keys to the doors were and successfully reset the breakers. The emails I sent were responded with sorry only. There was no attempt to remedy the situation. This is a million dollar neighborhood. People pay more to stay there and to be ignored is terrible customer service.
