name: Elaine Guice
title: Disappointing and Dangerous experience
text: UPDATE: For any potential customers reading these reviews, it's essential to pay close attention to the tone of the company's responses. The replies come across as condescending, and the claims made are misleading. Writing reviews to inform others about possible fraud should not be dismissed as "spam." There is no way anyone could have accessed that mountain on the day we were there—this is simply untrue. While they offered me a credit for the same house, it feels pointless since I only travel to Boone to ski, meaning the same mountain would be just as treacherous as before. Additionally, the offer of six bottles of wine was inappropriate, as I do not consume alcohol. A fair resolution would have been a refund of $2,469 to stay at ANY of their rentals, but that was not provided. I have sought advice on this matter and someone will be in contact soon.I am writing this review to express my deep dissatisfaction with Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals following a recent experience that was not only disappointing but also dangerous.I rented a house for two nights at a cost of $2400, and was advised to use a 4-wheel drive vehicle with chains. My husband’s Chevrolet 2500HD is a large, capable truck equipped for such conditions. We have lived in Western North Carolina our entire lives (55 years) and are well-acquainted with driving in the snow. However, the situation we encountered upon arriving at the community was unacceptable.The entrance to the community was covered in snow, and it was clear that no efforts had been made to scrape or salt the roads. As we began to drive up the steep mountain, the slick conditions quickly became alarming. After a few turns climbing up we got stuck, and it was terrifying! We were sliding backward down the mountain with a steep drop-off on one side. Thankfully, we had a shovel in the truck, which allowed my husband to create a space to turn around.Descending the mountain was equally perilous. The road was a solid sheet of ice, and even with the truck in the lowest gear, we struggled to maintain control and sliding off the side of the mountain. This was a nightmare of a situation, compounded by the fact that we had two children in the back seat, and I continue to have flashbacks about it. We understand the driveway to the property not being maintained, we expected that, but we had no idea that the main road in the subdivision getting to the house would be in such bad icy conditions!When I contacted the rental company to explain that we couldn’t reach the property due to the hazardous road conditions, their response was disappointing. They simply said they would pass my message along to customer care. We had nowhere to go and so we went back home! It was very disappointing. The next day, I did receive a call from one representative who seemed skeptical about my claims regarding the road conditions. She promised to investigate and follow up, but it has been several days and I have yet to hear back.Upon reviewing the lengthy rental agreement, I discovered that the company absolves itself of any responsibility for access issues due to snow. They are fully aware of the potential dangers posed by the steep, unmaintained roads, yet they continue to rent properties without ensuring safe access.This experience did not only ruin our trip but also put my family's safety at risk. I feel compelled to warn others about Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals. While some may leave positive reviews, I urge potential customers to pay close attention to the negative feedback. This company is a scam, and they do not prioritize the safety or satisfaction of their clients. My family and I will not be returning, and I will continue to share our experience to prevent others from facing the same ordeal.Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals, expect to hear more from me.

name: Noronha Rodrigo

name: Alexander Kristin
title: Poor Customer Service
text: Our family was excited for a weekend getaway at Beech Mountain. My husband, daughter and niece were planning a Saturday ski day, while I caught up on some work at the cabin. Driving up on Friday afternoon put us into a welcome snowstorm. It was much later when we arrived at the cabin due to heavy traffic in the area. When we arrived at the cabin the check in code would not allow us entry. I had to call BRMR and after trying the code again a few times, given a new code to try, we were finally told where the hide-a-key was located. Our family unloaded and my daughter went to take a shower. She began yelling that the water would not start. We tried the water in the kitchen, it would also not run. Once again, I made a call to BRMR. They deemed this as an emergency and stated that they would put in a call to maintenance asap. I received a call about thirty minutes later that the water company should be there soon. Around an hour later, the water company sent me a text stating that due to the weather they would not be able to make it to our location that evening but would be there sometime the next morning. My husband went to the basement to make sure the water valve was cut on (which it was-inside).The next morning my family left for the ski slopes and I prepared for work. This is when I realized that the Wi-Fi login was not working. I made another call back to BRMR. I told them that I was very frustrated about the water and now the Wi-Fi. I spoke with an agent that was going to follow up with maintenance. The water company arrived within an hour but the shut on/off valve was frozen underground and they were unable to proceed. I spoke again with a representative from BRMR at 6:00 that evening. She apologized for the inconvenience and asked if we wished to move to another home for the night. She and I both agreed that by the time my family got home from skiing, we pack up and move to a new house, it would be time for bed and then wake up and check out. The representative then stated that she would make adjustments to our account the next day. It has been one week and I haven't heard anything. This is my third time renting from BRMR and I typically don't have problems. I am disappointed to have spent a weekend without water and no Wi-Fi without any other contact from BRMR.

text: This was the worst rental experience I’ve ever had, and I feel compelled to share. We had four kids in the family, making this situation incredibly stressful. Despite Angie from customer service being great and communicative, no one ever showed up to fix the water issue, even though we were promised it would be addressed.Adding to the disappointment, when we were leaving, I noticed a guestbook meant for kind notes from previous visitors. I wanted to check what others had written, only to find the page broken and replaced with a new one. You can check the note dated 1-1-25 to confirm this.I’ve been coming to the Carolinas for 10 years and have never experienced such poor maintenance. This was especially disheartening as I brought family visiting from Cuba — a country where water and electricity are scarce — to enjoy what I promised would be their greatest vacation. Instead, we felt deceived and let down.I have never left a bad review before, but this experience left us all deeply disappointed.

title: 20 foot Dump Trailer 12/21-28/2024
text: We made our reservation in August 2024 planning for our Christmas vacation Dec 21-28, 2024. We arrived at the rental home that cost $3900 for the week to find a 20 foot dump trailer in the front of the house taking up the driveway, it appeared that this home was having the wrap around porch remodeled before we arrived and looked like the renovations would continue after we left. When I called to request the dump trailer be removed, they said no it will stay and there were no other options for us on our Christmas vacation in the mountains,  we would be forced to look at a dump trailer all week, give up a large part of our parking area and have 25% of the porch under construction and unusable. This rental company in our opinion does not care about complaints, they refunded us $500 but that was after multiple requests to resolve our issues. They said our contract doesn't give refunds, however we feel that by not giving us a warning about the property being under a remodel during our stay and not giving us as the consumer a choice in the matter is 100% a breach of the contract. The house itself was fine but not what we wanted to work around all week, it's just not fair, it's our 1 family vacation in years, since this reservation was made 4 plus months ago, to schedule a remodel while actively renting a vacation property is blatantly wrong and someone should be accountable.Buyer Beware, this rental company is not interested in customer service. If your rental has an issue, it is likely nothing will be resolved in your favor. It seems that they have too many properties and no quality control. Perhaps they are forgetting that vacation rental customers do have legal rights in these matters. If we as customers must abide by the signed contract, so must the rental company.

name: Dom
title: Book Elsewhere
text: When you are spending quite a bit of money to rent a cabin, you expect a great experience. Unfortunately, that was not the case for us. We stayed at The Nest at Seven Devils. When we walked into the cabin, we saw two fridges, one in the kitchen and the other right near the stairs where there's little space to walk past. We thought it was a bit odd until we started putting food in the fridge that is in the kitchen and realized the fridge isn't working. No one informed us of this. Made sense now that they had two fridges. We started putting our food in the other fridge and realized that fridge also was not working. So now there's two fridges that don't work. Then we tried to connect to the wifi. Could not find the wifi name on the list of networks. We called customer service about the fridge and the wifi. One of the maintenance guys came and informed us that the second fridge is here because the first one stopped working with the people before us, and he confirmed the second fridge wasn't working. He said first thing in the morning he would replace the fridge. We also spoke to him about the wifi and finally figured it out and confirmed the login information given was not correct. Next morning, it's 10AM and no one has come yet to replace the fridge. I call customer service which is in India and told me they reached out to whoever they needed to get the status of when we will be receiving the fridge. I told her I'll gladly stay on the phone until she receives a response, but she told me she has to end the session so she can contact whoever it is she needs to about the fridge. But she told me she already reached out to someone, so that made no sense, so I said I am not ending the call until you hear back from someone. So we sat on the phone in silence for about five minutes and then she proceeds to tell me the fridge request ticket is actually closed and was taken care of? I said no it's absolutely not resolved, and we did not get a replacement we need one. She said she would call me back in five minutes to reach out to them again, I said fine. Did she call me back? Nope. So I called customer service again, got a different rep, told them the situation and need someone asap. The maintenance guy from the first night called me and said he ended up switching days with someone else and will let them know to call me and give me a status. No one called. Three hours later I called the same maintenance guy back letting him know and he apologized and said he'll call them right away. They finally came and replaced the fridge. The replacement fridge also wasn't working correctly, but had a little coolness to it, and we were just very tired from the back and forth, so we just hoped for the best. Oven was filthy, kitchenware was not cleaned, found food on plates. Pictures on the website are outdated and don't have the same items in the cabin such as knives, table, end tables, etc. The blinds on the windows are broken, bathroom door handle is falling off, shower faucet is loose, blanket was dirty, found a used tissue on the floor. The welcome packet to read when you arrive is not up to date. It says they only have a gas fireplace, when the living room has a wood burning. The fireplace on the lower level is gas and it looks like it's taken apart, not sure if it works or not. The wood burning fireplace was the highlight of our stay, but overall, not worth booking through this company. And reading the BRMR responses in these google reviews, there seems to be no accountability at all and keep blaming their customers.

text: I'd like to begin with the positives of the home. We spent our 1st christmas as a family in this beautiful place. Upon arriving, we were all excited with the views and comforts of the house. Seemed maybe the bed had broken underneath from a previous stay. The topper would try and fold us both up in it as though we were burritos. It left us unable to utilize the bed and sleep on the couch. The home is allowing animals, but the cleanliness of the hair, we found while laying on the rug, was proof of a faulty vacuum. They informed us they will switch out to help other stays in the future. There are mouse droppings under the stove area and large pan area, I assume from an opening under the stove.  As I stated, these are just happenings we encountered. This isn't anything to take away from the homes magnificent overall feeling. We were able to build memories in spite of our events. text: Tour code GB511.First, a word about our tour guide—she was truly wonderful and incredibly knowledgeable about every detail of the trip, from the towns and cities along the route to the rich history of England and Scotland. The driver was equally impressive, navigating both city streets and long countryside roads with ease and professionalism.Now, about the trip itself. When I first read the tour description covering England, Ireland, and Scotland, I assumed there wouldn’t be much to learn and that it might feel a bit dull—but that was a big mistake. London turned out to be fantastic, Ireland was full of charming towns and beautiful scenery, and Scotland was simply wonderful. Edinburgh, in particular, stood out with its vibrant atmosphere and two-night stay, which gave us plenty of time to explore its many attractions.All in all, it was an excellent trip with pleasant weather, unforgettable experiences, and lasting memories across three incredible countries. Thank you!

We added on a day to go to Disney Tokyo!!  We fed snow monkeys and the bowing deer in Nara.  We saw beautiful flowers in bloom and witnessed the cleanest and safest country we have visited in our 30 years of traveling to more than 25 countries. We love Globus but found their independent yours to be uniquely personal and flexible versus the structured group tours.  We look forward to our next journey with Globus!!

title: NOT WORTH THE MONEY!!
text: 25th April - 6th May 2025.I recently took a trip to The Highlights of Ireland & Scotland.We travelled across Southern Ireland stopping in Dublin/Kilkenny/Waterford/Tramore. Then on to Blarney/Ring Of Kerry/Killarney.Then on to Adare/Cliffs of Moher/Galway/Sligo.Then on to Derry/Giant's Causeway and Belfast, Northern Ireland.Then we took a ferry from Belfast overto Alloway, Scotland & Glasgow.Then from Glasgow we went on to Fort William, Fort Augustus, Culloden Moor, Highlands.Then from The Highlands we went to Loch Lomond, Pitlochry, St Andrews and finishing in Edinburgh.Out of a coach of 45 people we were the only two from England and the rest of the coach (apart from an Indian couple) were Americans. We were not advised on booking that this would be the case.Some were ok, but the majority were very clicky and did not speak or acknowledge us.I asked our coach tour guide (who was Canadian) if you get many english people on the tours and she said no. She said they were mainly Americans, Australians & New Zealanders.I found that a bit strange as Cosmos are a UK based independent tour operator.Out of the 11 nights we were there we only got 5 evening meals.. 2 that were included on paid evening trips out and 3 in the hotels. Some hotels had a bar that you could order food from.For what the holiday cost I expected a much better service. After being on a coach for 8 hours every day, I assumed an evening meal would be included at each hotel. The old saying is "you get what you pay for" so I expected the hotel rooms to be better than what they were.By the time we had bought two meals  and a couple of drinks we had spent at least £50.00 a night.The stop off in Glasgow was in the centre of town and it was like a university dormatory room with no wardrobes.It was very tiring with bags out at the coach for 6.45am, 7 o'clock breakfasts and 8 o'clock starts. We were travelling all day until about 6pm when we would get to the next destination for the evening.It was an experience.. Galway and Giants Causeway were the best stop off places, but I wouldn't want to repeat it and I definitely wouldn't recommend it.

title: Amazing vacation but pre-trip communication need some work.
text: Firstly, the experience itself was amazing. Everything from the tour director to the driver was an incredible relaxing experience and I would recommend it to anybody. The tour director I really can't say enough good things about. He was a local from Rome and knew all of the areas the history and was able to translate if needed. He took care of everything soup to nuts and really made it enjoyable relaxing experience for everyone on board.However some pre-trip communications could be improved upon. About 6 months before the trip kicked off I accidentally stumbled upon a pretty major itinerary change. They had changed a day in Rome from Vatican, Sistine Chapel, coliseum, and basilica to just the basilica and a choice of other tours. To me, The change itself was not what upset me. I understand that things can happen. What upset me more was the fact that I was not notified. These are pretty significant tourist destinations and I would later find out that I was not the only one who was extremely upset by this. I as well as several other people on the trip had booked all of those locations to see separately because that was one of the primary reasons I booked the trip in the first place. Many of the people on the tour booked them in place of the included tour that they changed it to because they wanted to see it that badly. The tour guide was nice enough to tell us why the itinerary had changed but in my opinion, this should have been communicated as soon as the itinerary changed and we should have been given some options if we still wanted to see those things.Another less troublesome improvement that could be made is that Globus has deceptively simple descriptions for all of their itinerary and optional excursions. Now I'm not complaining about this because all the excursions were amazing I just think the descriptions didn't really do the excursions justice. Most notably was the balsamic vinegar tasting described simply as such. But what I experienced was a private historical tour of how balsamic vinegar was made, with integrated balsamic vinegar tasting and followed by an exquisite lunch with dried meats cheese and wine. Again it was a magnificent experience I just thought that the description didn't really do it justice and making the description a little bit more robust in what to expect may entice more people to splurge on the more expensive vacation instead of the lesser Globus priced vacation in which most of your excursions you do on your own.Lastly, but certainly not least, my favorite tours were the ones that were a little off the beaten path. That felt like private tours that had little crowds, but gave you amazing history as well as a minor culinary experience. One of my favorites was Jewish ghetto which had an incredibly rich history as well as getting to taste some pastrys. Paired with a detailed description of what to expect, I personally would be more likely to book a trip again if I knew those particular details were being looked at.

title: Southern Italy should not be overlooked
text: We went on the 'Southern Italy Escape' and thoroughly enjoyed the tour.  This tour of a lesser know area of Italy focused on Matera, Lecce, and Alberobello, and is well worth a visit.  We felt Globus had done a good job of designing the tour.  There are some instances where we thought a bit more time here or there would have been a better choice (e.g., less time in Napoli and more time on the Eastern coast), but those concerns were minor.  Generally the hotels themselves exceeded expectations, but the locations relative to the key cities (especially Lecce) could be improved (That's only only reason it is not a 5 star rating: more like 4.5).  We took all 3 optional excursions, and each was well worth it - especially the last one that included a 'farmhouse dinner'.  The guide and driver were both outstanding.  So this small group version of the tour was a delight, and is  highly recommended - especially if you want to avoid the crowds of the 'big 3' Italian cities.

name: PHX DLVRY DRVR
title: They Don't Care About The Travelers
text: I took The Legacy of the Incas with Peru's Amazon tour that ended on March 8 2025. This was my 9th tour with the Globus/Cosmos company. Globus met my expectations on the previous 8 tours, and they continued to until this happened.We were staying at a hotel called Casa Andina Premium Miraflores in Lima with 3 days left on the tour. We were then going to a hotel in Paracas and then returning to the same hotel in Lima for the last night. I was low on cash, and I asked my tour director to recommend an ATM machine because I didn't have enough cash to tip him a decent amount that I thought he deserved. The ATM machine gave me the cash that I requested , but they stole my card! The hotel refused to let me talk to the hotel manager, they offered no apology, and no attempt to compensate me. My tour director, Mauricio, finally convinced them to assist me in calling my financial institution to get the card canceled. Whoopie!!!! I finally got an apology from the hotel after my card was canceled, but that apology was 40 minutes overdue, and still no compensation was offered, such as free room service, free laundry, free drinks at the bar, or a cash refund for the dollar amount spent in the room.For the lack of apology given to me in a timely manner, and for the lack of any compensation offered,  I then told Mauricio that I refused to go back to that hotel and asked Mauricio to contact Globus to hook me up to a new hotel. If Mauricio was telling me the truth, Globus completely ignored my request and didn't give me another hotel, and didn't have the common courtesy to call, text, or email me when they knew I was upset! I paid an extra $200 for another hotel, an Uber ride to that hotel, and the hotel dinner.When I got home, I reported this tour to Globus, and received a notification almost instantly saying they will look into the incident, but to allow 4 weeks for a decision. I checked my email today, (4 days later), and there was a response from Globus. A lady from Globus management, who gave her name as Stacey Nass apologized but gave me no compensation. Her excuse was that Globus, and the hotel didn't steal from me, it was the ATM. While technically true, these companies are all associated with each other. Stacey said the hotel offered me a free room upgrade, which was true, but they didn't offer that to until just a few hours before we arrived in Lima, and day and a half later. By then it was too late. I already paid for another hotel.In Globus attitude, the hotels can treat us like trash, and we are supposed to their robots and punching bags and take their crap! They don't respect people who stand up for themselves. If the hotel apologized and try to compensate me in a timely manner, then I wouldn't have needed Globus to compensate me. Globus would rather have a 1 star review then make us travelers happy. Use Gate 1, Intrepid, Trafalgar, Insight, Collette, or any other company for your future travels.

Our tour director Paulina was friendly, personable and took care of all logistics with patience and care for all of us (there were 41 of us). title: Wonderful trip of a lifetime
text: This tour of Italy has it all. You start in Venice, then Florence, Assisi, Rome and Sorrento.  The sights you see are AMAZING and most admissions are included.  Extra things can cost up to 20 euros, like going to the top of the leaning tower of Pisa. The hotels were nice and the bus was very comfortable. The tour director, Erica was great; she was very knowledgeable and helpful.The local guides were also very good. The trip is fast paced with lots of walking, especially up stairs, inclines and uneven surfaces.  The breakfast is okay.  The dinners are mostly extra as excursions that you have to pay for additionally.  The bus stops for lunch/snacks every day and plenty of bathroom breaks.  The only drawback is that if you want to do things like throw a coin in the Trevi Fountain, you cannot because the line is VERY long and you are on a time schedule.  You do get free time on your own to shop/explore/eat dinner etc.  All on all a WONDERFUL trip.

title: Great Globus employees and a great trip!
text: The first thing I'd like to share is a quick shout out to one of the travelers on our trip.  He is a Globus employee, and he was so fun!  And so enthusiastic!  Matt Spillner is a representative out of the Minneapolis area, and we spent many dinners with him as he spoke enthusiastically about all the Globus offerings.  He is the best cheerleader Globus could have.  I wish someone like Matt could come to our area.  He is so fun!  We live in a Del Webb Active 55+ community in Huntley IL.  No one around here has heard of Globus.  We ordered our trip online because we've used Globus before, and my parents had used Globus for many years.  Lots of retired people here are looking for things to do....Anyway, on to our trip:  We had a wonderful trip!  We never worried from the minute we saw the "Globus" representative meeting us at the airport in Rome until we boarded the plane going home.  Globus does such a wonderful job of taking care of every detail from beginning to end - and the choices that were made as to where we went, what we saw, and where we ate were all perfect.  Our tour guide, Alessandra was amazing.  He knew everything about every place we went and was so calm and patient with all the travelers' needs.  He is absolutely the best!  There is no way we could have made this journey on our own!  The only surprise we had was that we were probably the oldest couple on the trip.  We assumed that this would be a trip of retired people (being in the middle of February) but most people were much younger than us.  We had to pace ourselves accordingly.  I'm sure there's not much you can do about that, but it was the only issue in our otherwise perfect experience.

title: Excellent Service, Worth the Cost, Not a Scam
text: I paid $450+ to get my passport 7-9 day expedited. I'm writing this review because after I sent my documents in I started reading a lot of bad reviews for this service. I sent my completed documents and passport in the mail on 4/1 and received my new passport on 4/9 (even though when I spoke with someone they forecasted a 4/16 delivery date). I'm thrilled I can actually go on my vacation - the cost was well worth it.My suggestion to everyone is just confirm you have all the proper documents completed EXACTLY as your directed. Missing any of the forms or incorrectly completing them seems to lead to delays. I would also ignore an email you will receive from the State Department after they get your passport that says it will take 2-3 weeks for expedited service: that is a generic, automated email.Overall I love this service and want people to know it is NOT A SCAM.

All you did is pay a ridiculous fee for shipping. 2-3 week turnaround (sometimes sooner) is the normal expedited process from the state department that they charge $60 for. The state dept also provides you with updates if you log in to their website to check. The worst if what I paid for, ironically called "smart service." I paid $119, their website software simply filled in the application from the state dept website (which by the way, there were a few mistakes with the rushmypassport software) and provided me with essentially the same checklist provided by the state department. Part of the checklist said "no inbound label required, post office worker will send" to which I figured, Ok well then they must send it some special fast way once they heard I've paid for "smart service" right? right? I went to a website affiliated with FedEx call "rush my passport" so I must have paid $119 for some sort of quicker than usual service, right? WRONG. After downloading the application I realize I have been duped into spending $119 just to go to their website to fill out the application. Everything else that is done to actually rush the passport is through the state department, with their own fees paid when I submit the app at the post office. I assume for the $800 service these tools perhaps actually slap a $35 FedEx shipping label on the application? This service is taking advantage of people who for whatever reason seem not to realize they can get their passport pretty quickly directly through the dept of state (admittedly, that was me; I actually trusted FedEx, my bad, won't be using them for anything again).  People who are busy and just search for "passport fast" see FedEx and think, "OK FedEx (or AAA or AARP, apparently, who also have partnered with these scammers) I can trust these known organizations/companies if they say this is how to get my passport the fastest"Then people end up paying a RIDICULOUS upcharge for shipping, or in my case, ("smart service") I didn't even get that!!

title: I strongly advise against using this…
text: I strongly advise against using this service, as it is neither as transparent nor as legitimate as it claims to be. In my experience, it operates in a misleading manner that borders on being a scam.I urgently needed a passport for my son and I, for a upcoming trip about five weeks away. I had already completed the necessary forms and obtained the required photos. Due to time constraints and difficulty securing an appointment through the Post Office, I decided—in good faith—to pay for expedited service through RushMyPassport.To my surprise, the $200 fee per application simply resulted in a pre-filled version of the form I had already completed myself. I was then instructed to take this form to a Post Office and submit it along with a check for the government processing fees. However, when I arrived, the clerk informed me that the form provided by RushMyPassport was not valid and that I would need to make an appointment and re-submit the application correctly.Frustrated, I visited a second Post Office for confirmation and was told the same thing. In fact, the clerk mentioned that they regularly see people misled by the same service.Ultimately, I walked in to a local Post Office, used the original documents I had prepared myself, paid the appropriate fees, and successfully expedited my application directly through them. My passport arrived within one week.Meanwhile, RushMyPassport continued to send automated emails claiming that my application was being processed—even though I already had my passport in hand. They used a contact email address (something like @govworks.com) I never authorized or monitored. Eventually, I received messages saying the passport was completed, then shipped, and finally "delivered to my home"—none of which was true. Unsurprisingly, nothing ever arrived.This experience was extremely disappointing and a clear example of deceptive business practices. I hope others can avoid the same mistake by going directly through official government channels.

text: This service provided everything they promised. Yes- you WILL still have to meet with someone to approve your documents.  NO they are not affiliated with the government, and they say so very plainly.  Yes, you CAN do all of this yourself, and save money, but if you are caught having to travel sooner than you expected, or didn't realize your passport had expired- this service can help you get your passport quickly.  I did have to wait on the phone for a while- but they were upfront about how long the wait might be.  We had a problem at the passport acceptance site- the person in charge said they could not sign off on the passport as it was "too early" and that expediting had to be done within a certain time frame.  So, I called the customer service number, and the gentleman that helped me found several other sites we could try instead with open appointments.  He even sent us the addresses and phone numbers via email and offered to help further if needed.  We got the passport in the mail, exactly as promised.  I'd surmise the bad reviews are mostly from folks that were in too much of a hurry to read and follow the instructions.

I was first informed by the agent that I will receive my passport on back on the 19th of March, then he said the 17th of March. name: Shabil Sha
title: My Refund Was Finally Resolved — But Only After Posting a Public Review on Trustpilot
text: I’m sharing my full experience with EaseMyTrip regarding a refund for a cancelled international flight (Booking ID: XXT142778047) so that others don’t face the same frustration and confusion.I had booked three tickets with Air India Express (Doha to Calicut), which I cancelled. As per the cancellation policy, I was eligible to receive Rs. 19,332 after deducting Rs. 6,000 per passenger (Rs. 5,500 airline fee + Rs. 500 EaseMyTrip service charge). Air India Express processed the refund on the same day of cancellation, so the delay wasn’t on the airline’s part.However, I initially received only Rs. 7,908. I contacted EaseMyTrip via email, providing all details and calculations. Following this, another Rs. 6,000 was credited — still leaving a balance of Rs. 5,424 unpaid, with no clear explanation provided. Customer service responded with generic, copy-paste replies and completely ignored the specific concerns I raised.Out of sheer frustration, I posted a review on Trustpilot on 05/05/2025, and also filed a formal complaint with the National Consumer Helpline (NCH), Grievance No: 0XX710040X, to uphold my rights as a consumer.Only after this public escalation did EaseMyTrip start contacting me personally — through WhatsApp messages and calls from their Delhi office, including on my Qatar number. They requested that I withdraw the review and soon after, credited the remaining refund along with an unexplained Rs. 576 extra.While I appreciate that the refund is now complete, it’s disappointing that I had to take public and legal steps for what should have been a routine process. The delay and lack of proper customer support caused unnecessary stress.To future customers: Keep all documentation, don’t rely solely on their support emails, and escalate if needed. Without pressure, you may not get the resolution you deserve.To EaseMyTrip: Please take this seriously and improve your customer support and refund transparency. No one should have to go through this for a basic refund that the airline already processed.– Shabil Sha

This person did not ask me any questions, just took my ticket, copied my reservation number and let me go.Since the week of Dec 4th, I have having to deal with the first attendant and he has been giving me a hard time. On the 8th, he said that my reservation is not visible. Luckily, I had another reservation and that worked (but that was for the week of 11th)Now on the week of 11th to 14th, the same attendant again said that my reservation does not pop up and I tried to call On Air Parking to resolve it. But it was 8 pm PST and they had closed. However, the attendant found my reservation some how and helped me solve the issue. This attendant told me that I should not mix up reservations, which did not make sense as the reservations are for particular dates. I had tried my best to be patient all this time as no matter what, I had a reservation from a third party which is authorized by this facility. So as far as I give the receipt, I should be free to go.Today, I had a the same issue again and with the same attendant. He started telling me that my reservation does not pop up. I tried to tell him, in any case I have the receipt, why not just use that. He just would not accept it. I completely lost my cool and did start yelling at him, especially because he asked me to pay the full charge. I ended up pay $47.98, even though I had a reservation paid in full.In the midst of the argument, this attendant mentioned that if my reservation was good then why did I have to pull a ticket and not scan my reservation. AND this is where I lost my cool even further. Going back 6 weeks - this is the same attendant from whom I tried to get directions onw what I need to do when parking with a reservation. HE WAS THE ONE WHO SAID, PULL A TICKET AND IT WILL BE SETTELED ON THE WAY OUT.Seriously, I never had to break my head anywhere when I had a reservation. This guy seriously needs some training.

title: To whom it may concern my name is…
text: To whom it may concern my name is Liezel DeguinonI just wanted to share my story flying with Cheap Air, since it was a worth story to tell, my frustration and disappointments lingering and must sit at my computer to write.I booked a flight through Cheap Air Flying Vancouver to Manila, Manila to General Santos City (Philippines Airlines) Last February 28, 2025, Booking reference #86599991, Cheap Air had moved the time of the original flight from Manila to General Santos City, I phone them and says I won’t be able to fly that Manila to General Santos City (April 2, 2025)since will be arrived Manila 5:30 Am and the flight to General Santos city move to 4 pm, I was clear that I won't take that flight, they did not inform me that if I no show It will affect my flight back, It frustrate me to think that I had spoken with them in the phone clearly that I won’t be able to take that flight and they say nothing about it will affect my flight back, why, because they want to make money and make my life miserable nobody seems to care nobody inform me emails or calls that my flight back in cancelled, considering I’m on my vacation.March 27, 2025, we all packed to go and tried to check in online only to find out that my flight is cancelled, calling Philippines Airline, Cheap Air put me on hold from 12:Am to 5:30 am in the morning trying to figure out whats going on, very unprofessional don’t know how to deal with customer hang up on me many times, what I don’t understand is I told them I won’t be able to flight that manila to general Santos city since they move the flight and now they cancelled my flight back that I already paid for it, and now they told me to book a flight back.Long story short, I had to purchase a ticket back which was the cheapest for the 3 of us $4674.6 and they couldn’t find a flight back the next day so we had to wait till April 3, 2025, extended my stay 5 days spending money with hotels, figured out where to stay since our check out is next day, and missing the day of work, these people no idea what we been through and flying with a small child.I can’t express enough my frustration, I try to let it go and forget about it but I have to do something about it, so in total round trip from Vancouver to General Santos city we spent $10,000, re buy a ticket back when it’s not my fault, as a customer I should get my money back since it’s not my fault and changing hour of flight when its not my fault and we have schedules to make we should get compensated. This is the worst flight of my life, I hope everyone wears my shoes.and understand where it's coming from, I was not able to sleep that night not to mention spending a lot of money for something it’s not my fault. The Airline rules are very unacceptable if no show they will cancel your flight that you already paid for, tell me if that makes sense.All in all, I just want to share my story and hope that it won’t happen to anyone.

text: I initially chose Passports and Visas.com because their pricing seemed more reasonable than other services. Unfortunately, my experience with them was frustrating and disappointing.Communication & Customer ServiceWhile I received timely automated responses about the process, they were generic and lacked any real personalization. The company advertises that you can contact them anytime with questions, but in reality, calls and emails go unanswered. When I requested to speak with someone or escalate concerns to management, I was given the runaround.My assigned representative, Patty, was difficult to reach. She never answered my direct calls or voicemails. The few times I managed to speak with her, it was only after waiting on hold with another representative. To her credit, she was pleasant and professional, but that didn’t make up for the overall lack of responsiveness.After much persistence, I finally received the manager Philip Diack’s contact information. I left a voicemail and, days later, received a generic email apology for the lack of communication. When I replied with more details as requested, the manager never followed up.Processing & Accuracy IssuesAlthough my spouse and I eventually received our passports, the process was far from smooth. The online portal was flawed, and the information did not properly transfer into the government documentation. We had to redo everything at the post office, where an employee mentioned that they had heard similar complaints from other customers.Another major issue was that we submitted both our applications together, yet Passports and Visas.com only acknowledged receipt of one. When I called to inquire about the second application, they claimed they don’t open envelopes, as they go directly to the U.S. processing facility. This left me questioning: what exactly are they reviewing for accuracy?Final ThoughtsWhile Passports and Visas.com ultimately delivered the passports, the lack of communication, poor service, and unnecessary complications made the process more stressful than it needed to be. Their website gives the impression of a large, professional operation, but in reality, they seem disorganized with few employees and no internal coordination.Had they been upfront about simply charging $700 to hand-walk my passport through the system, I would have accepted that. Instead, they overpromise customer service and follow-through, but fail to deliver. Based on my experience, I would not recommend them. If you’re looking for an expedited passport, you might be better off going directly through the post office or another reputable service.

Every call included some assurance on their part that I would receive follow-up via call or email by the end of the day, and not once was this promise fulfilled. Even a request to have my case be escalated to another level of management received no resolution. To this day my experience has yet to be acknowledged by anyone at Passports and Visas despite my requests on numerous occasions to have my complaints documented. title: This website scammed $500 from us
text: This website scammed $500 from us.My wife wanted to get a 90-day Chinese visa for her study abroad coming up. She was supposed to leave on the morning of May 10, 2024. She already had a visa, but realized in mid April that the length of stay required a new visa. We looked up Passports and Visas on Google, and found a bunch of favorable reviews. They said they were detailed oriented. They said they got things done fast and on time. It was a lie to us.We overnighted the passport and documents to our case handler, "Meridyth G" on Wednesday, April 24th. They claimed they got it on Friday, April 26th. Then, radio silence. We bought the five-day service package for ~$500, so we figured it had already been submitted and we were just waiting to hear back from the embassy. We asked for an update, but didn't get a response until the Friday afternoon on May 3, 2024, where they told us they just submitted the application for 5 business day processing. No idea why it took so long and why they cut it so close, but we trusted the advertising, we trusted they knew what they were doing.Then, on Tuesday May 7, 2024, we get an automated email saying our application was rejected. It was apparently rejected because one of the pages missed my wife's last name, a technicality. We were also informed that the processing for our application began on Monday, not on the Friday they submitted it. In other words, even if the mistake wasn't made, the 5 business day processing wouldn't have finished until the day that my wife needed to leave with said passport to China. How they planned to teleport her passport from Washington D.C. to our home is now besides the point.We asked for a refund. After all, they claimed they did things fast, they claimed they had experience, but left us in the dark and did things down to the wire. We gave them $500 for a visa, they only gave us heartburn. When we asked for a refund, they had the audacity to turn around and blame my wife. They said that she was the one who missed the last name on the forms, but their advertising that they would double and triple check your documents to make sure they are ready. They said that she didn't send the documents to them in time, but their advertising says they do stuff fast and she overnighted the documents to them 2 whole weeks for a 5 business day service.The worst part is, we're glad to have made the mistake. They submitted her passport for 5 day business processing on Monday when they knew she was leaving Friday morning. If the embassy hadn't kicked it back on Tuesday and did the full 5-day processing, there was physically no way for them to get my wife her passport by 8 AM Friday morning.These scammers still refuse to return our money. I wouldn't trust these fraudsters to deliver a pizza, much less my travel documents, and you shouldn't either.

text: I am a real customer and my experience was beyond horrible and it almost made us miss our trip had I not gotten an appointment in DC at the passport agency as Passportsandvisas.com not only lost my boyfriend’s passport at the last minute, but our customer service agent stopped communicating with us (he never really communicated with us that much in the first place.  To put the story into context, I was handling getting my boyfriend’s passport renewed for him as he just didn’t have time to do it himself.On Match 11, 2024 I overnighted the passport renewal info for my boyfriend to his assigned customer service agent Mike Sosa who is located in Florida.  He did communicate with me to confirm that all of the documents were correctly filled out and that the documents had been received.That was the last time I heard from Mike Sosa until I emailed him April 17, 2024 to ask about the status of the passport.  Mike emailed me back on April 18th to inform me that the passport would arrive April 24, 2024.  The passport never arrived.  I emailed Mike Sosa multiple times on April 24, 2024.   I also called passportsandvisas.com five times on April 24, 2024 and spoke to five different women all of whom hung up on me while I was telling them that the passport never arrived and could they please update me on where it was.  It was like the call dropped every time.  I got no where.Mike called me for the first time ever on April 25, 2024 and told me that the passport had been lost somewhere between their office in Colorado and the passport agency.  The entire reason I decided to go with this company was that they were supposed to be able to monitor the process of the passport in it’s journey of getting renewed, it was supposed to be white glove service.  Then tell me how/why Mike Sosa told me on April 18th that the passport was getting processed and it would be overnighted to my boyfriend on Tuesday, April 23, 2024 and would arrive Wednesday, April 24, 2024?  Shouldn’t he have been able to see that the passport never made it to the State Department??   Had I not emailed him the day it was supposed to arrive and just waited, would he have ever contacted me?  Who knows.While on the phone with Mike he told me that he would email me the instructions for the new situation we found ourselves in, that of a now lost passport.  Please realize at this point, I only had a week left before our trip.  I asked Mike Sosa would passportsandvisas.com pay for the state department fee since they lost the passport.  He told me he would check with his manager and never called me back.  I called and left multiple voicemails for Mike Sosa and I also emailed him and he never responded. I’m still emailing him asking for a refund for the $237 my boyfriend paid for the expediting service that never occurred.So what did we do?  We got on the State Department’s website and got an appointment at the passport agency in Washington, DC and got his passport in one day.  I’ve never heard back from Mike Sosa after six emails asking for a refund for a service that was never provided.I tell you all of this as my experience matches up exactly with what everyone on Facebook said happened to them.  They would call into the company and not only did it take an act of congress to get someone to answer the phone, but they constantly got hung up on.  I received no help at all when I called the company.  Mike Sosa to this day will not return my phone calls or emails.  I truly believe that this company is a sham.  If you want nothing more than a run around, headache, to lose your money and possibly miss your trip then go ahead and give passportsandvisas.com a try.  I wouldn’t waste my time and I would drive to your nearest passport agency and try to get a same day passport appointment.Please go see my Facebook review to see copies of the emails I sent to my account manager, Mike Sosa.  He never responded.

title: Scaling you to not give your money back
text: My experience with Transavia regarding the cancellation of flight TO7601 on December 28, 2024, from Porto to Paris-Orly has been extremely disappointing and frustrating.Initially, the airline stated that the cancellation was due to weather conditions. However, the reasoning behind their denial of compensation changed repeatedly over time, shifting from “weather” to ambiguous claims about “airport capacity” issues without providing any substantial evidence. Despite multiple explicit requests under EU Regulation 261/2004 for Transavia to present legally required documents (such as official NOTAMs, Air Traffic Control directives, internal operational records, or clear explanations why other flights, including another Transavia flight TO7611 from the exact same route and time frame, were able to land), they have consistently refused or failed to deliver adequate proof.Throughout my correspondence with their customer support, Transavia repeatedly attempted to direct me towards third-party intervention and mediation rather than directly fulfilling their legal obligations. Such practices clearly violate EU Regulation 261/2004, under which the burden of proof lies explicitly with the airline to demonstrate that extraordinary circumstances were genuinely unavoidable and beyond their control.Recently, Transavia has resorted to delaying tactics, repeatedly stating the case is “under review,” but providing no meaningful updates or additional information. This deliberate stalling appears to be a tactic to discourage passengers, like myself, from pursuing rightful legal claims through appropriate channels.Overall, Transavia’s handling of this issue has been marked by:•	Inconsistent and changing explanations for denial of compensation.•	Repeated refusal to provide required legal documentation.•	Unlawful insistence on third-party mediation to avoid fulfilling legal duties.•	Deliberate delays and avoidance tactics to prevent timely resolution.Due to this deeply unsatisfactory experience and their apparent disregard for passenger rights under European law, I strongly advise caution when dealing with Transavia. Future customers should be aware that resolving legitimate compensation claims may involve extensive frustration and potentially necessitate legal action.I am currently preparing legal action to enforce my rights under EU261, given Transavia’s continued refusal to comply voluntarily.

title: Worst company in the existence
text: Worst company in the existence. For my 30th birthday, we book a flight for 5-day holiday in Iceland with my husband between 29.01.2015-03.02.2025 in July 2024. In September, they changed the flight on the 29th to 31st (which is my birthday), but we thought that's fine, there is plenty of time and we could also change the accommodation check-in.In the evening of 30 January, as we were preparing our bags, just 13 hours before the flight they sent a message saying that it is postponed to the 2nd of February from 31st of January because of weather conditions. I was so disappointed, but I thought it is not their fault, nobody can control the weather. We decided to cancel since we wouldn't even spend 24 hours there.What comes after with their customer service was entirely their fault though. I filled in the forms from their website to get a refund for our tickets, part of the accommodation that I could not get a refund and the car rental which I could not get a refund at all because rental company has a policy of not refunding if the cancellation occurs less than 48 hours to pick up time. Since we bought our flights 6 months ago, we were not using the same credit card we used to pay the flights. In the first response that I got via email, they told me I cannot get a refund for accommodation or car rental but they refunded the flights to the same card we used to pay. I told them please do not refund to that card because we are not using it anymore, it was from another non-eu country we used to live, we do not have any access to that bank or card. And I also explained them I know my rights, they should reimburse me for accommodation and car rental as well. Then they ignored the part with the credit card and they told me okay you can but please show us the necessary documents. I don't even have the energy to explain everything that we talked after this moment because it has been 3 days and we are still talking. In this period, my flight get refunded to a card we don't use anymore from a bank in a country we don't live anymore and not very reachable by phone as it is non-eu. I got refund for my accommodation (after sending my IBAN information once and sending an official bank statement showing my IBAN from email twice, thank god!), and they refuse to pay reimbursement for my car rental because apparently the invoice, the bank statement, the screenshots of the emails with car rental company which shows that they will not do a refund and the car rental company's cancellation policy page on their website are not enough.But the final point for me was when I sent the invoice for the car rental (that I requested from the car rental) and the cancellation policy from car rental's website, the customer service employee from Transavia told me "you have a premium package, and it says you can get a refund when you have it." Mind you it is not written anywhere. The cancellation policy is the same with everyone. The packages are just for the damage coverage. I think they are trying to get you to a point where you say "I don't want to deal with this anymore" so they will get away without paying the refund and reimbursements. They are asking impossible documents from the bank that I told them from the beginning we were not using that card anymore. Their customer service is awful. So, book with transavia if:1) going to the destination is not super important to you2) you are extremely patient and have a lot of spare time to answer the emails and get the necessary documents ready3) you are so rich that you do not care about the refund or reimbursements

name: Elizabete
title: How Transavia Handles Its Passengers
text: How Transavia Handles Its Passengers: A Shocking Disregard for Rights and ResponsibilitiesHere’s the response I received from Transavia after my complaint:Dear Mrs,I contact you regarding the request for compensation and the unused ticket with another airline that was related to this cancelled flight under the booking number SCE8MZ.Offering compensation does depend on the reason for the disruption. The flight was postponed due to bad weather condition. It was resided from outside our responsibility and considered as an Extraordinary Circumstance. So, there is no entitlement to compensation.Regarding the unused ticket, we are not responsible for the missed services mainly after the original flight with us. We are only able to refund the incurred expenses during the moment of disruption or while waiting for the departure time.Lastly, I see that you were boarded on the alternative flight with us. As we know, our ticket is not refundable. Therefore, I cannot grant the request for compensation.I remain at your disposal if you have question. I wish you a nice afternoon.Kind regards,MackedonyTransavia Service CentreThis is how Transavia “solves” problems — by shifting blame and refusing to take responsibility for their actions.Here’s the situation in detail:1. Refusal to reimburse unused tickets:Because of Transavia’s cancellation, I couldn’t use my connecting Ryanair tickets. Transavia directly caused this issue, yet they refused to reimburse me for the unused tickets.2. Refusal to reimburse alternative Wizz Air tickets:I was forced to purchase new Wizz Air tickets to reach my destination. Transavia still refuses to cover these unavoidable expenses, blatantly ignoring their obligations under EU Regulation 261/2004.3. Refusal to reimburse the cost of the Transavia flight itself:Transavia claims that because I flew the next day, they owe me nothing for the original flight. But this wasn’t a voluntary choice — it was the only option available due to their cancellation.4. A token gesture with hotel and meals:While Transavia provided a hotel and meals, this doesn’t excuse the fact that I’m out of pocket for the tickets and transportation costs caused by their negligence.5. The issue of connecting flights:My original itinerary allowed a 12-hour layover between flights — more than enough time to rest, prepare, and catch my next flight to Manchester. Transavia’s cancellation ruined this entirely, making it impossible for me to stick to my schedule.What I demand:I demand full reimbursement for all my expenses caused by Transavia’s cancellation. This includes:• Unused Ryanair tickets.• Wizz Air replacement tickets.• Compensation for the cancelled Transavia flight.I am appalled by the company’s unwillingness to take responsibility and their blatant disregard for their passengers’ rights. If this matter is not resolved promptly, I will escalate it further by filing complaints with National Authorities and pursuing legal action.Transavia’s lack of accountability is shocking. Their indifference to passenger rights and outright refusal to follow EU regulations is unacceptable.

title: Transavia website source code implemented in a way to steal your money
text: Update:After I raised a complaint and a refund claim with Transavia on 6 September, I received an automated response that I would get a response within 3-6 weeks. After receiving no correspondence from Transavia, I called on 28 October.I was told that my case was closed without any case reviewer having reviewed it. It would now be reopened with an "urgent" note.On 29 October, I received a short response: that my claim was reviewed and they could not help. They claimed that what I argued could not be true because Transavia always asks for bank details before flight changes are made.It is clear that Transavia did not bother reading my claim as my claim was about an initial transaction that did not incur costs and was not confirmed by me which cost me additional charges for the following transaction.Transavia will steal money with a cheeky website and plead innocent. Avoid----I'm tentatively giving Transavia a 3-star review with subject to modification. I have so far flown twice with Transavia, once in May 2022 and once last week in September 2024, both on the same Paris - Berlin route.I do not have a recollection of anything specific from my first flight which is usually a neutral to positive remark for an airline, especially a low-cost one. My recent experience would have been positive had it not been for the following:I had booked my Paris - Berlin flight for 06.09.2024. On the morning of 06.09.2024, at around 10:30, I logged onto check what would happen if I changed my flight to 07.09.2024. I hadn't confirmed such plans as yet but wanted to see whether there was a price difference. On the phone app, at the top of the page, there were 5 green bars showing progress and on the 3rd step where the webpage clearly said "you will be asked for a final confirmation on the payment page", I clicked the "next" button and instead of going to what would be the 4th out of 5 steps and what I could only assume to be the "payment" page, I got a response saying my flight change was successful.Because there was no price difference (and therefore nothing to pay), there may not have been an additional step required to complete a payment but this does not mean that there should not have been a final confirmation page, as this is usual in all similar websites and most importantly, as this is what the instructions on the page I was on had claimed. Furthermore, an action is never completed with a "next" button; there's always a "confirm" or a "finalise" button.Having realised my flight was changed without my final confirmation, I immediately called the customer service whilst simultaneously checking to see if there would be a fare difference now if I wanted to revert my flight to the original 06.09.2024 -- there would be a 104€ to pay.At around 10:45, I spoke to the customer service agent (impressively short wait time). He was polite and professional but he only repeated that I would have to pay the 104€ for the change. I told him repeatedly that the webpage completed a transaction I had not confirmed. He insisted there was nothing he could help with and suggested I reach out to Transavia's WhatsApp account where "they may provide an exception".I immediately followed his advice and by 10:55, someone initially responded on WhatsApp asking me to explain the situation, while claiming "I can currently see your account and booking". For the next hour, upon my explanation of the story, no further response came.I then called the customer service again and this time a very rude and unprofessional agent kept arguing the same thing without even properly listening to me and consistently interrupting me. I asked for his name and for a supervisor to be connected to, both of which he refused.In the meanwhile, fearing the seats to the 06.09.2024 flight would sell out (or the price difference skyrocket further), I did pay the 104€ to revert the change that I did not want to make in the first place.I kept reaching out to Transavia through their social media accounts. WhatsApp was providing no further response and X / Twitter did not work either. An Instagram account representative suggested I issue a request / complaint which I had already done at this point.I took my 06.09.2024 flight which was a pleasant flight. The cabin crew members were joyful and polite. I ended up sitting next to a cabin crew member who was off-duty, flying to Berlin for the weekend. Overall, Transavia's aircraft and in-flight experience was satisfactory even though we were delayed for about half an hour without any explanation at the gate by the ground staff, nor by the captain on flight.Transavia claims they respond to requests / claims within 3-6 weeks; so, I'm waiting to hear back on what will hopefully be a positive and reasonable response on a mistake that was clearly originated from their website / app.

You pay you pay and you don't have ANYTHING.I booked a flight to Málaga from Amsterdam, within 24h I cancelled. Did not receive an email, as you can imagine people have things to do. I got an email about 10mins later asking me to 'confirm my cancellation' which I had already confirmed on their website, by the way. I only saw it the next morning, I pressed the confirm.I then immediately contacted transavia and explained the situation. Dear Joelle immediately told me that I had to proof, when I sent her screenshots with times of the emails. Even with the 10minutes buffer when they send the email I was within time.But dear Joëlle told me that I had no proof and that they will not reimburse me. Probably breaking a few EU laws, but apparently they are above it.I told her that I wanted someone from customer service to call me and she told me, you can call us AND IT'S GOING TO COST YOU 50C A MINUTE.Again, business model, let me steal as much as I can.Never book with them.I made the mistake twice.Prior to that I had a flight delayded 1.50h, of course not crossing the 2h mark cause they know otherwise we are entitled to compensation.Waisting our time and money because they are greedy. That's how companies fail unfortunately.

text: This airline’s business model seems to revolve around mistakes customers make. name: Co Schaap
title: Delayed flights, delayed luggage, terrible customer “service”
text: Flight from Crete to Amsterdam was delayed, meaning we would land in the middle of the night instead of at 23.30pm. We te wives a text message alerting us to the delay, however we were told that we still had to check our luggage in at the original time!! So we would have to hang around the busy Crete airport (with no airco) for 3 hours instead of 2. We paid extra for priority to have first row seats and Zone 1 boarding. Due to Transavia’s chaos, all zones go to the bus at once so all other zones boarded the plane before us, leaving no luggage bins available for the first row (except the crews’ bags). Stewardesses did not help at all. Once we arrived in Amsterdam, we had to taxi 15 minutes from the Polderbaan, then they didn’t even have the gate open. No one knew where to go. Escalator was running backwards so everyone had to carry bags and children up flight of stairs. Then luggage took 1.5 hours to come out so it’s now 2am, our pre-ordered taxi has already left yet I will have to pay for his time. A horrible experience, especially when traveling with children. Went to the Transavia/ Viggo service desk (as the baggage screens instructed us to do) and the two women were SO rude. If a baggage belt breaks, move the luggage to another one. Flights from Greece that arrived well after us, had their luggage long before us. Other flights that were on other belts, had their luggage come out on our belt, yet our bags couldn’t be brought up. Doesn’t make sense. Ridiculous and unprofessional.

name: Alessandro Roveda
title: Victim of abuse of authority
text: I was unfairly turned away from boarding the plane and placed on a watchlist.On July 1st, 2024 I was about to board the Transavia flight HV 5425 from Amsterdam to Pisa, but I was arbitrarily denied access to the plane by a Transavia employee. I am a frequent flyer and I travel on this same route multiple times every year. At the gate a Transavia employee (young white male) stopped me and told me I would have to pay extra fee to get into the plane with my trolly. This is exactly the same trolly I always take with me on exactly the same flight (and all the others) since many years now. I complained politely explaining this is same trolly as always on same flight and I had never had to pay any extra fee. The employee doesn’t want to listen so I ask to talk to someone else. At this pois the employee gets very annoyed and told me he would make sure I will not take the flight. He doesn’t allow me in the queue and this gets me very stressed. After all other passengers have boarded I have to call the airport security for help, but apparently Transavia employees at the gate have the unquestionable authority to decide who gets or not on the plane. The employee did not like I was asking questions and rather than providing explanations, or even letting me pay (I agreed in paying the fee for the trolly), he simply decided not to let me board the plane. it has been the most shameful and unfair experience I had to go through. I filed formal complaints asking Transavia to open a formal investigation about what really happened at the gate and they still haven’t responded. Instead I got a letter saying I will not be able to check in on line for the next 3 years as I am now on a watchlist. At each check in I  will have to go through an assessment at the counter for Transavia to decide if I am allowed or not on the plane. On top of being denied on the plane, Transavia denied to refund my ticket. This also makes me questioning how legal their behavior is. Up to now, more than a month after the incident, despite multiple emails I sent, Transavia never called me back to listen to my side of the story and never replied to my requests for opening a formal investigation about what happened at the gate and about the behavior of their employee.This is so unfair, the only thing I can do as customer, is sharing my horrendous experience and avoiding flying Transavia ever again.

title: Terrible airline.
text: Terrible airline.It was the only direct flight from Amsterdam to Sevilla, and it was therefore quite expensive, which was fine, as we thought we knew what to expect. Since this is a low-cost airline, both my boyfriend and I had to pay an extra €45 per trip in order to bring our two cabin bags with us (making the total ONLY for the hand lugguages to €135, on top of the price of the flight). However, once we got to the gate my hand lugguage (which I have already brought with me on the plane on many flights, also on other low-cost companies such as Easy Jet) did not (by less than 1cm) fit into the container two ladies were going around with at the gate, also calling on people that were not yet in line and were also travelling with children (and therefore had their arms full) to measure their hand lugguage. Now, I understand that these ladies were just doing their jobs and following directives from the airline. Indeed, my complaint is not about the employees, but rather about this so called "low-cost" airline. I also understand that I should have checked the lugguage measurements before hand, and that was indeed my mistake. I just went by the assumption that, having brought this lugguage on many flights, it fit the requirement of standard hand lugguages.Upon boarding the plane I had to pay on the spot an additional €65 to ship my lugguage, which I of course will also have to pay on my way back (for an additional total of €130).If you are travelling this same route (Amsterdam to Sevilla) I strongly recommend having a short layover and flying with regular airlines (apparently Transavia is the only company travelling this route directly, which in my opinion makes all of this even more problematic) or fly to another nearby airport, especially if you are travelling with children or people requiring extra assistance (we weren't, but I can easily imagine how that would have made the whole experience even more unpleasant).So, bottom line, I will never fly with Transavia again, even if I have to go an extra mile and take a layover.

title: Transavia Airlines: A Nightmare Experience
text: My recent experience with Transavia Airlines has been nothing short of a nightmare. For over a month now, they have held my suitcase hostage and refuse to send it back to me. The sheer incompetence and lack of customer service are staggering. From the beginning, the company's employees have been unhelpful and dismissive. Every attempt to speak to a supervisor has been met with firm refusals. When I ask them for solutions, they simply ignore me and don’t respond. The most infuriating part is their attitude. They have the audacity to get upset when I express my frustration at their complete lack of support. It's as if they expect me to be okay with their utter disregard for my situation. Somehow, they manage to twist the narrative, making me feel like I'm the unreasonable one, even though they’ve had my suitcase for over a month and refuse to take any meaningful steps to resolve the issue. Transavia Airlines has demonstrated an appalling lack of respect and responsibility towards their customers. I wouldn't recommend their services to anyone unless you're prepared for a frustrating and fruitless experience. Save yourself the headache and choose a different airline.

title: "Cheap" is actually very expensive
text: "Cheap" is actually very expensiveI flew with my family from France to Italy in the last week of June 2024. We purchased cabin baggage and priority boarding. My report here concerns especially the Transavia employees at Orly airport. Starting with the attitude that they were doing us a great favor by letting us board. They treat passengers like cheap merchandise that they don't like but are forced to board. In this context, they imply EVERYTHING they can and want to charge an extra exorbitant amount. We couldn't board with the cabin bags because they weren't the model they wanted, even though they had the measurements on the website and the same volume as the "accepted model". After much discussion, they checked the bags without charging. We did not receive the priority boarding we paid for. The funniest thing is that, despite treating passengers like trash, the employees are surprised when someone reacts and gets angry! I would like to mention the names of the employees involved here, but they refused to give me their names and took the tag off their clothes. Suspicious for those who say they're right... When we got on the plane, the luggage lockers were all empty. The flight wasn't even full. I wondered how many people had to pay because they were forced to check their cabin baggage? How many did not complain and bear this extra cost? In short, it was a horrible experience that I hope I don't have to repeat. It's much better to pay more and be treated like a customer than "cheap" and be treated like trash.

Then I explained that one of their colleagues over the phone told me otherwise and I would like to know why I'm getting two different answers from two customer service departments of the same company. I didn't get a reply to that message or to the two reminders I sent next. Upon arrival to Amsterdam, I had no choice than to wait for the night train and get an uber on top of that resulting to a commuting time of 3 more hours on top of the 2 hours of delay. And Transavia had nothing to say. Cherry on top that the flight attendants couldn't even help me find space for the cabin luggage and while being sitted at row 6, I had to store my luggage above row 23 and of course wait for everyone to disembark to get my luggage upon arrival. Awful experience, awful flight, awful customer service

name: Ronan Tanios
title: The most unprofessional company
text: I travel 2 times every month with all kind of companies going from Air France, SAS, SwissAir to Easyjet and Ryanair. I expected much more from an airline belonging to Air France.I have never experienced anything so unprofessional and discourteous. Despite arriving at the airport three hours before our flight, we missed it due to the staff's incompetence.We cleared security one hour before the flight and 40 minutes before the gate closed. However, we had to pass another security checkpoint because my cousin wasn't from a European country. The staff assured us we wouldn’t miss the flight and could pass once contacted by the gate during the last call for boarding.First of all, the gate staff didn’t do any last call. We failed to land there because of the weather and ended up landing in Lille (North if France). 30 minutes in, no one had explained to us anything except that we’re in Lille. Note that if I didn’t personally ask multiple times, they were leaving us completely uninformed. During this period (of eventually 3 hours), the staff was not communicating updates unless constantly asked, did not provide us with water, food, or internet to contact the people waiting for us at Orly airport. One passenger who already had a french sim gave 7 of us hotspot in order to do that. I asked for water repeatedly, even offering to pay for it, and was ignored.
